text: Fol.
text_bare: Fol.

text: a.
text_bare: a.

text: Hwæt!
text_bare: Hwæt!

text: wē Gār-Dena in gēar-dagum þēod-cyninga þrym gefrūnon, hū ðā æþelingas ellen fremedon.
text_bare: we Gar-Dena in gear-dagum þeod-cyninga þrym gefrunon, hu ða æþelingas ellen fremedon.

text: Oft Scyld Scēfing sceaþena þrēatum, monegum mǣgþum meodo-setla oftēah.
text_bare: Oft Scyld Scefing sceaþena þreatum, monegum mægþum meodo-setla ofteah.

text: Egsode eorl, syððan ǣrest wearð fēa-sceaft funden; hē þæs frōfre gebād, wēox under wolcnum, weorð-myndum þāh, oð þæt him ǣghwylc þāra ymb-sittendra ofer hron-rāde hȳran scolde, gomban gyldan; þæt wæs gōd cyning.
text_bare: Egsode eorl, syððan ærest wearð fea-sceaft funden; he þæs frofre gebad, weox under wolcnum, weorð-myndum þah, oð þæt him æghwylc þara ymb-sittendra ofer hron-rade hyran scolde, gomban gyldan; þæt wæs god cyning.

text: Ðǣm eafera wæs æfter cenned geong in geardum, þone God sende folce tō frōfre; fyren-ðearfe ongeat, þæt hīe ǣr drugon aldor-lēase lange hwīle.
text_bare: Ðæm eafera wæs æfter cenned geong in geardum, þone God sende folce to frofre; fyren-ðearfe ongeat, þæt hie ær drugon aldor-lease lange hwile.

text: Him þæs Līf-frēa, wuldres Wealdend, worold-āre forgeaf; Bēowulf wæs brēme blǣd wīde sprang , Scyldes eafera Scede-landum in.
text_bare: Him þæs Lif-frea, wuldres Wealdend, worold-are forgeaf; Beowulf wæs breme blæd wide sprang , Scyldes eafera Scede-landum in.

text: Swā sceal geong guma gōde gewyrcean, Fol.
text_bare: Swa sceal geong guma gode gewyrcean, Fol.

text: b.fromum feoh-giftum on fæder wine, þæt hine on ylde eft gewunigen wil-gesīþas, þonne wīg cume, lēode gelǣsten; lof-dǣdum sceal in mǣgþa gehwǣre man geþeon.
text_bare: b.fromum feoh-giftum on fæder wine, þæt hine on ylde eft gewunigen wil-gesiþas, þonne wig cume, leode gelæsten; lof-dædum sceal in mægþa gehwære man geþeon.

text: Him ða Scyld gewāt tō gescæp-hwīle fela-hrōr fēran on frēan wǣre; hī hyne þā ætbǣron tō brimes faroðe, swǣse gesīþas, swā hē selfa bæd, þenden wordum wēold wine Scyldinga, lēof land-fruma lange āhte.
text_bare: Him ða Scyld gewat to gescæp-hwile fela-hror feran on frean wære; hi hyne þa ætbæron to brimes faroðe, swæse gesiþas, swa he selfa bæd, þenden wordum weold wine Scyldinga, leof land-fruma lange ahte.

text: Þær æt hȳðe stōd hringed-stefna īsig ond ūt-fūs, æþelinges fær; ālēdon þā lēofne þēoden, bēaga bryttan on bearm scipes, mǣrne be mæste.
text_bare: Þær æt hyðe stod hringed-stefna isig ond ut-fus, æþelinges fær; aledon þa leofne þeoden, beaga bryttan on bearm scipes, mærne be mæste.

text: Þǣr wæs mādma fela, of feor-wegum frætwa gelǣded.
text_bare: Þær wæs madma fela, of feor-wegum frætwa gelæded.

text: Ne hȳrde ic cymlīcor cēol gegyrwan hilde-wǣpnum ond heaðo-wǣedum, billum ond byrnum; him on bearme læg mādma mænigo, þā him mid scoldon on flōdes ǣht feor gewītan.
text_bare: Ne hyrde ic cymlicor ceol gegyrwan hilde-wæpnum ond heaðo-wæedum, billum ond byrnum; him on bearme læg madma mænigo, þa him mid scoldon on flodes æht feor gewitan.

text: Nalæs hī hine lǣssan lācum tēodan, þēod-gestrēonum, þonne þā dydon, þe hine æt frum-sceafte forð onsendon Fol.
text_bare: Nalæs hi hine læssan lacum teodan, þeod-gestreonum, þonne þa dydon, þe hine æt frum-sceafte forð onsendon Fol.

text: a.ǣnne ofer ȳðe umbor-wesende.
text_bare: a.ænne ofer yðe umbor-wesende.

text: Þa gyt hīe him āsetton segen gyldenne hēah ofer hēafod, lēton hohn beran, gēafon on gār-secg; him wæs gēomor sefa, murnende mōd.
text_bare: Þa gyt hie him asetton segen gyldenne heah ofer heafod, leton hohn beran, geafon on gar-secg; him wæs geomor sefa, murnende mod.

text: Men ne cunnon secgan tō sōðe, sele-rǣdende, hæleð under heofenum, hwā þǣm hlæste onfēng.
text_bare: Men ne cunnon secgan to soðe, sele-rædende, hæleð under heofenum, hwa þæm hlæste onfeng.

text: Ðā wæs on burgum Bēowulf Scyldinga, lēof lēod-cyning, longe þrāge folcum gefrǣge fæder ellor hwearf, aldor of earde , oþ þæt him eft onwōc hēah Healfdene; hēold þenden lifde, gamol ond gūð-rēouw, glæde Scyldingas.
text_bare: Ða wæs on burgum Beowulf Scyldinga, leof leod-cyning, longe þrage folcum gefræge fæder ellor hwearf, aldor of earde , oþ þæt him eft onwoc heah Healfdene; heold þenden lifde, gamol ond guð-reouw, glæde Scyldingas.

text: Ðǣm feower bearn forð gerīmed in worold wōcun, weoroda rǣswa Heorogār, ond Hrōðgār ond Hālga til; hȳrde ic, þæt Elan cwēn Ongenþēowes wæs Heaðo-Scilfinges heals-gebedda.
text_bare: Ðæm feower bearn forð gerimed in worold wocun, weoroda ræswa Heorogar, ond Hroðgar ond Halga til; hyrde ic, þæt Elan cwen Ongenþeowes wæs Heaðo-Scilfinges heals-gebedda.

text: Þā wæs Hrōðgāre here-spēd gyfen, wīges weorð-mynd, þæt him his wine-māgas georne hȳrdon, oðð þæt sēo geogoð gewēox, mago-driht micel.
text_bare: Þa wæs Hroðgare here-sped gyfen, wiges weorð-mynd, þæt him his wine-magas georne hyrdon, oðð þæt seo geogoð geweox, mago-driht micel.

text: Him on mōd bearn, þæt heal-reced hātan wolde, medo-ærn micel men gewyrcean, þonne yldo bearn ǣfre gefrūnon, ond þǣr on innan eall gedǣlan geongum ond ealdum, swylc him God sealde, būton folc-scare ond feorum gumena.
text_bare: Him on mod bearn, þæt heal-reced hatan wolde, medo-ærn micel men gewyrcean, þonne yldo bearn æfre gefrunon, ond þær on innan eall gedælan geongum ond ealdum, swylc him God sealde, buton folc-scare ond feorum gumena.

text: Ðā ic wīde gefrægn weorc gebannan manigre mǣgþe geond þisne middan-geard, folc-stede frætwan.
text_bare: Ða ic wide gefrægn weorc gebannan manigre mægþe geond þisne middan-geard, folc-stede frætwan.

text: Him on fyrste gelomp ǣdre mid yldum, þæt hit wearð eal gearo, heal-ærna mǣst; scōp him Heort naman, sē þe his wordes geweald wīde hæfde.
text_bare: Him on fyrste gelomp ædre mid yldum, þæt hit wearð eal gearo, heal-ærna mæst; scop him Heort naman, se þe his wordes geweald wide hæfde.

text: Hē bēot ne ālēh, bēagas dǣlde, sinc æt symle.
text_bare: He beot ne aleh, beagas dælde, sinc æt symle.

text: Sele hlīfade hēah ond horn-gēap; heaðo-wylma bād lāðan līges.
text_bare: Sele hlifade heah ond horn-geap; heaðo-wylma bad laðan liges.

text: Ne wæs hit lenge þā, gēn, þæt se ecg-hete āþum-swerian æfter wæl-nīðe wæcnan scolde.
text_bare: Ne wæs hit lenge þa, gen, þæt se ecg-hete aþum-swerian æfter wæl-niðe wæcnan scolde.

text: Ðā se ellen‐gǣst earfoðlīce þrāge geþolode, sē þe in þȳstrum bād, þæt hē dōgora gehwām drēam gehȳrde hlūdne in healle; þǣr wæs hearpan swēg, swutol sang scopes.
text_bare: Ða se ellen‐gæst earfoðlice þrage geþolode, se þe in þystrum bad, þæt he dogora gehwam dream gehyrde hludne in healle; þær wæs hearpan sweg, swutol sang scopes.

text: Sægde sē þe cūþe frumsceaft fīra feorran reccan, cwæð þæt se Ælmihtiga eorðan worhte, wlite‐beorhtne wang, swā wæter bebūgeð; gesette sige‐hrēþig sunnan and mōnan lēoman tō lēohte land‐būendum, ond gefrætwade foldan scēatas leomum and lēafum; līf ēac gesceōp cynna gehwylcum, þāra ðe cwice hwyrfaþ.
text_bare: Sægde se þe cuþe frumsceaft fira feorran reccan, cwæð þæt se Ælmihtiga eorðan worhte, wlite‐beorhtne wang, swa wæter bebugeð; gesette sige‐hreþig sunnan and monan leoman to leohte land‐buendum, ond gefrætwade foldan sceatas leomum and leafum; lif eac gesceop cynna gehwylcum, þara ðe cwice hwyrfaþ.

text: Swā ðā driht‐guman drēamum lifdon ēadiglīce, oð ðæt ān ongan fyrene fremman, fēond on helle; wæs se grimma gæst Grendel hāten, mǣre mearc‐stapa, sē þe mōras hēold, fen ond fæsten; fīfel‐cynnes eard won‐sǣli wer weardode hwīle, siþðan him Scyppend forscrifen hæfde.
text_bare: Swa ða driht‐guman dreamum lifdon eadiglice, oð ðæt an ongan fyrene fremman, feond on helle; wæs se grimma gæst Grendel haten, mære mearc‐stapa, se þe moras heold, fen ond fæsten; fifel‐cynnes eard won‐sæli wer weardode hwile, siþðan him Scyppend forscrifen hæfde.

text: In Caines cynne þone cwealm gewræc, ēce Drihten, þæs þe hē Ābel slōg.
text_bare: In Caines cynne þone cwealm gewræc, ece Drihten, þæs þe he Abel slog.

text: Ne gefeah hē þǣere fǣhðe, ac hē hine feor forwræc, Metod for þȳ māne, man-cynue fram.
text_bare: Ne gefeah he þæere fæhðe, ac he hine feor forwræc, Metod for þy mane, man-cynue fram.

text: Ðanon untȳdras ealle onwōcon, eotenas ond ylfe ond orcneas, swylce gīgantas, þā wið Gode wunnon lange þrāge; hē him ðæs lēan forgeald.
text_bare: Ðanon untydras ealle onwocon, eotenas ond ylfe ond orcneas, swylce gigantas, þa wið Gode wunnon lange þrage; he him ðæs lean forgeald.

text: Gewāt ðā nēosian, syþðan niht becōm, hēan hūses, hū hit Hring-Dene æfter bēor-þege gebūn hæfdon.
text_bare: Gewat ða neosian, syþðan niht becom, hean huses, hu hit Hring-Dene æfter beor-þege gebun hæfdon.

text: Fand þā ðǣr inne æþelinga gedriht swefan æfter symble; sorge ne cūðon, wonsceaft wera.
text_bare: Fand þa ðær inne æþelinga gedriht swefan æfter symble; sorge ne cuðon, wonsceaft wera.

text: Wiht unhǣlo, grim ond grǣdig, gearo sōna wæs, rēoc ond rēþe, ond on raeste genam þrītig þegna; þanon eft gewāt hūðe hrēmig tō hām faran, mid þǣre wæl-fylle wica nēosan.
text_bare: Wiht unhælo, grim ond grædig, gearo sona wæs, reoc ond reþe, ond on raeste genam þritig þegna; þanon eft gewat huðe hremig to ham faran, mid þære wæl-fylle wica neosan.

text: Ða wæs on ūhtan mid ǣr-dæge Grendles guð-cræft gumum undyrne; þā wæs æfter wiste wōp ūp āhafen, micel morgen-swēg.
text_bare: Ða wæs on uhtan mid ær-dæge Grendles guð-cræft gumum undyrne; þa wæs æfter wiste wop up ahafen, micel morgen-sweg.

text: Mǣre þēoden, æþeling ǣr-gōd, unblīðe sæt, þolode ðrȳð-swȳðy, þegn-sorge drēah, syðþan hīe þæs lāðan lāst scēawedon, wergan gāstes; wæs þæt gewin tō strang, lāð ond longsum.
text_bare: Mære þeoden, æþeling ær-god, unbliðe sæt, þolode ðryð-swyðy, þegn-sorge dreah, syðþan hie þæs laðan last sceawedon, wergan gastes; wæs þæt gewin to strang, lað ond longsum.

text: Næs hit lengra fyrst, ac ymb āne niht eft gefremede morð-beala māre ond nō mearn fore fǣhðe ond fyrene; wæs tō fæst on þām.
text_bare: Næs hit lengra fyrst, ac ymb ane niht eft gefremede morð-beala mare ond no mearn fore fæhðe ond fyrene; wæs to fæst on þam.

text: Þā wæs ēað-fynde, þe him elles hwǣr gerūmlīcor ræste sōhte, bed æfter būrum, ðā him gebēacnod wæs, gesægd sōðlīce, sweotolan tācne heal-ðegnes hete; hēold hyne syðþan fyr ond fæstor, sē þǣm fēonde ætwand.
text_bare: Þa wæs eað-fynde, þe him elles hwær gerumlicor ræste sohte, bed æfter burum, ða him gebeacnod wæs, gesægd soðlice, sweotolan tacne heal-ðegnes hete; heold hyne syðþan fyr ond fæstor, se þæm feonde ætwand.

text: Swā rixode ond wið rihte wan āna wið eallum, oð þæt īdel stōd hūsa sēlest.
text_bare: Swa rixode ond wið rihte wan ana wið eallum, oð þæt idel stod husa selest.

text: Wæs sēo hwīl micel; twelf wintra tīd torn geþolode wine Scyldinga, wēana gehwelcne, sīdra sorga; forðam syðþan wearð ylda bearnum undyrne cuð, gyddum gēomore, þætte Grendel wan hwīle wið Hrōþgār, hete-nīðas wæg, fyrene ond fǣhðe fela missera, singale sæce; sibbe ne wolde wið manna hwone mægenes Deniga feorh-bealo feorran, fēo þingian, ne þǣr nǣnig witena wēnan þorfte beorhtre bōte tō banan fohnum.
text_bare: Wæs seo hwil micel; twelf wintra tid torn geþolode wine Scyldinga, weana gehwelcne, sidra sorga; forðam syðþan wearð ylda bearnum undyrne cuð, gyddum geomore, þætte Grendel wan hwile wið Hroþgar, hete-niðas wæg, fyrene ond fæhðe fela missera, singale sæce; sibbe ne wolde wið manna hwone mægenes Deniga feorh-bealo feorran, feo þingian, ne þær nænig witena wenan þorfte beorhtre bote to banan fohnum.

text: Atol ǣglǣca ēhtende wæs, deorc dēaþ-scūa, duguþe ond geogoþe, seomade ond syrede, sin-nihte hēold mistige mōras; men ne cunnon, hwyder hel-rūnan hwyrftum scrīþað.
text_bare: Atol æglæca ehtende wæs, deorc deaþ-scua, duguþe ond geogoþe, seomade ond syrede, sin-nihte heold mistige moras; men ne cunnon, hwyder hel-runan hwyrftum scriþað.

text: Swā fela fyrena fēond man-cynnes, atol ān-gengea, oft gefremede, heardra hȳnða; Heorot eardode, sinc-fāge sel sweartum nihtum; nō hē þone gif-stōl grētan mōste, māþðum for Metode, ne his myne wisse.
text_bare: Swa fela fyrena feond man-cynnes, atol an-gengea, oft gefremede, heardra hynða; Heorot eardode, sinc-fage sel sweartum nihtum; no he þone gif-stol gretan moste, maþðum for Metode, ne his myne wisse.

text: Þæt wæs wrsec micel wine Scyldinga, mōdes brecða.
text_bare: Þæt wæs wrsec micel wine Scyldinga, modes brecða.

text: Monig oft gesæt rīce tō rūne, rǣd eahtedon, hwæt swīð-ferhðum sēlest wǣre wið fǣr-gryrum tō gefremmanne.
text_bare: Monig oft gesæt rice to rune, ræd eahtedon, hwæt swið-ferhðum selest wære wið fær-gryrum to gefremmanne.

text: Hwīlum hīe gehēton æt hærg-trafum.
text_bare: Hwilum hie geheton æt hærg-trafum.

text: wīg-weorþunga, wordum bǣdon, þæt him gāst-bona gēoce gefremede wið þēod-þrēaum.
text_bare: wig-weorþunga, wordum bædon, þæt him gast-bona geoce gefremede wið þeod-þreaum.

text: Swylc wæs þēaw hyra, hǣþenra hyht; helle gemundon in mōd-sefan, Metod hīe ne cūþon, dǣda Dēmend, ne wiston hīe Drihten God, ne hīe hūru heofena Helm herian ne cūþon, wuldres Waldend.
text_bare: Swylc wæs þeaw hyra, hæþenra hyht; helle gemundon in mod-sefan, Metod hie ne cuþon, dæda Demend, ne wiston hie Drihten God, ne hie huru heofena Helm herian ne cuþon, wuldres Waldend.

text: Wā bið þǣm ðe sceal þurh slīðne nīð sāwle bescūfan in fȳres fæþm, frōfre ne wēnan, wihte gewendan; wel bið þǣm þe mōt æfter dēað-dæge Drihten sēcean, ond tō Fæder fæþmum freoðo wilnian.
text_bare: Wa bið þæm ðe sceal þurh sliðne nið sawle bescufan in fyres fæþm, frofre ne wenan, wihte gewendan; wel bið þæm þe mot æfter deað-dæge Drihten secean, ond to Fæder fæþmum freoðo wilnian.

text: Swā ðā mǣl-ceare maga Healfdenes singala sēað; ne mihte snotor hæleð wēan onwendan; wæs þæt gewin tō swȳð, lāþ ond longsum, þe on ðā lēode becōm, nȳd-wracu nīþ-grim, niht-bealwa mǣst.
text_bare: Swa ða mæl-ceare maga Healfdenes singala seað; ne mihte snotor hæleð wean onwendan; wæs þæt gewin to swyð, laþ ond longsum, þe on ða leode becom, nyd-wracu niþ-grim, niht-bealwa mæst.

text: Þaet fram hām gefrægn Higelāces þegn, gōd mid Gēatum, Grendles dǣda; sē wæs mon-cynnes mægenes strengest on þǣm dæge þysses līfes, æþele ond ēacen.
text_bare: Þaet fram ham gefrægn Higelaces þegn, god mid Geatum, Grendles dæda; se wæs mon-cynnes mægenes strengest on þæm dæge þysses lifes, æþele ond eacen.

text: Hēt him ȳð-lidan gōdne gegyrwan; cwæð, hē gūð-cyning ofer swan-rāde sēcean wolde, mǣrne þēoden, þā him wæs manna þearf.
text_bare: Het him yð-lidan godne gegyrwan; cwæð, he guð-cyning ofer swan-rade secean wolde, mærne þeoden, þa him wæs manna þearf.

text: Ðone sīð-fæt him snotere ceorlas lȳt-hwon lōgon, þēah hē him lēof wǣre; hwetton hige-rōfne, hǣl scēawedon.
text_bare: Ðone sið-fæt him snotere ceorlas lyt-hwon logon, þeah he him leof wære; hwetton hige-rofne, hæl sceawedon.

text: Hæfde se gōda Gēata lēoda cempan gecorone, þāra þe hē cēnoste findan mihte; fiftena sum sund-wudu sōhte; secg wīsade, lagu-cræftig mon, land-gemyrcu.
text_bare: Hæfde se goda Geata leoda cempan gecorone, þara þe he cenoste findan mihte; fiftena sum sund-wudu sohte; secg wisade, lagu-cræftig mon, land-gemyrcu.

text: Fyrst forð gewāt; flota wæs on ȳðum, bāt under beorge.
text_bare: Fyrst forð gewat; flota wæs on yðum, bat under beorge.

text: Beornas gearwe on stefn stigon; strēamas wundon sund wið sande; secgas bǣron on bearm nacan beorhte frætwe, gūð-searo geatolīc; guman ūt scufon, weras on wil-sīð, wudu bundenne.
text_bare: Beornas gearwe on stefn stigon; streamas wundon sund wið sande; secgas bæron on bearm nacan beorhte frætwe, guð-searo geatolic; guman ut scufon, weras on wil-sið, wudu bundenne.

text: Gewat þā ofer wǣg-holm winde gefȳsed flota fāmi-heals fugle gelīcost, oð þæt ymb an-tīd ōþres dōgores wunden-stefna gewaden hæfde, þæt ðā līðende land gesāwon, brim-clifu blīcan, beorgas stēape, sīde sǣ-næssas; þā wæs sund liden eoletes æt ende.
text_bare: Gewat þa ofer wæg-holm winde gefysed flota fami-heals fugle gelicost, oð þæt ymb an-tid oþres dogores wunden-stefna gewaden hæfde, þæt ða liðende land gesawon, brim-clifu blican, beorgas steape, side sæ-næssas; þa wæs sund liden eoletes æt ende.

text: Þanon up hraðe Wedera lēode on wang stigon, sǣ-wudu sǣldon; syrcan hrysedon, gūð-gewǣdo; Gode þancedon, þæs þe him ȳþ-lāde ēaðe wurdon.
text_bare: Þanon up hraðe Wedera leode on wang stigon, sæ-wudu sældon; syrcan hrysedon, guð-gewædo; Gode þancedon, þæs þe him yþ-lade eaðe wurdon.

text: Þā of wealle geseah weard Scildinga, sē þe holm-clifu healdan scolde, beran ofer bolcan beorhte randas, fyrd-searu fūslicu; hine fyrwyt bræc mōd-gehygdum, hwæt þā men wǣron.
text_bare: Þa of wealle geseah weard Scildinga, se þe holm-clifu healdan scolde, beran ofer bolcan beorhte randas, fyrd-searu fuslicu; hine fyrwyt bræc mod-gehygdum, hwæt þa men wæron.

text: Gewāt him þā tō waroðe wicge rīdan þegn Hrōðgāres, þrymmum cwehte mægen-wudu mundum, meþel-wordum frægn: “Hwæt syndon gē searo-hæbbendra byrnum werede, þe þus brontne cēol ofer lagu-strǣte lǣdan cwōmon, hider ofer holmas hringed-stefnan?
text_bare: Gewat him þa to waroðe wicge ridan þegn Hroðgares, þrymmum cwehte mægen-wudu mundum, meþel-wordum frægn: “Hwæt syndon ge searo-hæbbendra byrnum werede, þe þus brontne ceol ofer lagu-stræte lædan cwomon, hider ofer holmas hringed-stefnan?

text: Ic wæs ende-sǣta, ǣg-wearde hēold, þē on land Dena lāðra nǣnig mid scip-herge sceðþan ne meahte.
text_bare: Ic wæs ende-sæta, æg-wearde heold, þe on land Dena laðra nænig mid scip-herge sceðþan ne meahte.

text: Nō hēr cūðlīcor cuman ongunnon lind-hæbbende; ne gē lēafnes-word gūð-fremmendra gearwe ne wisson, māga gemēdu.
text_bare: No her cuðlicor cuman ongunnon lind-hæbbende; ne ge leafnes-word guð-fremmendra gearwe ne wisson, maga gemedu.

text: Nǣfre ic māran geseah eorla ofer eorþan, ðonne is ēower sum, secg on searwum; nis þæt seld-guma wǣpnum geweorðad, næfne him his wlite lēoge, ǣnlīc an-sȳn.
text_bare: Næfre ic maran geseah eorla ofer eorþan, ðonne is eower sum, secg on searwum; nis þæt seld-guma wæpnum geweorðad, næfne him his wlite leoge, ænlic an-syn.

text: Nū ic ēower sceal frum-cyn witan, ǣr gē fyr heonan, lēase scēaweras, on land Dena furþur fēran.
text_bare: Nu ic eower sceal frum-cyn witan, ær ge fyr heonan, lease sceaweras, on land Dena furþur feran.

text: Nū gē feor-būend, mere-līðende, mīnne gehȳrað ān-fealdne geþōht; ofost is sēlest tō gecȳðanne, hwanan ēowre cyme syndon.”
text_bare: Nu ge feor-buend, mere-liðende, minne gehyrað an-fealdne geþoht; ofost is selest to gecyðanne, hwanan eowre cyme syndon.”

text: Him se yldesta ondswarode, werodes wīsa, word-hord onlēac: “Wē synt gum-cynnes Gēata lēode ond Higelāces heoið-genēatas.
text_bare: Him se yldesta ondswarode, werodes wisa, word-hord onleac: “We synt gum-cynnes Geata leode ond Higelaces heoið-geneatas.

text: Wæs mīn fæder folcum gecȳþed, æþele ord-fruma Ecgþēow hāten; gebād wintra worn, ǣr hē on weg hwurfe gamol of geardum; hine gearwe geman witena wel-hwylc wīde geond eorþan.
text_bare: Wæs min fæder folcum gecyþed, æþele ord-fruma Ecgþeow haten; gebad wintra worn, ær he on weg hwurfe gamol of geardum; hine gearwe geman witena wel-hwylc wide geond eorþan.

text: Wē þurh holdne hige hlāford þīnne, sunu Healfdenes, sēcean cwōmon, lēod-gebyrgean; wes þū ūs lārena gōd.
text_bare: We þurh holdne hige hlaford þinne, sunu Healfdenes, secean cwomon, leod-gebyrgean; wes þu us larena god.

text: Habbað wē tō þǣm mǣran micel ǣrende Deniga frēan; ne sceal þǣr dyrne sum wesan, þæs ic wēne.
text_bare: Habbað we to þæm mæran micel ærende Deniga frean; ne sceal þær dyrne sum wesan, þæs ic wene.

text: Þū wāst gif hit is, swā wē sōþlīce secgan hȳrdon, þæt mid Scyldingum sceaðona ic nāt hwylc, dēogol dǣd-hata, deorcum nihtum ēaweð þurh egsan uncūðne nīð, hȳnðu ond hrā-fyl.
text_bare: Þu wast gif hit is, swa we soþlice secgan hyrdon, þæt mid Scyldingum sceaðona ic nat hwylc, deogol dæd-hata, deorcum nihtum eaweð þurh egsan uncuðne nið, hynðu ond hra-fyl.

text: Ic þæs Hrōðgār mæg þurh rūmne sefan rǣd gelǣran, hū hē frōd ond gōd fēond oferswȳðeþ, gyf him ed-wendan ǣfre scolde bealuwa bisigu, bōt eft cuman, ond þā cear-wylmas cōlran wurðaþ; oððe ā syþðan earfoð-þrāge, þrēa-nȳd þolað, þenden þǣr wunað on hēah-stede hūsa sēlest.” Weard maþelode, ðǣr on wicge saet, ombeht unforht: “Ǣghwaþres sceal scearp scyld-wiga gescād witan, worda ond worca, sē þe wel þenceð.
text_bare: Ic þæs Hroðgar mæg þurh rumne sefan ræd gelæran, hu he frod ond god feond oferswyðeþ, gyf him ed-wendan æfre scolde bealuwa bisigu, bot eft cuman, ond þa cear-wylmas colran wurðaþ; oððe a syþðan earfoð-þrage, þrea-nyd þolað, þenden þær wunað on heah-stede husa selest.” Weard maþelode, ðær on wicge saet, ombeht unforht: “Æghwaþres sceal scearp scyld-wiga gescad witan, worda ond worca, se þe wel þenceð.

text: Ic þæt gehȳre, þæt þis is hold weorod frēan Scyldinga.
text_bare: Ic þæt gehyre, þæt þis is hold weorod frean Scyldinga.

text: Gewītaþ forð beran wǣpen ond gewǣdu, ic ēow wīsige; swylce ic magu-þegnas mīne hāte wið fēonda gehwone flotan ēowerne, nīw-tyrwydne nacan on sande, ārum healdan, oþ þæt eft byreð ofer lagu-strēamas lēofne mannan wudu wunden-hals tō Weder-mearce.
text_bare: Gewitaþ forð beran wæpen ond gewædu, ic eow wisige; swylce ic magu-þegnas mine hate wið feonda gehwone flotan eowerne, niw-tyrwydne nacan on sande, arum healdan, oþ þæt eft byreð ofer lagu-streamas leofne mannan wudu wunden-hals to Weder-mearce.

text: Gōd-fremmendra swylcum gifeþe bið, þæt þone hilde-rǣs hāl gedīgeð.” Gewiton him þā fēran; flota stille bād, seomode on sāle sīd-fæþmed scip, on ancre fæst.
text_bare: God-fremmendra swylcum gifeþe bið, þæt þone hilde-ræs hal gedigeð.” Gewiton him þa feran; flota stille bad, seomode on sale sid-fæþmed scip, on ancre fæst.

text: Eofor-līc scionon ofer hlēor-bergan, gehroden golde, fāh ond fȳr-heard; ferh wearde hēold.
text_bare: Eofor-lic scionon ofer hleor-bergan, gehroden golde, fah ond fyr-heard; ferh wearde heold.

text: Gūþmōd grummon, guman ōnetton, sigon ætsomne, oþ þæt hȳ sæl timbred, geatolīc ond gold-fāh, ongyton mihton; þæt wæs fore-mǣrost fold-būendum receda under roderum, on þǣm se rīca bād; līxte se lēoma ofer landa fela.
text_bare: Guþmod grummon, guman onetton, sigon ætsomne, oþ þæt hy sæl timbred, geatolic ond gold-fah, ongyton mihton; þæt wæs fore-mærost fold-buendum receda under roderum, on þæm se rica bad; lixte se leoma ofer landa fela.

text: Him þā hilde-dēor hof mōdigra torht getǣhte, þæt hīe him tō mihton gegnum gangan; gūð-beorna sum wicg gewende, word æfter cwæð: “Mǣl is mē tō fēran; Fæder al-walda mid ār-stafum ēowic gehealde sīða gesunde!
text_bare: Him þa hilde-deor hof modigra torht getæhte, þæt hie him to mihton gegnum gangan; guð-beorna sum wicg gewende, word æfter cwæð: “Mæl is me to feran; Fæder al-walda mid ar-stafum eowic gehealde siða gesunde!

text: Ic tō sǣ wille wið wrāð werod wearde healdan.”
text_bare: Ic to sæ wille wið wrað werod wearde healdan.”

text: Strǣt wæs stān-fāh, stīg wīsode gumum ætgædere.
text_bare: Stræt wæs stan-fah, stig wisode gumum ætgædere.

text: Gūð-byrne scān heard hond-locen, hring-īren scīr song in searwum, þā hīe tō sele furðam in hyra gryre-geatwum gangan cwōmon.
text_bare: Guð-byrne scan heard hond-locen, hring-iren scir song in searwum, þa hie to sele furðam in hyra gryre-geatwum gangan cwomon.

text: Setton sǣ-mēþe sīde scyldas, rondas regn-hearde, wið þæs recedes weal, bugon þā tō bence; byrnan hringdon, gūð-searo gumena; gāras stōdon, sǣ-manna searo, samod ætgædere, æsc-holt ufan grǣg; wæs se īren-þrēat wǣpnum gewurþad.
text_bare: Setton sæ-meþe side scyldas, rondas regn-hearde, wið þæs recedes weal, bugon þa to bence; byrnan hringdon, guð-searo gumena; garas stodon, sæ-manna searo, samod ætgædere, æsc-holt ufan græg; wæs se iren-þreat wæpnum gewurþad.

text: Þā ðǣr wlonc hæleð ōret-mecgas æfter æþelum frægn: “Hwanon ferigeað gē fǣtte scyldas, grǣge syrcan ond grīm-helmas, here-sceafta hēap?
text_bare: Þa ðær wlonc hæleð oret-mecgas æfter æþelum frægn: “Hwanon ferigeað ge fætte scyldas, græge syrcan ond grim-helmas, here-sceafta heap?

text: Ic eom Hrōðgāres ār ond ombiht.
text_bare: Ic eom Hroðgares ar ond ombiht.

text: Ne seah ic el-þēodige þus manige men mōdiglīcran.
text_bare: Ne seah ic el-þeodige þus manige men modiglicran.

text: Wēn ic þæt gē for wlenco, nalles for wræc-sīðum ac for hige-þrymmum, Hrōðgār sōhton.” Him þā ellen-rōf andswarode, wlanc Wedera lēod word æfter spræc, heard under helme: “Wē synt Higelāces bēod-genēatas; Bēowulf is mīn nama.
text_bare: Wen ic þæt ge for wlenco, nalles for wræc-siðum ac for hige-þrymmum, Hroðgar sohton.” Him þa ellen-rof andswarode, wlanc Wedera leod word æfter spræc, heard under helme: “We synt Higelaces beod-geneatas; Beowulf is min nama.

text: Wille ic āsecgan sunu Healfdenes, mǣrum þēodne, mīn ǣrende, aldre þīnum, gif hē ūs geunnan wile, þæt wē hine swā gōdne grētan mōton.” Wulfgār maþelode þæt wæs Wendla lēod, wæs his mōd-sefa manegum gecȳðed, wīg ond wīs-dōm : “Ic þæs wine Deniga, frēan Scildinga, frinan wille, bēaga bryttan, swā þū bēna eart, þēoden mǣrne, ymb þīnne sīð, ond þē þā, ondsware ǣdre gecȳðan, ðe mē se gōda āgifan þenceð.” Hwearf þā hrædlīce, þǣr Hrōðgār sæt eald ond unhār mid his eorla gedriht; ēode ellen-rōf, þæt hē for eaxlum gestōd Deniga frēan; cūþe hē duguðe þēaw.
text_bare: Wille ic asecgan sunu Healfdenes, mærum þeodne, min ærende, aldre þinum, gif he us geunnan wile, þæt we hine swa godne gretan moton.” Wulfgar maþelode þæt wæs Wendla leod, wæs his mod-sefa manegum gecyðed, wig ond wis-dom : “Ic þæs wine Deniga, frean Scildinga, frinan wille, beaga bryttan, swa þu bena eart, þeoden mærne, ymb þinne sið, ond þe þa, ondsware ædre gecyðan, ðe me se goda agifan þenceð.” Hwearf þa hrædlice, þær Hroðgar sæt eald ond unhar mid his eorla gedriht; eode ellen-rof, þæt he for eaxlum gestod Deniga frean; cuþe he duguðe þeaw.

text: Wulfgār maðelode tō his wine-drihtne: “Hēr syndon geferede, feorran cumene ofer geofenes begang, Gēata lēode; þone yldestan ōret-mecgas Bēowulf nemnað.
text_bare: Wulfgar maðelode to his wine-drihtne: “Her syndon geferede, feorran cumene ofer geofenes begang, Geata leode; þone yldestan oret-mecgas Beowulf nemnað.

text: Hȳ bēnan synt, þæt hīe, þēoden mīn, wið þē mōton wordum wrīxlan; nō ðū him wearne getēoh ðīnra gegn-cwida, glædman Hrōðgār.
text_bare: Hy benan synt, þæt hie, þeoden min, wið þe moton wordum wrixlan; no ðu him wearne geteoh ðinra gegn-cwida, glædman Hroðgar.

text: Hȳ on wīg-getāwum wyrðe þinceað eorla geæhtlan; hūru se aldor dēah, sē þǣm heaðo-rincum hider wīsade.”
text_bare: Hy on wig-getawum wyrðe þinceað eorla geæhtlan; huru se aldor deah, se þæm heaðo-rincum hider wisade.”

text: Hrōðgār maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “Ic hine cūðe cniht-wesende; wæs his eald fæder Ecgþēo hāten, ðǣm tō hām forgeaf Hrēþel Gēata āngan dohtor; is his eafora nū heard hēr cumen, sōhte holdne wine.
text_bare: Hroðgar maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “Ic hine cuðe cniht-wesende; wæs his eald fæder Ecgþeo haten, ðæm to ham forgeaf Hreþel Geata angan dohtor; is his eafora nu heard her cumen, sohte holdne wine.

text: Ðonne sægdon þæet sǣ-līþende, þā ðe gif-sceattas Gēata fyredon þyder tō þance, þæt hē þrittiges manna mægen-cræft on his mund-gripe heaþo-rōf hæbbe.
text_bare: Ðonne sægdon þæet sæ-liþende, þa ðe gif-sceattas Geata fyredon þyder to þance, þæt he þrittiges manna mægen-cræft on his mund-gripe heaþo-rof hæbbe.

text: Hine hālig God for ār-stafum ūs onsende, tō West-Denum, þæs ic wēn hæbbe, wið Grendles gryre; ic þǣm gōdan sceal for his mōd-þræce mādmas bēodan.
text_bare: Hine halig God for ar-stafum us onsende, to West-Denum, þæs ic wen hæbbe, wið Grendles gryre; ic þæm godan sceal for his mod-þræce madmas beodan.

text: Bēo ðū on ofeste, hāt in gān sēon sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere; gesaga him ēac wordum, þæt hīe sint wil-cuman Deniga lēodum.” Þā wið duru healle Wulfgār ēode, word inne ābēad; “Ēow hēt secgan sige-drihten mīn, aldor Ēast-Dena, þæt hē ēower æþelu can, ond gē him syndon ofer sǣ-wylmas, heard-hicgende, hider wil-cuman.
text_bare: Beo ðu on ofeste, hat in gan seon sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere; gesaga him eac wordum, þæt hie sint wil-cuman Deniga leodum.” Þa wið duru healle Wulfgar eode, word inne abead; “Eow het secgan sige-drihten min, aldor East-Dena, þæt he eower æþelu can, ond ge him syndon ofer sæ-wylmas, heard-hicgende, hider wil-cuman.

text: Nū gē mōton gangan in ēowrum gūð-geatawum, under here-grīman, Hrōðgār gesēon; lǣtað hilde-bord hēr onbīdan, wudu, wæl-sceaftas, worda geþinges.” Ārās þā se rīca, ymb hine rinc manig, þrȳðlīc þegna hēap; sume þǣr bidon, heaðo-rēaf hēoldon, swā him se hearda bebēad.
text_bare: Nu ge moton gangan in eowrum guð-geatawum, under here-griman, Hroðgar geseon; lætað hilde-bord her onbidan, wudu, wæl-sceaftas, worda geþinges.” Aras þa se rica, ymb hine rinc manig, þryðlic þegna heap; sume þær bidon, heaðo-reaf heoldon, swa him se hearda bebead.

text: Snyredon ætsomne, þā secg wīsode, under Heorotes hrōf; hyge-rōf ēode, heard under helme, þæt hē on hēoðe gestōd.
text_bare: Snyredon ætsomne, þa secg wisode, under Heorotes hrof; hyge-rof eode, heard under helme, þæt he on heoðe gestod.

text: Bēowulf maðelode on him byrne scān, searo-net sēowed smiþes or-þancum : “Wæs þū, Hrōðgār, hāl!
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode on him byrne scan, searo-net seowed smiþes or-þancum : “Wæs þu, Hroðgar, hal!

text: Ic eom Higelāces mǣg ond mago-ðegn; hæbbe ic mǣrða fela ongunnen on geogoþe.
text_bare: Ic eom Higelaces mæg ond mago-ðegn; hæbbe ic mærða fela ongunnen on geogoþe.

text: Mē wearð Grendles þing on mīnre ēþel-tyrf undyrne cūð; secgað sǣ-līðend, þæt þes sele stande, reced sēlesta, rinca gehwylcum īdel ond unnyt, siððan ǣfen-lēoht under heofenes hador beholen weorþeð.
text_bare: Me wearð Grendles þing on minre eþel-tyrf undyrne cuð; secgað sæ-liðend, þæt þes sele stande, reced selesta, rinca gehwylcum idel ond unnyt, siððan æfen-leoht under heofenes hador beholen weorþeð.

text: Þā mē þæt gelǣrdon lēode mīne, }} þā sēlestan, snotere ceorlas, þēoden Hrōðgār, þæt ic þē sōhte, forþan hīe mægenes cræft mīnne cūþon; selfe ofersāwon, ðā ic of searwum cwōm, fāh from fēondum, þǣr ic fīfe geband, ȳðde eotena cyn, ond on ȳðum slōg niceras nihtes, nearo-þearfe drēah, wræc Wedera nīð wēan āhsodon , forgrand gramum; ond nū wið Grendel sceal, wið þām āglǣcan, āna gehēgan ðing wið þyrse.
text_bare: Þa me þæt gelærdon leode mine, }} þa selestan, snotere ceorlas, þeoden Hroðgar, þæt ic þe sohte, forþan hie mægenes cræft minne cuþon; selfe ofersawon, ða ic of searwum cwom, fah from feondum, þær ic fife geband, yðde eotena cyn, ond on yðum slog niceras nihtes, nearo-þearfe dreah, wræc Wedera nið wean ahsodon , forgrand gramum; ond nu wið Grendel sceal, wið þam aglæcan, ana gehegan ðing wið þyrse.

text: Ic þē nū ðā, brego Beorht-Dena, biddan wille, eodor Scyldinga, ānre bēne, þæt ðū mē ne forwyrne, wīgendra hlēo, frēo-wine folca, nū ic þus feorran cōm, þæt ic mōte āna ond mīnra eorla gedryht, þes hearda hēap, Heorot fǣlsian.
text_bare: Ic þe nu ða, brego Beorht-Dena, biddan wille, eodor Scyldinga, anre bene, þæt ðu me ne forwyrne, wigendra hleo, freo-wine folca, nu ic þus feorran com, þæt ic mote ana ond minra eorla gedryht, þes hearda heap, Heorot fælsian.

text: Hæbbe ic ēac geāhsod, þæt se ǣglǣca for his won-hȳdum wǣpna ne rēcceð; ic þæt þonne forhicge, swā mē Higelāc sīe, mīn mon-drihten, mōdes bliðe, þæt ic sweord bere oþðe sīdne scyld, geolo-rand tō gūþe; ac ic mid grāpe sceal fōn wið fēonde, ond ymb feorh sacan lāð wið lāþum; ðǣr gelȳfan sceal Dryhtnes dōme sē þe hine dēað nimeð.
text_bare: Hæbbe ic eac geahsod, þæt se æglæca for his won-hydum wæpna ne recceð; ic þæt þonne forhicge, swa me Higelac sie, min mon-drihten, modes bliðe, þæt ic sweord bere oþðe sidne scyld, geolo-rand to guþe; ac ic mid grape sceal fon wið feonde, ond ymb feorh sacan lað wið laþum; ðær gelyfan sceal Dryhtnes dome se þe hine deað nimeð.

text: Wēn ic þæt hē wille, gif hē wealdan mōt, in þǣm.
text_bare: Wen ic þæt he wille, gif he wealdan mot, in þæm.

text: gūð-sele Gēatena lēode }} etan unforhte, swa hē oft dyde mægen Hrēð-manna.
text_bare: guð-sele Geatena leode }} etan unforhte, swa he oft dyde mægen Hreð-manna.

text: Nā þū mīnne þearft hafalan hȳclan, ac hē me habban wile drēore fāhne, gif mec dēað nimeð; byreð blōdig wæl, byrgean þenceð, eteð ān-genga unmurnlīce, mearcað mōr-hopu; nō ðū ymb mīnes ne þearft līces feorme leng sorgian.
text_bare: Na þu minne þearft hafalan hyclan, ac he me habban wile dreore fahne, gif mec deað nimeð; byreð blodig wæl, byrgean þenceð, eteð an-genga unmurnlice, mearcað mor-hopu; no ðu ymb mines ne þearft lices feorme leng sorgian.

text: Onsend Higelāce, gif mec hild nime, beadu-scrūda betst, þæt mīne brēost wereð, hrægla sēlest; þæt is Hrædlan lāf, Wēlandes geweorc.
text_bare: Onsend Higelace, gif mec hild nime, beadu-scruda betst, þæt mine breost wereð, hrægla selest; þæt is Hrædlan laf, Welandes geweorc.

text: Gǣð ā wyrd swā hīo scel.”
text_bare: Gæð a wyrd swa hio scel.”

text: Hrōðgār maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “For were-fyhtum þū, wine mīn Bēowulf, ond for ār-stafum ūsic sōhtest.
text_bare: Hroðgar maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “For were-fyhtum þu, wine min Beowulf, ond for ar-stafum usic sohtest.

text: Geslōh þin fæder fǣhðe mǣste, wearþ hē Heaþolāfe tō hand-bonan mid Wilfingum; ðā hine Wedera cyn for here-brōgan habban ne mihte.
text_bare: Gesloh þin fæder fæhðe mæste, wearþ he Heaþolafe to hand-bonan mid Wilfingum; ða hine Wedera cyn for here-brogan habban ne mihte.

text: Þanon hē gesōhte Sūð-Dena folc ofer ȳða gewealc, Ār-Scyldinga; ðā ic furþum wēold folce Deniga, ond on geogoðe hēold gimme-rīce hord-burh hæleþa.
text_bare: Þanon he gesohte Suð-Dena folc ofer yða gewealc, Ar-Scyldinga; ða ic furþum weold folce Deniga, ond on geogoðe heold gimme-rice hord-burh hæleþa.

text: Ðā wæs Heregār dēad, mīn yldra mǣg unlifigende, bearn Healfdenes; sē wæs betera ðonne ic.
text_bare: Ða wæs Heregar dead, min yldra mæg unlifigende, bearn Healfdenes; se wæs betera ðonne ic.

text: Siððan þā fǣhðe fēo þingode; sende ic Wylfingum ofer wæteres hrycg ealde mādmas; hē mē āþas swōr.
text_bare: Siððan þa fæhðe feo þingode; sende ic Wylfingum ofer wæteres hrycg ealde madmas; he me aþas swor.

text: Sorh is mē tō secganne on sefan mīnum gumena ǣngum, hwæt mē Grendel hafað hȳnðo on Heorote mid his hete-þancum, fǣr-nīða gefremed; is mīn flet-werod, wīg-hēap, gewanod; hīe wyrd forswēop on Grendles gryre.
text_bare: Sorh is me to secganne on sefan minum gumena ængum, hwæt me Grendel hafað hynðo on Heorote mid his hete-þancum, fær-niða gefremed; is min flet-werod, wig-heap, gewanod; hie wyrd forsweop on Grendles gryre.

text: God ēaþe mæg þone dol-sceaðan dǣda getwǣfan.
text_bare: God eaþe mæg þone dol-sceaðan dæda getwæfan.

text: Ful oft gebēotedon bēore druncne ofer ealo-wǣge ōret-mecgas, þæt hīe in bēor-sele bīdan woldon Grendles gūþe mid gryrum ecga.
text_bare: Ful oft gebeotedon beore druncne ofer ealo-wæge oret-mecgas, þæt hie in beor-sele bidan woldon Grendles guþe mid gryrum ecga.

text: Ðonne wæs þēos medo-heal on morgen tīd, driht-sele drēor-fāh, þonne dæg līxte, eal benc-þelu blōde bestȳmed, heall heoru-drēore; āhte ic holdra þȳ lǣs, dēorre duguðe, þē þā dēað fornam.
text_bare: Ðonne wæs þeos medo-heal on morgen tid, driht-sele dreor-fah, þonne dæg lixte, eal benc-þelu blode bestymed, heall heoru-dreore; ahte ic holdra þy læs, deorre duguðe, þe þa deað fornam.

text: Site nū tō symle ond onsǣl meoto, sige-hrēð secgum, swā þīn sefa hwette.” Þā wæs Gēat-mæcgum geador ætsomne on bēor-sele bene gerȳmed; þǣr swīð-ferhþe sittan ēodon, þrȳðum dealle.
text_bare: Site nu to symle ond onsæl meoto, sige-hreð secgum, swa þin sefa hwette.” Þa wæs Geat-mæcgum geador ætsomne on beor-sele bene gerymed; þær swið-ferhþe sittan eodon, þryðum dealle.

text: Þegn nytte behēold, sē þe on handa bær hroden ealo-wǣge, scencte scīr wered.
text_bare: Þegn nytte beheold, se þe on handa bær hroden ealo-wæge, scencte scir wered.

text: Scop hwīlum sang hādor on Heorote; þǣr wæs hæleða drēam, duguð unlȳtel Dena ond Wedera.
text_bare: Scop hwilum sang hador on Heorote; þær wæs hæleða dream, duguð unlytel Dena ond Wedera.

text: Unferð maþelode, Ecglāfes bearn, þe æt fōtum sæt frēan Scyldinga, onband beadu-rūne wæs him Bēowulfes sið, mōdges mere-faran, micel æf-þunca, forþon þe hē ne ūþe, þæt ǣnig ōðer man ǣfre mǣrða þon mā middan-geardes gehēdde under heofenum þonne hē sylfa : “Eart þū se Bēowulf, sē þe wið Brecan wunne, on sīdne sǣ ymb sund flite, ðǣr git for wlence wada cunnedon, ond for dol-gilpe on dēop wæter aldrum nēþdon?
text_bare: Unferð maþelode, Ecglafes bearn, þe æt fotum sæt frean Scyldinga, onband beadu-rune wæs him Beowulfes sið, modges mere-faran, micel æf-þunca, forþon þe he ne uþe, þæt ænig oðer man æfre mærða þon ma middan-geardes gehedde under heofenum þonne he sylfa : “Eart þu se Beowulf, se þe wið Brecan wunne, on sidne sæ ymb sund flite, ðær git for wlence wada cunnedon, ond for dol-gilpe on deop wæter aldrum neþdon?

text: Ne inc ǣnig mon, ne lēof nē lāð, belēan mihte sorh-fullne sīð, þā git on sund rēon; þǣr git ēagor-strēam earmum þehton, mǣton mere-strǣta, mundum brugdon, glidon ofer gār-secg; geofon ȳþum wēol, wintrys wyhn.
text_bare: Ne inc ænig mon, ne leof ne lað, belean mihte sorh-fullne sið, þa git on sund reon; þær git eagor-stream earmum þehton, mæton mere-stræta, mundum brugdon, glidon ofer gar-secg; geofon yþum weol, wintrys wyhn.

text: Git on wæteres ǣht seofon niht swuncon; hē þē æt sunde oferflāt, hæfde māre mægen.
text_bare: Git on wæteres æht seofon niht swuncon; he þe æt sunde oferflat, hæfde mare mægen.

text: Þā hine on morgen-tīd on Heaþo-Rǣmas holm up ætbær; ðonon hē gesōhte swǣsne ēðel, lēof his lēodum lond Brondinga, freoðo-burh fægere, þǣr hē folc āhte, burh ond bēagas.
text_bare: Þa hine on morgen-tid on Heaþo-Ræmas holm up ætbær; ðonon he gesohte swæsne eðel, leof his leodum lond Brondinga, freoðo-burh fægere, þær he folc ahte, burh ond beagas.

text: Bēot eal wið þē sunu Bēanstānes sōðe gelǣste.
text_bare: Beot eal wið þe sunu Beanstanes soðe gelæste.

text: Ðonne wēne ic tō þē wyrsan geþingea, ðēah þū heaðo-rǣsa gehwǣr dohte, grimre gūðe, gif þū Grendles dearst niht-longne fyrst nēan bīdan.” Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: “Hwæt!
text_bare: Ðonne wene ic to þe wyrsan geþingea, ðeah þu heaðo-ræsa gehwær dohte, grimre guðe, gif þu Grendles dearst niht-longne fyrst nean bidan.” Beowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: “Hwæt!

text: þū worn fela, wine mīn Unferð, bēore druncen ymb Brecan sprǣce, sægdest from his sīðe.
text_bare: þu worn fela, wine min Unferð, beore druncen ymb Brecan spræce, sægdest from his siðe.

text: Sōð ic talige, þæt ic mere-strengo māran āhte, earfeþo on ȳþum, ðonne ǣnig ōþer man.
text_bare: Soð ic talige, þæt ic mere-strengo maran ahte, earfeþo on yþum, ðonne ænig oþer man.

text: Wit þæt gecwǣdon cniht-wesende ond gebēotedon wǣron begen þā git on geogoð-fēore , þæt wit on gār-secg ūt aldrum nēðdon; ond þæt geæfndon swā.
text_bare: Wit þæt gecwædon cniht-wesende ond gebeotedon wæron begen þa git on geogoð-feore , þæt wit on gar-secg ut aldrum neðdon; ond þæt geæfndon swa.

text: Hæfdon swurd nacod, þā wit on sund rēon, heard on handa; wit unc wið hron-fixas werian þōhton.
text_bare: Hæfdon swurd nacod, þa wit on sund reon, heard on handa; wit unc wið hron-fixas werian þohton.

text: Nō hē wiht fram mē flōd-ȳþum feor flēotan meahte, hraþor on holme; nō ic fram him wolde.
text_bare: No he wiht fram me flod-yþum feor fleotan meahte, hraþor on holme; no ic fram him wolde.

text: Ðā wit æt somne on sǣ wǣron fīf nihta fyrst, oþ þæt unc flōd tōdrāf, wado weallende; wedera cealdost, nīpende niht ond norþan wind, heaðo-grim ondhwearf; hrēo wǣron ȳþa.
text_bare: Ða wit æt somne on sæ wæron fif nihta fyrst, oþ þæt unc flod todraf, wado weallende; wedera cealdost, nipende niht ond norþan wind, heaðo-grim ondhwearf; hreo wæron yþa.

text: Wæs mere-fixa mōd onhrēred; þǣr mē wið lāðum līc-syrce mīn, heard hond-locen, helpe gefremede; beado-hrægl brōden on brēostum læg, golde gegyrwed.
text_bare: Wæs mere-fixa mod onhrered; þær me wið laðum lic-syrce min, heard hond-locen, helpe gefremede; beado-hrægl broden on breostum læg, golde gegyrwed.

text: Mē tō grunde tēah fāh fēond-scaða, fæste hæfde grim on grāpe; hwæþre mē gyfeþe wearð, þæt ic āglǣcan orde gerǣhte, hilde-bille; heaþo-rǣs fornam mihtig mere-dēor þurh mīne hand.
text_bare: Me to grunde teah fah feond-scaða, fæste hæfde grim on grape; hwæþre me gyfeþe wearð, þæt ic aglæcan orde geræhte, hilde-bille; heaþo-ræs fornam mihtig mere-deor þurh mine hand.

text: Swā mec gelōme lāð-getēonan þrēatedon þearle.
text_bare: Swa mec gelome lað-geteonan þreatedon þearle.

text: Ic him þēnode dēoran sweorde, swa hit gedēfe wæs; næs hīe ðǣre fylle gefēan hæfdon, mān-fordǣdlan, þæt hīe mē þēgon, symbel ymb-sǣton sǣ-grunde nēah; ac on mergenne mēcum wunde be ȳð-lāfe uppe lǣgon, sweordum āswefecle, þæt syðþan nā ymb brontne ford brim-līðende lāde ne letton.
text_bare: Ic him þenode deoran sweorde, swa hit gedefe wæs; næs hie ðære fylle gefean hæfdon, man-fordædlan, þæt hie me þegon, symbel ymb-sæton sæ-grunde neah; ac on mergenne mecum wunde be yð-lafe uppe lægon, sweordum aswefecle, þæt syðþan na ymb brontne ford brim-liðende lade ne letton.

text: Lēoht ēastan cōm, beorht bēacen Godes; brimu swaþredon, þæt ic sǣ-næssas gesēon mihte, windige weallas.
text_bare: Leoht eastan com, beorht beacen Godes; brimu swaþredon, þæt ic sæ-næssas geseon mihte, windige weallas.

text: Wyrd oft nereð unfǣgne eorl, þonne his ellen dēah.
text_bare: Wyrd oft nereð unfægne eorl, þonne his ellen deah.

text: Hwæþere mē gesǣlde, þæt ic mid sweorde ofslōh niceras nigene.
text_bare: Hwæþere me gesælde, þæt ic mid sweorde ofsloh niceras nigene.

text: Nō ic on niht gefrægn under heofones hwealf heardran feohtan, ne on ēg-strēamum earmran mannon; hwæþere ic fāra feng fēore gedīgde, sīþes wērig.
text_bare: No ic on niht gefrægn under heofones hwealf heardran feohtan, ne on eg-streamum earmran mannon; hwæþere ic fara feng feore gedigde, siþes werig.

text: Ðā mec sǣ oþbær, flod æfter faroðe, on Finna land, wadu weallendu.
text_bare: Ða mec sæ oþbær, flod æfter faroðe, on Finna land, wadu weallendu.

text: Nō ic wiht fram þē swylcra searo-nīða secgan hȳrde, billa brōgan; Breca nǣfre git æt heaðo-lāce, ne gehwæþer incer, swā dēorlīce dǣd gefremede fāgum sweordum nō ic þæs fela gylpe , þēah ðū þīnum brōðrum tō banan wurde, hēafod-mǣgum; þæs þū in helle scealt werhðo drēogan.
text_bare: No ic wiht fram þe swylcra searo-niða secgan hyrde, billa brogan; Breca næfre git æt heaðo-lace, ne gehwæþer incer, swa deorlice dæd gefremede fagum sweordum no ic þæs fela gylpe , þeah ðu þinum broðrum to banan wurde, heafod-mægum; þæs þu in helle scealt werhðo dreogan.

text: þēah þīn wit duge.
text_bare: þeah þin wit duge.

text: Secge ic þē tō sōðe, sunu Ecglāfes, þæt nǣfre Grendel swā fela gryra gefremede, atol ǣglǣca, ealdre þīnum, hȳnðo on Heorote, gif þīn hige wǣre, sefa swā searo-grim, swā þū self talast; ac hē hafað onfunden, þæt hē þā fǣhðe ne þearf, atole ecg-þræce, ēower lēode swīðe onsittan, Sige-Scyldinga; nymeð nȳd-bāde, nǣnegum ārað lēode Deniga, ac hē on lust wīgeð, swefeð ond sendeþ, secce ne wēneþ tō Gar-Denum.
text_bare: Secge ic þe to soðe, sunu Ecglafes, þæt næfre Grendel swa fela gryra gefremede, atol æglæca, ealdre þinum, hynðo on Heorote, gif þin hige wære, sefa swa searo-grim, swa þu self talast; ac he hafað onfunden, þæt he þa fæhðe ne þearf, atole ecg-þræce, eower leode swiðe onsittan, Sige-Scyldinga; nymeð nyd-bade, nænegum arað leode Deniga, ac he on lust wigeð, swefeð ond sendeþ, secce ne weneþ to Gar-Denum.

text: Ac ic him Gēata sceal eafoð ond ellen ungēara nū gūþe gebēodan.
text_bare: Ac ic him Geata sceal eafoð ond ellen ungeara nu guþe gebeodan.

text: Gǣþ eft sē þe mōt tō medo mōdig, siþþan morgen-lēoht ofer ylda bearn oþres dōgores, sunne swegl-wered, sūþan scīneð.” Þā wæs on sālum sinces brytta, gamol-feax ond gūð-rōf; gēoce gelȳfde brego Beorht-Dena; gehȳrde on Bēowulfe folces hyrde fæst-rǣdne geþōht.
text_bare: Gæþ eft se þe mot to medo modig, siþþan morgen-leoht ofer ylda bearn oþres dogores, sunne swegl-wered, suþan scineð.” Þa wæs on salum sinces brytta, gamol-feax ond guð-rof; geoce gelyfde brego Beorht-Dena; gehyrde on Beowulfe folces hyrde fæst-rædne geþoht.

text: Ðǣr wæs hæleþa hleahtor, hlyn swynsode, word wǣron wynsume.
text_bare: Ðær wæs hæleþa hleahtor, hlyn swynsode, word wæron wynsume.

text: Ēode Wealhþēow forð, cwēn Hrōðgāres, cynna gemyndig, grētte gold-hroden guman on healle; ond þā frēolic wīf ful gesealde ǣrest Ēast-Dena ēþel-wearde, bæd hine blīðne æt þǣre bēor-þege, lēodum lēofne; hē on lust geþeah symbel ond sele-ful, sige-rōf kyning.
text_bare: Eode Wealhþeow forð, cwen Hroðgares, cynna gemyndig, grette gold-hroden guman on healle; ond þa freolic wif ful gesealde ærest East-Dena eþel-wearde, bæd hine bliðne æt þære beor-þege, leodum leofne; he on lust geþeah symbel ond sele-ful, sige-rof kyning.

text: Ymb-ēode þa ides Helminga duguþe ond geogoþe dǣl ǣghwylcne, sinc-fato sealde, oþ þæt sǣl ālamp, þæt hīo Bēowulfe, bēag-hroden cwēn, mōde geþungen, medo-ful ætbær; grētte Gēata lēod, Gode þancode wīs-fæst wordum, þæs ðe hire se willa gelamp, þæt hēo on ǣnigne eorl gelȳfde fyrena frōfre.
text_bare: Ymb-eode þa ides Helminga duguþe ond geogoþe dæl æghwylcne, sinc-fato sealde, oþ þæt sæl alamp, þæt hio Beowulfe, beag-hroden cwen, mode geþungen, medo-ful ætbær; grette Geata leod, Gode þancode wis-fæst wordum, þæs ðe hire se willa gelamp, þæt heo on ænigne eorl gelyfde fyrena frofre.

text: He þæt ful geþeah, wæl-rēow wiga, æt Wealhþēon, ond þā gyddode gūþe gefȳsed; Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Eegþēowes: “Ic þæt hogode, þā ic on holm gestāh, sǣ-bāt gesæt mid mīnra secga gedriht, þæt ic ānunga ēowra lēoda willan geworhte, oþðe on wæl crunge fēond-grāpum fæst.
text_bare: He þæt ful geþeah, wæl-reow wiga, æt Wealhþeon, ond þa gyddode guþe gefysed; Beowulf maþelode, bearn Eegþeowes: “Ic þæt hogode, þa ic on holm gestah, sæ-bat gesæt mid minra secga gedriht, þæt ic anunga eowra leoda willan geworhte, oþðe on wæl crunge feond-grapum fæst.

text: Ic gefremman sceal eorlīc ellen, oþðe ende-dæg on þisse meodu-healle mīnne gebīdan.” Ðām wīfe þā word wel līcodon, gilp-cwide Gēates; ēode gold-hroden frēolicu folc-cwēn tō hire frēan sittan.
text_bare: Ic gefremman sceal eorlic ellen, oþðe ende-dæg on þisse meodu-healle minne gebidan.” Ðam wife þa word wel licodon, gilp-cwide Geates; eode gold-hroden freolicu folc-cwen to hire frean sittan.

text: Þā wæs eft swā ǣr inne on healle þrȳð-word sprecen, ðēod on sǣlum, sige-folca swēg, oþ þæt semninga sunu Healfdenes sēcean wolde ǣfen-ræste; wiste þǣm āhlǣcan tō þǣm hēah-sele hilde geþinged, siððan hīe sunnan lēoht gesēon ne meahton, oþðe nīpende niht ofer ealle, scadu-helma gesceapu scrīðan cwōman, wan under wolcnum.
text_bare: Þa wæs eft swa ær inne on healle þryð-word sprecen, ðeod on sælum, sige-folca sweg, oþ þæt semninga sunu Healfdenes secean wolde æfen-ræste; wiste þæm ahlæcan to þæm heah-sele hilde geþinged, siððan hie sunnan leoht geseon ne meahton, oþðe nipende niht ofer ealle, scadu-helma gesceapu scriðan cwoman, wan under wolcnum.

text: Werod eall ārās; grētte þā guma ōþerne, Hrōðgār Bēowulf, ond him hǣl ābēad, wīn-ærnes geweald, ond þæt word ācwæð: “Nǣfre ic ǣnegum men ǣr ālȳfde, siþðan ic hond ond rond hebban mihte, ðrȳþ-ærn Dena būton þē nū ðā.
text_bare: Werod eall aras; grette þa guma oþerne, Hroðgar Beowulf, ond him hæl abead, win-ærnes geweald, ond þæt word acwæð: “Næfre ic ænegum men ær alyfde, siþðan ic hond ond rond hebban mihte, ðryþ-ærn Dena buton þe nu ða.

text: Hafa nū ond geheald hūsa sēlest, gemyne mǣrþo, mægen-ellen cȳð, waca wið wrāþum.
text_bare: Hafa nu ond geheald husa selest, gemyne mærþo, mægen-ellen cyð, waca wið wraþum.

text: Ne bið þē wilna gād, gif þū þæt ellen-weorc aldre gedīgest.”
text_bare: Ne bið þe wilna gad, gif þu þæt ellen-weorc aldre gedigest.”

text: Ða him Hrōðgār gewāt mid his hæleþa gedryht, eodur Scyldinga, ūt of healle; wolde wīg-fruma Wealhþēo sēcan, cwēn tō gebeddan.
text_bare: Ða him Hroðgar gewat mid his hæleþa gedryht, eodur Scyldinga, ut of healle; wolde wig-fruma Wealhþeo secan, cwen to gebeddan.

text: Hæfde kyninga wuldor Grendle tō-gēanes, swā guman gefrungon, sele-weard āseted; sundor-nytte behēold ymb aldor Dena, eoton-weard ābēad.
text_bare: Hæfde kyninga wuldor Grendle to-geanes, swa guman gefrungon, sele-weard aseted; sundor-nytte beheold ymb aldor Dena, eoton-weard abead.

text: Hūru Gēata lēod georne trūwode mōdgan mægnes, Metodes hyldo.
text_bare: Huru Geata leod georne truwode modgan mægnes, Metodes hyldo.

text: Ðā hē him of dyde īsern-byrnan, helm of hafelan, sealde his hyrsted sweord, īrena cyst, ombiht-þegne, ond gehealdan hēt hilde-geātwe.
text_bare: Ða he him of dyde isern-byrnan, helm of hafelan, sealde his hyrsted sweord, irena cyst, ombiht-þegne, ond gehealdan het hilde-geatwe.

text: Gesprsec þā se gōda gylp-worda sum, Bēowulf Gēata, ǣr hē on bed stige: “Nō ic mē an here-wǣsmun hnāgran talige gūþ-geweorca þonne Grendel hine; forþan ic hine sweorde swebban nelle, aldre benēotan, þēah ic eal mæge.
text_bare: Gesprsec þa se goda gylp-worda sum, Beowulf Geata, ær he on bed stige: “No ic me an here-wæsmun hnagran talige guþ-geweorca þonne Grendel hine; forþan ic hine sweorde swebban nelle, aldre beneotan, þeah ic eal mæge.

text: Nāt hē þāra gōda, þæt hēe mē ongēan slēa, rand gehēawe, þēah ðe hē rōf sīe nīþ-geweorca; ac wit on niht sculon secge ofersittan, gif hē gesēcean dear wīg ofer wǣpen, ond siþðan wītig God on swā hwæþere hond, hālig Dryhten, mǣrðo dēme, swā him gemet þince.” Hylde hine þā heaþo-dēor, hlēor-bolster onfēng eorles andwlitan, ond hine ymb monig snellīc sǣ-rinc sele-reste gebēah.
text_bare: Nat he þara goda, þæt hee me ongean slea, rand geheawe, þeah ðe he rof sie niþ-geweorca; ac wit on niht sculon secge ofersittan, gif he gesecean dear wig ofer wæpen, ond siþðan witig God on swa hwæþere hond, halig Dryhten, mærðo deme, swa him gemet þince.” Hylde hine þa heaþo-deor, hleor-bolster onfeng eorles andwlitan, ond hine ymb monig snellic sæ-rinc sele-reste gebeah.

text: Nǣnig heora þōhte, þæt hē þanon scolde eft eard-lufan ǣfre gesēcean, folc oþðe frēo-burh, þǣr hē āfēded wæs: ac hīe hæfdon gefrūnen, þǣt hīe ǣr tō fela micles in þǣm wīn-sele wǣl-dēað fornam, Denigea lēode.
text_bare: Nænig heora þohte, þæt he þanon scolde eft eard-lufan æfre gesecean, folc oþðe freo-burh, þær he afeded wæs: ac hie hæfdon gefrunen, þæt hie ær to fela micles in þæm win-sele wæl-deað fornam, Denigea leode.

text: Ac him Dryhten forgeaf wīg-spēda gewiofu, Wedera lēodum frōfor ond fultum, þæt hīe fēond heora ðurh ānes cræft ealle ofercōmon, selfes mihtum; sōð is gecȳþed, þæt mihtig God manna cynnes wēold wīde-ferhð.
text_bare: Ac him Dryhten forgeaf wig-speda gewiofu, Wedera leodum frofor ond fultum, þæt hie feond heora ðurh anes cræft ealle ofercomon, selfes mihtum; soð is gecyþed, þæt mihtig God manna cynnes weold wide-ferhð.

text: Cōm on wanre niht scrīðan sceadu-genga.
text_bare: Com on wanre niht scriðan sceadu-genga.

text: Scēotend swǣfon, þā þæt horn-reced healdan scoldon, ealle būton ānum.
text_bare: Sceotend swæfon, þa þæt horn-reced healdan scoldon, ealle buton anum.

text: Þæt wæs yldum cūþ, þæt hīe ne mōste, þā metod nolde, se syn-scaþa under sceadu bregdan; ac hē wæccende wrāþum on andan bād bolgen-mōd beadwa geþinges.
text_bare: Þæt wæs yldum cuþ, þæt hie ne moste, þa metod nolde, se syn-scaþa under sceadu bregdan; ac he wæccende wraþum on andan bad bolgen-mod beadwa geþinges.

text: Ðā cōm of mōre under mist-hleoþum Grendel gongan, Godes yrre bær; mynte se mān-scaða manna cynnes sumne besyrwan in sele þām hēan.
text_bare: Ða com of more under mist-hleoþum Grendel gongan, Godes yrre bær; mynte se man-scaða manna cynnes sumne besyrwan in sele þam hean.

text: Wōd under wolcnum, tō þæs þe hē wīn-reced, gold-sele gumena, gearwost wisse, fǣttum fāhne; ne wæs þæt forma sīð, þæt hē Hrōþgāres hām gesōhte.
text_bare: Wod under wolcnum, to þæs þe he win-reced, gold-sele gumena, gearwost wisse, fættum fahne; ne wæs þæt forma sið, þæt he Hroþgares ham gesohte.

text: Nǣfre hē on aldor-dagum ǣr ne siþðan heardran hæle, heal-ðegnas fand.
text_bare: Næfre he on aldor-dagum ær ne siþðan heardran hæle, heal-ðegnas fand.

text: Cōm þā tō recede rinc siðian drēamum bedǣled; duru sōna onarn, fȳr-bendum fæst, syþðan hē hire folmum hrān; onbrǣd þā bealo-hȳdig, ðā hē gebolgen wæs, recedes mūþan.
text_bare: Com þa to recede rinc siðian dreamum bedæled; duru sona onarn, fyr-bendum fæst, syþðan he hire folmum hran; onbræd þa bealo-hydig, ða he gebolgen wæs, recedes muþan.

text: Raþe æfter þon on fāgne flōr fēond treddode, ēode yrre-mōd; him of ēagum stōd ligge gelīcost lēoht unfæger.
text_bare: Raþe æfter þon on fagne flor feond treddode, eode yrre-mod; him of eagum stod ligge gelicost leoht unfæger.

text: Geseah hē in recede rinca manige, swefan sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere, mago-rinca hēap.
text_bare: Geseah he in recede rinca manige, swefan sibbe-gedriht samod ætgædere, mago-rinca heap.

text: Þā his mōd āhlōg; mynte þæt hē gedǣlde, ǣ þon dæg cwōme, atol āglǣca, ānra gehwylces līf wið līce, þā him ālumpen wæs wist-fylle wēn.
text_bare: Þa his mod ahlog; mynte þæt he gedælde, æ þon dæg cwome, atol aglæca, anra gehwylces lif wið lice, þa him alumpen wæs wist-fylle wen.

text: Ne wæs þæt wyrd þā gēn, þæt hē mā mōste manna cynnes ðicgean ofer þā niht.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt wyrd þa gen, þæt he ma moste manna cynnes ðicgean ofer þa niht.

text: Þrȳð-swȳð behēold mǣg Higelāces, hū se mān-scaða under fǣr-gripum gefaran wolde.
text_bare: Þryð-swyð beheold mæg Higelaces, hu se man-scaða under fær-gripum gefaran wolde.

text: Ne þæt se āglǣca yldan þōhte, ac he gefēng hraðe forman sīðe slǣpendne rinc, slāt unwearnum, bāt bān-locan, blōd ēdrum dranc, syn-snǣdum swealh; sōna hæfde unlyfigendes eal gefeormod, fēt ond folma.
text_bare: Ne þæt se aglæca yldan þohte, ac he gefeng hraðe forman siðe slæpendne rinc, slat unwearnum, bat ban-locan, blod edrum dranc, syn-snædum swealh; sona hæfde unlyfigendes eal gefeormod, fet ond folma.

text: Forð nēar ætstōp, nam þā mid handa hige-þihtigne rinc on ræste; rǣhte ongēan fēond mid folme; hē onfēng hraþe inwit-þancum ond wið earm gesæt.
text_bare: Forð near ætstop, nam þa mid handa hige-þihtigne rinc on ræste; ræhte ongean feond mid folme; he onfeng hraþe inwit-þancum ond wið earm gesæt.

text: Sōna þæt onfunde fyrena hyrde, þæt hē ne mētte middan-geardes, eorþan sceatta, on elran men mund-gripe māran; hē on mōde wearð forht, on ferhðe; nō þȳ ǣr fram meahte.
text_bare: Sona þæt onfunde fyrena hyrde, þæt he ne mette middan-geardes, eorþan sceatta, on elran men mund-gripe maran; he on mode wearð forht, on ferhðe; no þy ær fram meahte.

text: Hyge wæs him hin-fūs, wolde on heolster flēon, sēcan dēofla gedræg; ne wæs his drohtoð þǣr, swylce hē on ealder-dagum ǣr gemētte.
text_bare: Hyge wæs him hin-fus, wolde on heolster fleon, secan deofla gedræg; ne wæs his drohtoð þær, swylce he on ealder-dagum ær gemette.

text: Gemunde þā se gōda mǣg Higelāces ǣfen-sprǣce, up-lang āstōd ond him fæste wiðfēng; fingras burston; eoten wæs ūt-weard; eorl furþur stōp.
text_bare: Gemunde þa se goda mæg Higelaces æfen-spræce, up-lang astod ond him fæste wiðfeng; fingras burston; eoten wæs ut-weard; eorl furþur stop.

text: Mynte se mǣra, hwǣr hē meahte swā, wīdre gewindan ond on weg þanon flēon on fen-hopu; wiste his fingra geweald on grames grāpum.
text_bare: Mynte se mæra, hwær he meahte swa, widre gewindan ond on weg þanon fleon on fen-hopu; wiste his fingra geweald on grames grapum.

text: Þæt hē wæs gēocor sīð, þæt se hearm-scaþa tō Heorute ātēah.
text_bare: Þæt he wæs geocor sið, þæt se hearm-scaþa to Heorute ateah.

text: Dryht-sele dynede; Denum eallum wearð, ceaster-būendum, cēnra gehwylcum, eorlum ealu-scerwen.
text_bare: Dryht-sele dynede; Denum eallum wearð, ceaster-buendum, cenra gehwylcum, eorlum ealu-scerwen.

text: Yrre wǣron begen rēþe rēn-weardas.
text_bare: Yrre wæron begen reþe ren-weardas.

text: Reced hlynsode; þā wæs wundor micel, þæt se wīn-sele wiðhæfde heaþo-dēorum, þæt hē on hrūsan ne fēol, fæger fold-bold; ac hē þæs fæste wæs innan ond ūtan īren-bendum searo-þoncum besmiþod.
text_bare: Reced hlynsode; þa wæs wundor micel, þæt se win-sele wiðhæfde heaþo-deorum, þæt he on hrusan ne feol, fæger fold-bold; ac he þæs fæste wæs innan ond utan iren-bendum searo-þoncum besmiþod.

text: Þær fram sylle ābēag medu-benc monig, mīne gefrǣge, golde geregnad, þǣr þā graman wunnon; þæs ne wēndon ǣr witan Scyldinga, þæt hit ā mid gemete manna ǣnig, betlīc ond bān-fāg, tōbrecan meahte, listum tōlūcan, nymþe līges fæþm swulge on swaþule.
text_bare: Þær fram sylle abeag medu-benc monig, mine gefræge, golde geregnad, þær þa graman wunnon; þæs ne wendon ær witan Scyldinga, þæt hit a mid gemete manna ænig, betlic ond ban-fag, tobrecan meahte, listum tolucan, nymþe liges fæþm swulge on swaþule.

text: Swēg ūp āstāg nīwe geneahhe; Norð-Denum stōd atelīc egesa, ānra gehwylcum, þāra þe of wealle wōp gehȳrdon, gryre-lēoð galan godes ondsacan, sige-lēasne sang, sār wānigean helle hæfton.
text_bare: Sweg up astag niwe geneahhe; Norð-Denum stod atelic egesa, anra gehwylcum, þara þe of wealle wop gehyrdon, gryre-leoð galan godes ondsacan, sige-leasne sang, sar wanigean helle hæfton.

text: Hēold hine fæste, sē þe manna wæs mægene strengest on þǣem dæge þysses līfes.
text_bare: Heold hine fæste, se þe manna wæs mægene strengest on þæem dæge þysses lifes.

text: Nolde eorla hlēo ǣnige þinga þone cwealm-cuman cwicne forlǣtan, ne his līf-dagas lēoda ǣnigum nytte tealde.
text_bare: Nolde eorla hleo ænige þinga þone cwealm-cuman cwicne forlætan, ne his lif-dagas leoda ænigum nytte tealde.

text: Þær genehost brægd eorl Bēowulfes ealde lāfe, wolde frēa-drihtnes feorh ealgian, mǣres þēodnes, ðǣr hīe meahton swā.
text_bare: Þær genehost brægd eorl Beowulfes ealde lafe, wolde frea-drihtnes feorh ealgian, mæres þeodnes, ðær hie meahton swa.

text: Hīe þæt ne wiston, þā hīe gewin drugon, heard-hicgende hilde-mecgas, ond on healfa gehwone hēawan þōhton, sāwle sēcan: þone syn-scaðan ǣnig ofer eorþan īrenna cyst, gūð-billa nān, grētan nolde; ac hē sige-wǣpnum forsworen hæfde, ecga gehwylcre.
text_bare: Hie þæt ne wiston, þa hie gewin drugon, heard-hicgende hilde-mecgas, ond on healfa gehwone heawan þohton, sawle secan: þone syn-scaðan ænig ofer eorþan irenna cyst, guð-billa nan, gretan nolde; ac he sige-wæpnum forsworen hæfde, ecga gehwylcre.

text: Scolde his aldor-gedāl on ðǣm dæge þysses līfes earmlīc wurðan, ond se ellor-gāst on fēonda geweald feor sīðian.
text_bare: Scolde his aldor-gedal on ðæm dæge þysses lifes earmlic wurðan, ond se ellor-gast on feonda geweald feor siðian.

text: Ðā þæt onfunde, sē þe fela ǣror mōdes myrðe manna cynne fyrene gefremede, hē fāg wið God, þæt him se līc-homa lǣstan nolde, ac hine se mōdega mǣg Hygelāces hæfde be honda; wæs gehwæþer ōðrum lifigende lāð.
text_bare: Ða þæt onfunde, se þe fela æror modes myrðe manna cynne fyrene gefremede, he fag wið God, þæt him se lic-homa læstan nolde, ac hine se modega mæg Hygelaces hæfde be honda; wæs gehwæþer oðrum lifigende lað.

text: Līc-sār gebād atol ǣglǣca; him on eaxle wearð syn-dolh sweotol; seonowe onsprungon, burston bān-locan.
text_bare: Lic-sar gebad atol æglæca; him on eaxle wearð syn-dolh sweotol; seonowe onsprungon, burston ban-locan.

text: Bēowulfe wearð gūð-hrēð gyfeþe; scolde Grendel þonan feorh-sēoc flēon under fen-hleoðu, }} sēcean wyn-lēas wīc; wiste þē geornor, þæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dōgera dæg-rīm.
text_bare: Beowulfe wearð guð-hreð gyfeþe; scolde Grendel þonan feorh-seoc fleon under fen-hleoðu, }} secean wyn-leas wic; wiste þe geornor, þæt his aldres wæs ende gegongen, dogera dæg-rim.

text: Denum eallum wearð æfter þām wæl-rǣse willa gelumpen.
text_bare: Denum eallum wearð æfter þam wæl-ræse willa gelumpen.

text: Hæfde þā gefǣlsod, sē þe iǣr feorran cōm, snotor ond swȳð-ferhð sele Hrōðgāres, genered wið nīðe; niht-weorce gefeh, ellen-mǣrþum.
text_bare: Hæfde þa gefælsod, se þe iær feorran com, snotor ond swyð-ferhð sele Hroðgares, genered wið niðe; niht-weorce gefeh, ellen-mærþum.

text: Hæfde East-Denum Gēat-mecga lēod gilp gelǣsted, swylce oncȳþðe ealle gebētte, inwid-sorge, þe hīe ǣr drugon ond for þrēa-nȳdum þolian scoldon, torn unlȳtel.
text_bare: Hæfde East-Denum Geat-mecga leod gilp gelæsted, swylce oncyþðe ealle gebette, inwid-sorge, þe hie ær drugon ond for þrea-nydum þolian scoldon, torn unlytel.

text: Þæt wæs tācen sweotol, syþðan hilde-dēor hond ālegde, earm ond eaxle þǣr wæs eal geador Grendles grāpe under gēapne hrōf.
text_bare: Þæt wæs tacen sweotol, syþðan hilde-deor hond alegde, earm ond eaxle þær wæs eal geador Grendles grape under geapne hrof.

text: Ðā wæs on morgen, mīne gefrǣge, ymb þā gif-healle gūð-rinc monig; fērdon folc-togan feorran ond nēan geond wīd-wegas wundor scēawian, lāþes lāstas.
text_bare: Ða wæs on morgen, mine gefræge, ymb þa gif-healle guð-rinc monig; ferdon folc-togan feorran ond nean geond wid-wegas wundor sceawian, laþes lastas.

text: Nō his līf-gedāl sārlīc þūhte secga ǣnegum, þāra þe tīr-lēases trode scēawode, hū hē wērig-mōd on weg þanon, nīða ofercumen on nicera mere, fǣge ond geflȳmed, feorh-lāstas bær.
text_bare: No his lif-gedal sarlic þuhte secga ænegum, þara þe tir-leases trode sceawode, hu he werig-mod on weg þanon, niða ofercumen on nicera mere, fæge ond geflymed, feorh-lastas bær.

text: Ðǣr wæs on blōde brim weallende, atol ȳða geswing eal gemenged hāton heolfre, heoro-drēore, wēol; dēað-fǣge dēog, siððan drēama lēas in fen-freoðo feorh ālegde, hǣþene sāwle; þǣr him hel onfēng.
text_bare: Ðær wæs on blode brim weallende, atol yða geswing eal gemenged haton heolfre, heoro-dreore, weol; deað-fæge deog, siððan dreama leas in fen-freoðo feorh alegde, hæþene sawle; þær him hel onfeng.

text: Þanon eft gewiton eald-gesīðas, swylce geong manig of gomen-wāþe, fram mere mōdge mēarum rīdan, beornas on blancum.
text_bare: Þanon eft gewiton eald-gesiðas, swylce geong manig of gomen-waþe, fram mere modge mearum ridan, beornas on blancum.

text: Ðǣr wæs Bēowulfes mǣrðo mǣned; monig oft gecwæð, þætte sūð ne norð be sǣm twēonum ofer eormen-grund ōþer nǣnig under swegles begong sēlra nǣre rond-hæbbendra, rīces wyrðra.
text_bare: Ðær wæs Beowulfes mærðo mæned; monig oft gecwæð, þætte suð ne norð be sæm tweonum ofer eormen-grund oþer nænig under swegles begong selra nære rond-hæbbendra, rices wyrðra.

text: Ne hīe hūru wine-drihten wiht ne lōgon, glædne Hrōðgār, ac þǣt wæs gōd cyning.
text_bare: Ne hie huru wine-drihten wiht ne logon, glædne Hroðgar, ac þæt wæs god cyning.

text: Hwīlum heaþo-rōfe hlēapan lēton, on geflit faran, fealwe mēaras, ðǣr him fold-wegas fægere þūhton, cystum cūðe.
text_bare: Hwilum heaþo-rofe hleapan leton, on geflit faran, fealwe mearas, ðær him fold-wegas fægere þuhton, cystum cuðe.

text: Hwīlum cyninges þegn, guma gilp-hlæden, gidda gemyndig, sē ðe eal-fela eald-gesegena worn gemunde, word ōþer fand sōðe gebunden.
text_bare: Hwilum cyninges þegn, guma gilp-hlæden, gidda gemyndig, se ðe eal-fela eald-gesegena worn gemunde, word oþer fand soðe gebunden.

text: Secg eft ongan sīð Bēowulfes snyttrum styrian, ond on spēd wrecan spel gerāde, wordum wrixlan; wel-hwylc gecwæð, þæt hē fram Sigemundes secgan hȳrde ellen-dǣdum, imcūþes fela, Wælsinges gewin, wīde sīðas, þāra þe gumena bearn gearwe ne wiston, fǣhðe ond fyrena, būton Fitela mid hine, þonne hē swulces hwæt secgan wolde ēam his nefan, swā hie ā wǣron æt nīða gehwām nȳd-gesteallan; hæfdon eal-fela eotena cynnes sweordum gesǣged.
text_bare: Secg eft ongan sið Beowulfes snyttrum styrian, ond on sped wrecan spel gerade, wordum wrixlan; wel-hwylc gecwæð, þæt he fram Sigemundes secgan hyrde ellen-dædum, imcuþes fela, Wælsinges gewin, wide siðas, þara þe gumena bearn gearwe ne wiston, fæhðe ond fyrena, buton Fitela mid hine, þonne he swulces hwæt secgan wolde eam his nefan, swa hie a wæron æt niða gehwam nyd-gesteallan; hæfdon eal-fela eotena cynnes sweordum gesæged.

text: Sigemunde gesprong æfter dēað-dæge dōm unlȳtel, syþðan wīges heard wyrm ācwealde, hordes hyrde; hē under hārne stān, æþelinges bearn, āna genēðde frēcne dǣde; ne wæs him Fitela mid; hwæþre him gesǣlde, ðæt þæt swurd þurhwōd wrætlīcne wyrm, þæt hit on wealle ætstōd, dryhtlīc īren; draca morðre swealt.
text_bare: Sigemunde gesprong æfter deað-dæge dom unlytel, syþðan wiges heard wyrm acwealde, hordes hyrde; he under harne stan, æþelinges bearn, ana geneðde frecne dæde; ne wæs him Fitela mid; hwæþre him gesælde, ðæt þæt swurd þurhwod wrætlicne wyrm, þæt hit on wealle ætstod, dryhtlic iren; draca morðre swealt.

text: Hæfde āglǣca elne gegongen, þæt hē bēah-hordes brūcan mōste selfes dōme; sǣ-bāt gehlēod, bær on bearm scipes beorhte frætwa Wælses eafera; wyrm hāt gemealt.
text_bare: Hæfde aglæca elne gegongen, þæt he beah-hordes brucan moste selfes dome; sæ-bat gehleod, bær on bearm scipes beorhte frætwa Wælses eafera; wyrm hat gemealt.

text: Sē wæs wreccena wīde mǣrost ofer wer-þēode, wīgendra hlēo, ellen-dǣdum; hē þæs ǣr onðāh.
text_bare: Se wæs wreccena wide mærost ofer wer-þeode, wigendra hleo, ellen-dædum; he þæs ær onðah.

text: Siððan Heremōdes hild sweðrode, eafoð ond ellen; hē mid eotenum wearð on fēonda geweald forð forlācen, snūde forsended.
text_bare: Siððan Heremodes hild sweðrode, eafoð ond ellen; he mid eotenum wearð on feonda geweald forð forlacen, snude forsended.

text: Hine sorh-wylmas lemede tō lange; hē his lēodum wearð, eallum æþelingnm, to aldor-ceare.
text_bare: Hine sorh-wylmas lemede to lange; he his leodum wearð, eallum æþelingnm, to aldor-ceare.

text: Swylce oft bemearn ǣrran mǣlum swið-ferhþes sīð snotor ceorl monig, sē þe him bealwa tō bōte gelȳfde, þæt þæt ðēodnes bearn geþēon scolde, fæder æþelum onfōn, folc gehealdan, hord ond hlēo-burh, hæleþa rīce, ēðel Scyldinga.
text_bare: Swylce oft bemearn ærran mælum swið-ferhþes sið snotor ceorl monig, se þe him bealwa to bote gelyfde, þæt þæt ðeodnes bearn geþeon scolde, fæder æþelum onfon, folc gehealdan, hord ond hleo-burh, hæleþa rice, eðel Scyldinga.

text: Hē þǣr eallum wearð, mǣg Higelāces manna cynne, frēondum gefægra; hine fyren onwōd.
text_bare: He þær eallum wearð, mæg Higelaces manna cynne, freondum gefægra; hine fyren onwod.

text: Hwīlum flītende fealwe strǣte mēarum mǣton.
text_bare: Hwilum flitende fealwe stræte mearum mæton.

text: Ðā wæs morgen-lēoht scofen ond scynded.
text_bare: Ða wæs morgen-leoht scofen ond scynded.

text: Eode scealc monig switð-hicgende tō sele þām hēan searo-wundor sēon; swylce self cyning of brȳd-būre, bēah-horda weard, tryddode tīr-fæst getrume micle, cystum gecȳþed, ond his cwēn mid him medo-stīg gemæt mægþa hōse.
text_bare: Eode scealc monig switð-hicgende to sele þam hean searo-wundor seon; swylce self cyning of bryd-bure, beah-horda weard, tryddode tir-fæst getrume micle, cystum gecyþed, ond his cwen mid him medo-stig gemæt mægþa hose.

text: Hrōðgār maþelode; hē tō healle gēong, stōd on stapole, geseah stēapne hrōf golde fāhne ond Grendles hond: “Ðisse ansȳne Al-wealdan þanc lungre gelimpe.
text_bare: Hroðgar maþelode; he to healle geong, stod on stapole, geseah steapne hrof golde fahne ond Grendles hond: “Ðisse ansyne Al-wealdan þanc lungre gelimpe.

text: Fela ic lāþes gebād, grynna æt Grendle; ā mæg God wyrcan wunder æfter wundre, wuldres Hyrde.
text_bare: Fela ic laþes gebad, grynna æt Grendle; a mæg God wyrcan wunder æfter wundre, wuldres Hyrde.

text: Ðæt wæs ungēara, þæt ic ǣnigra mē wēana ne wēnde tō wīdan fēore bōte gebīdan, þonne blōde fāb, hūsa sēlest heoro-drēorig stōd; wēa wīd-scofen witena gebwylcne, ðāra þe ne wēndon, þæt hīe wīde-ferhð lēoda land-geweorc lāþum beweredon scuccum ond scinnum.
text_bare: Ðæt wæs ungeara, þæt ic ænigra me weana ne wende to widan feore bote gebidan, þonne blode fab, husa selest heoro-dreorig stod; wea wid-scofen witena gebwylcne, ðara þe ne wendon, þæt hie wide-ferhð leoda land-geweorc laþum beweredon scuccum ond scinnum.

text: Nū scealc hafað þurb Drihtnes miht dǣd gefremede, ðe wē ealle ǣr ne meabton snyttrum besyrwan, Hwæt!
text_bare: Nu scealc hafað þurb Drihtnes miht dæd gefremede, ðe we ealle ær ne meabton snyttrum besyrwan, Hwæt!

text: þæt secgan mæg efne swā hwylc mægþa, swā ðone magan cende æfter gum-cynnum, gyf hēo gyt lyfað, þæt hyre eald Metod ēste wǣre bearn-gebyrdo.
text_bare: þæt secgan mæg efne swa hwylc mægþa, swa ðone magan cende æfter gum-cynnum, gyf heo gyt lyfað, þæt hyre eald Metod este wære bearn-gebyrdo.

text: Nū ic, Bēowulf, þec, secg betsta, mē for sunu wylle frēogan on ferhþe; heald forð tela nīwe sibbe.
text_bare: Nu ic, Beowulf, þec, secg betsta, me for sunu wylle freogan on ferhþe; heald forð tela niwe sibbe.

text: Ne bið þē nǣnigra gād worolde wilna, þe ic geweald hæbbe.
text_bare: Ne bið þe nænigra gad worolde wilna, þe ic geweald hæbbe.

text: Ful oft ic for lǣssan lēan teohhode, hord-weorþunge, hnāhran rince, sǣmran æt sæcce.
text_bare: Ful oft ic for læssan lean teohhode, hord-weorþunge, hnahran rince, sæmran æt sæcce.

text: Þū þē self hafast dǣdum gefremed, þæt þīn dom lyfað āwa tō aldre.
text_bare: Þu þe self hafast dædum gefremed, þæt þin dom lyfað awa to aldre.

text: Al-walda þec gōde forgylde, swā hē nū gyt dyde!” Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: “Wē þæt ellen-weorc ēstum miclum, feohtan fremedon, frēcne genēðdon eafoð uncūþes; ūþe ic swīþor, þæt ðū hine selfne gesēon mōste, fēond on frætewum fyl-wērigne.
text_bare: Al-walda þec gode forgylde, swa he nu gyt dyde!” Beowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: “We þæt ellen-weorc estum miclum, feohtan fremedon, frecne geneðdon eafoð uncuþes; uþe ic swiþor, þæt ðu hine selfne geseon moste, feond on frætewum fyl-werigne.

text: Ic hine hrædlīce heardan clammum on wæl-bedde wrīþan þōhte, þæt hē for mund-gripe mīnum scolde licgean līf-bysig, būtan his līc swice; ic hine ne mihte, þā Metod nolde, ganges getwǣman; nō ic him þæs georne astfealh, feorh-geniðlan; wæs tō fore-mihtig fēond on fēþe.
text_bare: Ic hine hrædlice heardan clammum on wæl-bedde wriþan þohte, þæt he for mund-gripe minum scolde licgean lif-bysig, butan his lic swice; ic hine ne mihte, þa Metod nolde, ganges getwæman; no ic him þæs georne astfealh, feorh-geniðlan; wæs to fore-mihtig feond on feþe.

text: Hwæþere hē his folme forlēt tō līf-wraþe lāst weardian, earm ond eaxle; nō þǣr ǣnige swā þēah fēa-sceaft guma frōfre gebohte; nō þȳ leng leofað lāð-getēona synnum geswenced; ac hyne sār hafað in nȳd-gripe nearwe befongen, balwon bendum; ðǣr ābīdan sceal maga māne fāh miclan dōmes, hū him scīr Metod scrīfan wille.” Ðā wæs swīgra secg sunu Ecglāfes on gylp-sprǣce gūð-geweorca, siþðan æþelingas eorles cræfte ofer hēanne hrōf hand scēawedon, fēondes fingras, foran ǣghwylc; wæs steda nægla gehwylc stȳle gelīcost, hǣþenes hand-sporu, hilde-rinces egl unhēoru; ǣghwylc gecwæð, þæt him heardra nān hrīnan wolde īren ǣr-gōd, þæt ðæs āhlǣcan blōdge beadu-folme onberan wolde.
text_bare: Hwæþere he his folme forlet to lif-wraþe last weardian, earm ond eaxle; no þær ænige swa þeah fea-sceaft guma frofre gebohte; no þy leng leofað lað-geteona synnum geswenced; ac hyne sar hafað in nyd-gripe nearwe befongen, balwon bendum; ðær abidan sceal maga mane fah miclan domes, hu him scir Metod scrifan wille.” Ða wæs swigra secg sunu Ecglafes on gylp-spræce guð-geweorca, siþðan æþelingas eorles cræfte ofer heanne hrof hand sceawedon, feondes fingras, foran æghwylc; wæs steda nægla gehwylc style gelicost, hæþenes hand-sporu, hilde-rinces egl unheoru; æghwylc gecwæð, þæt him heardra nan hrinan wolde iren ær-god, þæt ðæs ahlæcan blodge beadu-folme onberan wolde.

text: Ðā wæs hāten hreþe Heort innan-weard folmum gefrætwod; fela þǣra wæs wera ond wīfa, þe þæt wīn-reced, gest-sele, gyredon.
text_bare: Ða wæs haten hreþe Heort innan-weard folmum gefrætwod; fela þæra wæs wera ond wifa, þe þæt win-reced, gest-sele, gyredon.

text: Gold-fāg scinon web æfter wāgum, wundor-sīona fela secga gehwylcum, þāra þe on swylc starað.
text_bare: Gold-fag scinon web æfter wagum, wundor-siona fela secga gehwylcum, þara þe on swylc starað.

text: Wæs þæt beorhte bold tōbrocen swīðe, eal inne-weard īren-bendum fæst, heorras tōhlidene; hrōf āna genæs ealles ansund, þā se āglǣca fyren-dǣdum fāg on flēam gewand, aldres orwēna.
text_bare: Wæs þæt beorhte bold tobrocen swiðe, eal inne-weard iren-bendum fæst, heorras tohlidene; hrof ana genæs ealles ansund, þa se aglæca fyren-dædum fag on fleam gewand, aldres orwena.

text: Nō þæt ȳðe byð tō beflēonne, fremme sē þe wille; ac gesacan sceal sāwl-berendra, nȳde genȳdde, niþða bearna, grund-būendra, gearwe stōwe, þǣr his līc-homa leger-bedde fæst swefeþ æfter symle.
text_bare: No þæt yðe byð to befleonne, fremme se þe wille; ac gesacan sceal sawl-berendra, nyde genydde, niþða bearna, grund-buendra, gearwe stowe, þær his lic-homa leger-bedde fæst swefeþ æfter symle.

text: Þā wæs sǣl ond mǣl, þæt tō healle gang Healfdenes sunu; wolde self cyning symbel þicgan.
text_bare: Þa wæs sæl ond mæl, þæt to healle gang Healfdenes sunu; wolde self cyning symbel þicgan.

text: Ne gefrægen ic þā mǣgþe māran weorode ymb hyra sinc-gyfan sēl gebǣran.
text_bare: Ne gefrægen ic þa mægþe maran weorode ymb hyra sinc-gyfan sel gebæran.

text: Bugon þā tō bence blǣd-āgende, fylle gefǣgon; fægere geþǣgon medo-ful manig māgas þāra, swīð-hicgende, on sele þām hēan, Hrōðgār ond Hrōþulf.
text_bare: Bugon þa to bence blæd-agende, fylle gefægon; fægere geþægon medo-ful manig magas þara, swið-hicgende, on sele þam hean, Hroðgar ond Hroþulf.

text: Heorot innan wæs frēondum āfylled; nalles fācen-stafas Þēod-Scyldingas þenden fremedon.
text_bare: Heorot innan wæs freondum afylled; nalles facen-stafas Þeod-Scyldingas þenden fremedon.

text: Forgeaf þā Bēowulfe bearn Healfdenes segen gyldenne sigores tō lēane, hroden hilte-cumbor, helm ond byrnan; mǣre māðþum-sweord manige gesāwon beforan beorn beran.
text_bare: Forgeaf þa Beowulfe bearn Healfdenes segen gyldenne sigores to leane, hroden hilte-cumbor, helm ond byrnan; mære maðþum-sweord manige gesawon beforan beorn beran.

text: Bēowulf geþah ful on flette.
text_bare: Beowulf geþah ful on flette.

text: Nō hē þǣre feoh-gyfte for scotenum scamigan ðorfte; ne gefrægn ic frēondlīcor fēower mādmas golde gegyrede gum-manna fela in ealo-bence ōðrum gesellan.
text_bare: No he þære feoh-gyfte for scotenum scamigan ðorfte; ne gefrægn ic freondlicor feower madmas golde gegyrede gum-manna fela in ealo-bence oðrum gesellan.

text: Ymb þæs helmes hrōf hēafod-beorge wīrum bewunden wala utan heold, þæt him fēla lāfe frēcne ne meahton scūr-heard sceþðan, þonne scyld-freca ongēan gramum gangan scolde.
text_bare: Ymb þæs helmes hrof heafod-beorge wirum bewunden wala utan heold, þæt him fela lafe frecne ne meahton scur-heard sceþðan, þonne scyld-freca ongean gramum gangan scolde.

text: Heht ðā eorla hlēo eahta mēaras fǣted-hlēore on flet tēon, in under eoderas; þāra ānum stōd sadol searwum fāh, since gewurþad; þæt wæs hilde-setl hēah-cyninges, ðonne sweorda gelāc sunu Healfdenes efnan wolde; nǣfre on ōre læg wīd-cūþes wīg, ðonne walu fēollon.
text_bare: Heht ða eorla hleo eahta mearas fæted-hleore on flet teon, in under eoderas; þara anum stod sadol searwum fah, since gewurþad; þæt wæs hilde-setl heah-cyninges, ðonne sweorda gelac sunu Healfdenes efnan wolde; næfre on ore læg wid-cuþes wig, ðonne walu feollon.

text: Ond ðā Bēowulfe bēga gehwæþ res eodor Ingwina onweald getēah, wicga ond wǣpna; hēt hine wel brūcan.
text_bare: Ond ða Beowulfe bega gehwæþ res eodor Ingwina onweald geteah, wicga ond wæpna; het hine wel brucan.

text: Swā manlīce mǣere þēoden, hord-weard hæleþa, heaþo-rǣsas geald mēarum ond mādmum, swā hȳ nǣfre man lyhð, sē þe secgan wile sōð ætter rihte.
text_bare: Swa manlice mæere þeoden, hord-weard hæleþa, heaþo-ræsas geald mearum ond madmum, swa hy næfre man lyhð, se þe secgan wile soð ætter rihte.

text: Ðā gyt ǣghwylcum eorla drihten, þāra þe mid Bēowulfe brim-lāde tēah, on þǣre medu-bence māþðum gesealde, yrfe-lāfe; ond þone ǣnne heht golde forgyldan, þone ðe Grendel ǣr māne ācwealde, swā hē hyra mā wolde, nefne him witig God wyrd forstōde, ond ðæs mannes mōd.
text_bare: Ða gyt æghwylcum eorla drihten, þara þe mid Beowulfe brim-lade teah, on þære medu-bence maþðum gesealde, yrfe-lafe; ond þone ænne heht golde forgyldan, þone ðe Grendel ær mane acwealde, swa he hyra ma wolde, nefne him witig God wyrd forstode, ond ðæs mannes mod.

text: Metod eallum wēold gumena cjnines, swā hē nū git dēð; forþan bið andgit ǣghwǣr sēlest, ferhðes fore-þanc.
text_bare: Metod eallum weold gumena cjnines, swa he nu git deð; forþan bið andgit æghwær selest, ferhðes fore-þanc.

text: Fela sceal gebīdan lēofes ond lāþes, sē þe longe hēr on ðyssum win-dagum worolde brūceð.
text_bare: Fela sceal gebidan leofes ond laþes, se þe longe her on ðyssum win-dagum worolde bruceð.

text: Þǣr wæs sang ond sweg samod ætgædere fore Healfdenes hilde-wīsan, gomen-wudu grēted, gid oft wrecen, ðonne heal-gamen Hrōþgāres scop æfter medo-bence mǣnan scolde: “Finnes eaferum, ðā hīe se fǣr begeat, hæleð Healf-Dena, Hnæf Scyldinga, in Frēs-wæle feallan scolde.
text_bare: Þær wæs sang ond sweg samod ætgædere fore Healfdenes hilde-wisan, gomen-wudu greted, gid oft wrecen, ðonne heal-gamen Hroþgares scop æfter medo-bence mænan scolde: “Finnes eaferum, ða hie se fær begeat, hæleð Healf-Dena, Hnæf Scyldinga, in Fres-wæle feallan scolde.

text: Ne hūru Hildeburh herian þorfte Eotena trēowe; unsynnum wearð beloren lēofum æt þām lind-plegan, bearnum ond brōðrum; hīe on gebyrd hruron gāre wunde; þæt wæs gēomuru ides.
text_bare: Ne huru Hildeburh herian þorfte Eotena treowe; unsynnum wearð beloren leofum æt þam lind-plegan, bearnum ond broðrum; hie on gebyrd hruron gare wunde; þæt wæs geomuru ides.

text: Nalles hōlinga Hōces dohtor meotod-sceaft bemearn, syþðan morgen cōm, ðā hēo under swegle gesēon meahte morþor-bealo māga, þǣr hēo ǣr mǣste hēold worolde wynne.
text_bare: Nalles holinga Hoces dohtor meotod-sceaft bemearn, syþðan morgen com, ða heo under swegle geseon meahte morþor-bealo maga, þær heo ær mæste heold worolde wynne.

text: Wīg ealle fornam Finnes þegnas, nemne fēaum ānum, þæt hē ne mehte on þǣm meðel-stede wūg Hengeste wiht gefeohtan, ne þā wēa-lāfe wīge forþringan þēodnes ðegne; ac hig him geþingo budon, þæt hīe him ōðer flet eal gerȳmdon, healle ond hēah-setl, þæt hīe healfie geweald wið Eotena bearn āgan mōston, ond æt feoh-gyftum Folcwaldan sunu dōgra gehwylce Dene weorþode, Hengestes hēap hringum wenede, efne swā swīðe sinc-gestrēonum fǣttan goldes, swā hē Frēsena cyn on bēor-sele byldan wolde.
text_bare: Wig ealle fornam Finnes þegnas, nemne feaum anum, þæt he ne mehte on þæm meðel-stede wug Hengeste wiht gefeohtan, ne þa wea-lafe wige forþringan þeodnes ðegne; ac hig him geþingo budon, þæt hie him oðer flet eal gerymdon, healle ond heah-setl, þæt hie healfie geweald wið Eotena bearn agan moston, ond æt feoh-gyftum Folcwaldan sunu dogra gehwylce Dene weorþode, Hengestes heap hringum wenede, efne swa swiðe sinc-gestreonum fættan goldes, swa he Fresena cyn on beor-sele byldan wolde.

text: Ðā hīe getrūwedon on twā healfa fæste frioðu-wǣre; Fin Hengeste elne unflitme āðum benemde, þæt hē þā wēa-lāfe weotena dōme ārum hēolde, þæt ðǣr ǣnig mon wordum ne worcum wǣre ne brǣpe, ne þurh inwit-searo ǣfre gemǣnden, ðēah hīe hira bēag-gyfan banan folgedon ðēoden-lēase, þā him swā geþearfod wæs.
text_bare: Ða hie getruwedon on twa healfa fæste frioðu-wære; Fin Hengeste elne unflitme aðum benemde, þæt he þa wea-lafe weotena dome arum heolde, þæt ðær ænig mon wordum ne worcum wære ne bræpe, ne þurh inwit-searo æfre gemænden, ðeah hie hira beag-gyfan banan folgedon ðeoden-lease, þa him swa geþearfod wæs.
