text: Gyf þonne Frȳsna hwylc frecnan sprǣce ðæs morþor-hetes myndgiend wǣre, þonne hit sweordes ecg syððan scolde.
text_bare: Gyf þonne Frysna hwylc frecnan spræce ðæs morþor-hetes myndgiend wære, þonne hit sweordes ecg syððan scolde.

text: Āð wæs geæfned, ond icge gold āhæfen of horde.
text_bare: Að wæs geæfned, ond icge gold ahæfen of horde.

text: Here-Scyldinga betst beado-rinca wæs on bǣl gearu: æt þǣm āde wæs ēþ-gesȳne swāt-fāh syrce, swȳn eal-gylden, eofer īren-heard, æþeling manig wundum āwyrded; sume on wæle crungon.
text_bare: Here-Scyldinga betst beado-rinca wæs on bæl gearu: æt þæm ade wæs eþ-gesyne swat-fah syrce, swyn eal-gylden, eofer iren-heard, æþeling manig wundum awyrded; sume on wæle crungon.

text: Hēt ðā Hildeburh æt Hnæfes āde hire selfre sunu sweoloðe befæstan, bān-fatu bærnan ond on bǣl dōn; earme on eaxle ides gnornode, gēomrode giddum.
text_bare: Het ða Hildeburh æt Hnæfes ade hire selfre sunu sweoloðe befæstan, ban-fatu bærnan ond on bæl don; earme on eaxle ides gnornode, geomrode giddum.

text: Gūð-rinc āstāh.
text_bare: Guð-rinc astah.

text: Wand tō wolcnum wæl-fȳra mǣst, hlynode for hlāwe; hafelan multon, ben-geato burston; ðonne blōd ætspranc lāð-bite līces.
text_bare: Wand to wolcnum wæl-fyra mæst, hlynode for hlawe; hafelan multon, ben-geato burston; ðonne blod ætspranc lað-bite lices.

text: Līg ealle forswealg, gǣsta gīfrost, þāra ðe þǣr gūð fornam bēga folces; wæs hira blǣd scacen.
text_bare: Lig ealle forswealg, gæsta gifrost, þara ðe þær guð fornam bega folces; wæs hira blæd scacen.

text: Gewiton him ðā wīgend wīca nēosian frēondum befeallen, Frȳsland gesēon, hāmas ond hēa-burh.
text_bare: Gewiton him ða wigend wica neosian freondum befeallen, Frysland geseon, hamas ond hea-burh.

text: Hengest ðā gyt wæl-fāgne winter wunode mid Finn elne unflitme; eard gemunde, þēah þe hē ne meahte on mere drīfan hringed-stefnan; holm storme wēol, won wið winde; winter ȳþe belēac īs-gebinde, op ðæt ōþer cōm gēar in geardas, swā nū gyt dēð, þā ðe syngales sēle bewitiað, wuldor-torhtan weder.
text_bare: Hengest ða gyt wæl-fagne winter wunode mid Finn elne unflitme; eard gemunde, þeah þe he ne meahte on mere drifan hringed-stefnan; holm storme weol, won wið winde; winter yþe beleac is-gebinde, op ðæt oþer com gear in geardas, swa nu gyt deð, þa ðe syngales sele bewitiað, wuldor-torhtan weder.

text: Ðā wæs winter scacen, fæger foldan bearm; fundode wrecca, gist of geardum; hē tō gyrn-wræce swīðor þohte, þonne tō sǣ-lāde, gif hē torn-gemōt þurhtēon mihte, þæt hē Eotena bearn inne gemunde.
text_bare: Ða wæs winter scacen, fæger foldan bearm; fundode wrecca, gist of geardum; he to gyrn-wræce swiðor þohte, þonne to sæ-lade, gif he torn-gemot þurhteon mihte, þæt he Eotena bearn inne gemunde.

text: Swā hē ne forwyrnde worold-rǣdenne, þonne him Hūnlāfing hilde-lēoman, billa sēlest, on bearm dyde; þæs wǣron mid Eotenum ecge cūðe.
text_bare: Swa he ne forwyrnde worold-rædenne, þonne him Hunlafing hilde-leoman, billa selest, on bearm dyde; þæs wæron mid Eotenum ecge cuðe.

text: Swylce ferhð-frecan Fin eft begeat sweord-bealo slīðen æt his selfes hām, siþðan grimne gripe Gūðlāf ond Ōslāf æfter sǣ-sīðe sorge mǣndon, ætwiton wēana dǣl; ne meahte wǣfre mōd forhabban in hreþre.
text_bare: Swylce ferhð-frecan Fin eft begeat sweord-bealo sliðen æt his selfes ham, siþðan grimne gripe Guðlaf ond Oslaf æfter sæ-siðe sorge mændon, ætwiton weana dæl; ne meahte wæfre mod forhabban in hreþre.

text: Ðā wæs heal hroden fēonda fēorum, swilce Fin slægen, cyning on corþre, ond sēo cwēn numen.
text_bare: Ða wæs heal hroden feonda feorum, swilce Fin slægen, cyning on corþre, ond seo cwen numen.

text: Scēotend Scyldinga tō scypon feredon eal in-gesteald eorð-cyninges, swylce hīe æt Finnes hām findan meahton sigla, searo-gimma.
text_bare: Sceotend Scyldinga to scypon feredon eal in-gesteald eorð-cyninges, swylce hie æt Finnes ham findan meahton sigla, searo-gimma.

text: Hīe on sǣ-lāde drihtlīce wīf tō Denum feredon, lǣddon tō lēodum.” Lēoð wæs āsungen, glēo-mannes gyd.
text_bare: Hie on sæ-lade drihtlice wif to Denum feredon, læddon to leodum.” Leoð wæs asungen, gleo-mannes gyd.

text: Gamen eft āstāh, beorhtode benc-swēg; byrelas sealdon wīn of wunder-fatum.
text_bare: Gamen eft astah, beorhtode benc-sweg; byrelas sealdon win of wunder-fatum.

text: Þā cwōm Wealhþēo forð gān under gyldnum bēage, þǣr þā gōdan twēgen sǣton suhter-gefæderan; þā gyt wæs hiera sib ætgædere, ǣghwylc ōðrum trȳwe.
text_bare: Þa cwom Wealhþeo forð gan under gyldnum beage, þær þa godan twegen sæton suhter-gefæderan; þa gyt wæs hiera sib ætgædere, æghwylc oðrum trywe.

text: Swylce þǣr Unferþ þyle æt fōtum sæt frēan Scyldinga; gehwylc hiora his ferhþe trēowde, þæt hē hæfde mōd micel, þēah þe hē his māgum nǣre ār-fæst æt ecga gelācum.
text_bare: Swylce þær Unferþ þyle æt fotum sæt frean Scyldinga; gehwylc hiora his ferhþe treowde, þæt he hæfde mod micel, þeah þe he his magum nære ar-fæst æt ecga gelacum.

text: Spræc ðā ides Scyldinga: “Onfōh þissum fulle, frēo-drihten mīn, sinces brytta; þū on sǣlum wes, gold-wine gumena, ond tō Gēatum sprec mildum wordum, swā sceal man dōn.
text_bare: Spræc ða ides Scyldinga: “Onfoh þissum fulle, freo-drihten min, sinces brytta; þu on sælum wes, gold-wine gumena, ond to Geatum sprec mildum wordum, swa sceal man don.

text: Bēo wið Gēatas glæd, geofena gemyndig; nēan ond feorran þū nū freoðo hafast.
text_bare: Beo wið Geatas glæd, geofena gemyndig; nean ond feorran þu nu freoðo hafast.

text: Mē man sægde, þæt þū ðē for sunu wolde here-rinc habban.
text_bare: Me man sægde, þæt þu ðe for sunu wolde here-rinc habban.

text: Heorot is gefǣlsod, bēah-sele beorhta; brūc þenden þū mōte manigra mēda, ond þīnum māgum lǣf folc ond rīce, þonne ðū forð scyle metod-sceaft sēon.
text_bare: Heorot is gefælsod, beah-sele beorhta; bruc þenden þu mote manigra meda, ond þinum magum læf folc ond rice, þonne ðu forð scyle metod-sceaft seon.

text: Ic mīnne can glædne Hrōþulf, þæt hē þā geogoðe wile ārum healdan, gyf þū ǣr þonne hē, wine Scildinga, worold oflǣtest; wēne ic, þæt hē mid gōde gyldan wille uncran eaferan, gif hē þæt eal gemon, hwaet wit tō willan ond tō worð-myndum umbor-wesendum ǣr ārna gefremedon.” Hwearf þā bī bence, þǣr hyre byre wǣron, Hrēðrīc ond Hrōðmund, ond hæleþa bearn, giogoð ætgædere; þǣr se gōda sæt, Bēowulf Gēata, be þǣm gebrōðrum twǣm.
text_bare: Ic minne can glædne Hroþulf, þæt he þa geogoðe wile arum healdan, gyf þu ær þonne he, wine Scildinga, worold oflætest; wene ic, þæt he mid gode gyldan wille uncran eaferan, gif he þæt eal gemon, hwaet wit to willan ond to worð-myndum umbor-wesendum ær arna gefremedon.” Hwearf þa bi bence, þær hyre byre wæron, Hreðric ond Hroðmund, ond hæleþa bearn, giogoð ætgædere; þær se goda sæt, Beowulf Geata, be þæm gebroðrum twæm.

text: Him wæs ful boren, ond frēond-laþu wordum bewægned, ond wunden gold ēstum geēawed, earm-hrēade twā, hrægl ond hringas, heals-bēaga mǣst, þāra þe ic on foldan gefrægen hæbbe.
text_bare: Him wæs ful boren, ond freond-laþu wordum bewægned, ond wunden gold estum geeawed, earm-hreade twa, hrægl ond hringas, heals-beaga mæst, þara þe ic on foldan gefrægen hæbbe.

text: Nǣnigne ic under swegle sēlran hȳrde hord-mādmum hæleþa, syþðan Hāma ætwæg tō þǣre byrhtan byrig Brōsinga mene, sigle ond sinc-fæt, searo-nīðas flēah Eormenrīces, gecēas ēcne rǣd.
text_bare: Nænigne ic under swegle selran hyrde hord-madmum hæleþa, syþðan Hama ætwæg to þære byrhtan byrig Brosinga mene, sigle ond sinc-fæt, searo-niðas fleah Eormenrices, geceas ecne ræd.

text: Þone hring hæfde Higelāc Gēata, nefa Swertinges, nȳhstan sīðe, siðþan hē under segne sine ealgode, wæl-rēaf werede; hyne wyrd fornam, syþðan hē for wlenco wēan āhsode, fǣhðe tō Frȳsum.
text_bare: Þone hring hæfde Higelac Geata, nefa Swertinges, nyhstan siðe, siðþan he under segne sine ealgode, wæl-reaf werede; hyne wyrd fornam, syþðan he for wlenco wean ahsode, fæhðe to Frysum.

text: Hē þā frætwe wæg, eorclan-stānas, ofer ȳða ful, rīce þēoden; hē under rande gecranc.
text_bare: He þa frætwe wæg, eorclan-stanas, ofer yða ful, rice þeoden; he under rande gecranc.

text: Gehwearf þā in Francna fæþm feorh cyninges, brēost-gewǣdu ond se bēah somod; wyrsan wīg-frecan wæl rēafedon æfter gūð-sceare; Gēata lēode hrēa-wīc hēoldon.
text_bare: Gehwearf þa in Francna fæþm feorh cyninges, breost-gewædu ond se beah somod; wyrsan wig-frecan wæl reafedon æfter guð-sceare; Geata leode hrea-wic heoldon.

text: Heal swēge onfēng.
text_bare: Heal swege onfeng.

text: Wealhðēo maþelode, hēo fore þǣm.
text_bare: Wealhðeo maþelode, heo fore þæm.

text: werede spræc: “Brūc ðisses bēages, Bēowulf lēofa, hyse, mid hǣle, ond þisses hrægles nēot, þēod-gestrēona, ond geþēoh tela; cen þec mid cræfte, ond þyssum cnyhtum wes lāra līðe; ic þē þǣs lēan geman.
text_bare: werede spræc: “Bruc ðisses beages, Beowulf leofa, hyse, mid hæle, ond þisses hrægles neot, þeod-gestreona, ond geþeoh tela; cen þec mid cræfte, ond þyssum cnyhtum wes lara liðe; ic þe þæs lean geman.

text: Hafast þū gefēred, þæt ðē feor ond nēah ealne wīde-ferhþ weras ehtigað, efne swā sīde swā sǣ bebūgeð windge eard-weallas.
text_bare: Hafast þu gefered, þæt ðe feor ond neah ealne wide-ferhþ weras ehtigað, efne swa side swa sæ bebugeð windge eard-weallas.

text: Wes, þenden þū lifige, æþeling ēadig; ic þē an tela sinc-gestrēona.
text_bare: Wes, þenden þu lifige, æþeling eadig; ic þe an tela sinc-gestreona.

text: Bēo þū suna mīnum dǣdum gedēfe, drēam healdende.
text_bare: Beo þu suna minum dædum gedefe, dream healdende.

text: Hēr is ǣghwylc eorl ōþrum getrȳwe, mōdes milde, man-drihtne hold; þegnas syndon geþwǣre, þēod eal gearo.
text_bare: Her is æghwylc eorl oþrum getrywe, modes milde, man-drihtne hold; þegnas syndon geþwære, þeod eal gearo.

text: Druncne dryht-guman, dōð swā ic bidde.” Ēode þā tō setle.
text_bare: Druncne dryht-guman, doð swa ic bidde.” Eode þa to setle.

text: Þǣr w«s symbla cyst, druncon wīn weras; wyrd ne cūþon, gēo-sceaft grimme, swā hit āgangen wearð eorla manegum.
text_bare: Þær w«s symbla cyst, druncon win weras; wyrd ne cuþon, geo-sceaft grimme, swa hit agangen wearð eorla manegum.

text: Syþðan ǣfen cwōm, ond him Hrōþgār gewāt tō hofe sīnum, rīce tō ræste, reced weardode unrīm eorla, swā hīe oft ǣr dydon.
text_bare: Syþðan æfen cwom, ond him Hroþgar gewat to hofe sinum, rice to ræste, reced weardode unrim eorla, swa hie oft ær dydon.

text: Benc-þelu beredon; hit geond-brǣded wearð beddum ond bolstrum.
text_bare: Benc-þelu beredon; hit geond-bræded wearð beddum ond bolstrum.

text: Bēor-scealca sum fūs ond fǣge flet-ræste gebēag.
text_bare: Beor-scealca sum fus ond fæge flet-ræste gebeag.

text: Setton him tō hēafdon hilde-randas, bord-wudu beorhtan; þǣr on bence wæs ofer æþelinge ȳþ-gesene heaþo-stēapa helm, hringed byrne, þrec-wudu þrymlīc.
text_bare: Setton him to heafdon hilde-randas, bord-wudu beorhtan; þær on bence wæs ofer æþelinge yþ-gesene heaþo-steapa helm, hringed byrne, þrec-wudu þrymlic.

text: Wæs þēaw hyra, þæt hīe oft wǣron an wīg gearwe ge æt hām ge on herge, ge gehwæþer þāra efne swylce mǣla, swylce hira man-dryhtne þearf gesǣlde; wæs sēo þrēod tilu.
text_bare: Wæs þeaw hyra, þæt hie oft wæron an wig gearwe ge æt ham ge on herge, ge gehwæþer þara efne swylce mæla, swylce hira man-dryhtne þearf gesælde; wæs seo þreod tilu.

text: Sigon þā tō slǣpe.
text_bare: Sigon þa to slæpe.

text: Sum sāre angeald ǣfen-ræste, swā him ful oft gelamp, siþðan gold-sele Grendel warode, unriht æfnde, oþ þæt ende becwōm, swylt æfter synnum.
text_bare: Sum sare angeald æfen-ræste, swa him ful oft gelamp, siþðan gold-sele Grendel warode, unriht æfnde, oþ þæt ende becwom, swylt æfter synnum.

text: Þæt gesȳne wearþ, wīd-cūþ werum, þætte wrecend þā gyt lifde æfter lāþum, lange þrāge æfter gūð-ceare; Grendles mōdor, ides, āglǣc-wīf, yrmþe gemunde, sē þe wæter-egesan wunian scolde, cealde strēamas, siþðan Cain wearð tō ecg-banan āngan brēþer, fæderen-mǣge; hē þā fāg gewāt, morþre gemearcod, man-drēam flēon, wēsten warode.
text_bare: Þæt gesyne wearþ, wid-cuþ werum, þætte wrecend þa gyt lifde æfter laþum, lange þrage æfter guð-ceare; Grendles modor, ides, aglæc-wif, yrmþe gemunde, se þe wæter-egesan wunian scolde, cealde streamas, siþðan Cain wearð to ecg-banan angan breþer, fæderen-mæge; he þa fag gewat, morþre gemearcod, man-dream fleon, westen warode.

text: Þanon wōc fela gēo-sceaft-gāsta; wæs þǣra Grendel sum, heoro-wearh hetelīc, sē æt Heorote fand wæccendne wer wīges bīdan.
text_bare: Þanon woc fela geo-sceaft-gasta; wæs þæra Grendel sum, heoro-wearh hetelic, se æt Heorote fand wæccendne wer wiges bidan.

text: Þǣr him āglǣca ætgrǣpe wearð; hwæþre hē gemunde mægenes strenge, gim-fæste gife, ðe him God sealde, ond him tō Anwaldan āre gelȳfde, frōfre ond fultum; ðȳ hē þone fēond ofercwōm, gehnǣgde helle gāst.
text_bare: Þær him aglæca ætgræpe wearð; hwæþre he gemunde mægenes strenge, gim-fæste gife, ðe him God sealde, ond him to Anwaldan are gelyfde, frofre ond fultum; ðy he þone feond ofercwom, gehnægde helle gast.

text: Þā hā hēan gewāt, drēame bedǣled, dēaþ-wīc sēon, man-cynnes fēond.
text_bare: Þa ha hean gewat, dreame bedæled, deaþ-wic seon, man-cynnes feond.

text: Ond his mōdor þā gyt gīfre ond galg-mōd gegān wolde sorh-fulne sīð, suna dēað wrecan; cōm þā tō Heorote, ðǣr Hring-Dene geond þæt sæld swǣfun.
text_bare: Ond his modor þa gyt gifre ond galg-mod gegan wolde sorh-fulne sið, suna deað wrecan; com þa to Heorote, ðær Hring-Dene geond þæt sæld swæfun.

text: Þā ðǣr sōna wearð ed-hwyrft eorkim, siþðan inne fealh Grendles mōdor.
text_bare: Þa ðær sona wearð ed-hwyrft eorkim, siþðan inne fealh Grendles modor.

text: Wæs se gryre lǣssa efne swā micle, swā bið mægþa.
text_bare: Wæs se gryre læssa efne swa micle, swa bið mægþa.

text: cræft, wīg-gryre wīfes, be wǣpned-men, þonne heoru bunden, hamere geþuren, sweord swāte fāh swīn ofer helme, ecgum dyhtig andweard scireð.
text_bare: cræft, wig-gryre wifes, be wæpned-men, þonne heoru bunden, hamere geþuren, sweord swate fah swin ofer helme, ecgum dyhtig andweard scireð.

text: Ðā wæs on healle heard-ecg togen sweord ofer setlum, sīd-rand manig hafen handa fæst; helm ne gemunde, byrnan sīde, þā hine se brōga angeat.
text_bare: Ða wæs on healle heard-ecg togen sweord ofer setlum, sid-rand manig hafen handa fæst; helm ne gemunde, byrnan side, þa hine se broga angeat.

text: Hēo wæs on ōfste, wolde ūt þanon fēore beorgan, þā hēo onfunden wæs; hraðe hēo æþelinga ānne hæfde fæste befangen; þā hēo tō fenne gang.
text_bare: Heo wæs on ofste, wolde ut þanon feore beorgan, þa heo onfunden wæs; hraðe heo æþelinga anne hæfde fæste befangen; þa heo to fenne gang.

text: Sē wæs Hrōþgāre hæleþa lēofost on gesīðes hād be sǣm twēonum, rīce rand-wīga, þone ðe hēo on ræste ābrēat, blǣd-fæstne beorn.
text_bare: Se wæs Hroþgare hæleþa leofost on gesiðes had be sæm tweonum, rice rand-wiga, þone ðe heo on ræste abreat, blæd-fæstne beorn.

text: Næs Bēowulf ðǣr, ac wæs ōþer in ǣr geteohhod æfter māþðum-gife mǣrum Gēate.
text_bare: Næs Beowulf ðær, ac wæs oþer in ær geteohhod æfter maþðum-gife mærum Geate.

text: Hrēam wearð in Heorote; hēo under heolfre genam cūþe folme; cearu wæs genīwod, geworden in wīcun.
text_bare: Hream wearð in Heorote; heo under heolfre genam cuþe folme; cearu wæs geniwod, geworden in wicun.

text: Ne wæs þæt gewrixle til, þæt hīe on bā healfa bicgan scoldon frēonda fēorum.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt gewrixle til, þæt hie on ba healfa bicgan scoldon freonda feorum.

text: Þā wæs frōd cyning, hār hilde-rinc, on hrēon mōde, syðþan hē aldor-þegn unlyfigendne, þone dēorestan dēadne wisse.
text_bare: Þa wæs frod cyning, har hilde-rinc, on hreon mode, syðþan he aldor-þegn unlyfigendne, þone deorestan deadne wisse.

text: Hraþe wæs tō būre Bēowulf fetod, sigor-ēadig secg; samod ǣr-dæge ēode eorla sum, æþele cempa self mid gesīðum, þǣr se snotera bād, hwæþre him Al-walda ǣfre wille æfter wēa-spelle wtrpe gefremman.
text_bare: Hraþe wæs to bure Beowulf fetod, sigor-eadig secg; samod ær-dæge eode eorla sum, æþele cempa self mid gesiðum, þær se snotera bad, hwæþre him Al-walda æfre wille æfter wea-spelle wtrpe gefremman.

text: Gang ðā æfter flōre fyrd-wyrðe man mid his hand-scole heal-wudu dynede , þæt hē þone wīsan wordum nǣgde frēan Ingwina, frægn gif him wǣre æfter nēod-laðu niht getǣse.
text_bare: Gang ða æfter flore fyrd-wyrðe man mid his hand-scole heal-wudu dynede , þæt he þone wisan wordum nægde frean Ingwina, frægn gif him wære æfter neod-laðu niht getæse.

text: Hrōðgār maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “Ne frīn þū æfter sǣlum; sorh is genīwod Denigea lēodum.
text_bare: Hroðgar maþelode, helm Scyldinga: “Ne frin þu æfter sælum; sorh is geniwod Denigea leodum.

text: Dēad is Æschere, Yrmenlāfes yldra brōþor, mīn rūn-wita ond mīn rǣd-bora, eaxl-gestealla, ðonne wē on orlege hafelan weredon, þonne hniton fēþan, eoferas cnysedan.
text_bare: Dead is Æschere, Yrmenlafes yldra broþor, min run-wita ond min ræd-bora, eaxl-gestealla, ðonne we on orlege hafelan weredon, þonne hniton feþan, eoferas cnysedan.

text: Swylc scolde eorl wesan, æþeling ǣr-gōd, swylc Æschere wæs.
text_bare: Swylc scolde eorl wesan, æþeling ær-god, swylc Æschere wæs.

text: Wearð him on Heorote tō hand-banan wæl-gæst wǣfre; ic ne wāt hwæder atol ǣse wlanc eft-sīðas tēah, fylle gefrǣgnod.
text_bare: Wearð him on Heorote to hand-banan wæl-gæst wæfre; ic ne wat hwæder atol æse wlanc eft-siðas teah, fylle gefrægnod.

text: Hēo þā fǣhðe wræc, þe þū gystran niht Grendel cwealdest þurh hǣstne hād heardum clammum, forþan hē tō lange lēode mīne wanode ond wyrde.
text_bare: Heo þa fæhðe wræc, þe þu gystran niht Grendel cwealdest þurh hæstne had heardum clammum, forþan he to lange leode mine wanode ond wyrde.

text: Hē æt wīge gecrang ealdres scyldig, ond nū ōþer cwōm mihtig mān-scaða, wolde hyre mǣg wrecan, ge feor hafað fǣhðe gestǣled, þæs þe þincean mæg þegne monegum, sē þe æfter sinc-gyfan on sefan grēoteþ, hreþer-bealo hearde; nū sēo hand ligeð, sē þe ēow wel-hwylcra wilna dohte.
text_bare: He æt wige gecrang ealdres scyldig, ond nu oþer cwom mihtig man-scaða, wolde hyre mæg wrecan, ge feor hafað fæhðe gestæled, þæs þe þincean mæg þegne monegum, se þe æfter sinc-gyfan on sefan greoteþ, hreþer-bealo hearde; nu seo hand ligeð, se þe eow wel-hwylcra wilna dohte.

text: Ic þæt lond-būend, lēode mīne, sele-rǣdende, secgan hȳrde, þæt hīe gesāwon swylce twēgen micle mearc-stapan mōras healdan, ellor-gǣstas; ðǣra ōðer wæs, þæs þe hīe gewislīcost gewitan meahton, idese onlīcnes; ōðer earm-sceapen on weres wæstmum wræc-lāstas træd, næfne hē wæs māra þonne ǣnig man ōðer, þone on gēar-dagum Grendel nemdon fold-būende; nō hīe fæder cunnon, hwæþer him ǣnig wæs ǣr ācenned dyrnra gāsta.
text_bare: Ic þæt lond-buend, leode mine, sele-rædende, secgan hyrde, þæt hie gesawon swylce twegen micle mearc-stapan moras healdan, ellor-gæstas; ðæra oðer wæs, þæs þe hie gewislicost gewitan meahton, idese onlicnes; oðer earm-sceapen on weres wæstmum wræc-lastas træd, næfne he wæs mara þonne ænig man oðer, þone on gear-dagum Grendel nemdon fold-buende; no hie fæder cunnon, hwæþer him ænig wæs ær acenned dyrnra gasta.

text: Hīe dȳgel lond warigeað, wulf-hleoþu, windige næssas, frēcne fen-gelād, ðǣr fyrgen-strēam under næssa genipu niþer gewīteð, flōd under foldan.
text_bare: Hie dygel lond warigeað, wulf-hleoþu, windige næssas, frecne fen-gelad, ðær fyrgen-stream under næssa genipu niþer gewiteð, flod under foldan.

text: Nis þæt feor heonon mīl-gemearces, þæt se mere standeð, ofer þǣm hongiað hrīmge bearwas, wudu wyrtum fæst, wæter oferhelmað.
text_bare: Nis þæt feor heonon mil-gemearces, þæt se mere standeð, ofer þæm hongiað hrimge bearwas, wudu wyrtum fæst, wæter oferhelmað.

text: Þǣr mæg nihta gehwǣm nīð-wundor sēon, fȳr on flōde.
text_bare: Þær mæg nihta gehwæm nið-wundor seon, fyr on flode.

text: Nō þæs frōd leofað gumena beama, þæt þone grund wite.
text_bare: No þæs frod leofað gumena beama, þæt þone grund wite.

text: Ðēah þe hǣð-stapa hundum geswenced, heorot hornum trum, holt-wudu sēce, feorran geflȳmed, ǣr hē feorh seleð, aldor on ōfre, ǣr hē in wille hafelan hȳdan.
text_bare: Ðeah þe hæð-stapa hundum geswenced, heorot hornum trum, holt-wudu sece, feorran geflymed, ær he feorh seleð, aldor on ofre, ær he in wille hafelan hydan.

text: Nis þæt hēoru stōw; þonon ȳd-geblond ūp āstīgeð won tō wolcnum, þonne wind styreþ lāð gewidru, oð ðæt lyft drysmaþ, roderas rēotað.
text_bare: Nis þæt heoru stow; þonon yd-geblond up astigeð won to wolcnum, þonne wind styreþ lað gewidru, oð ðæt lyft drysmaþ, roderas reotað.

text: Nū is se rǣd gelang eft æt þē ānum.
text_bare: Nu is se ræd gelang eft æt þe anum.

text: Eard git ne const, frēcne stōwe, ðær þū findan miht fela-sinnigne secg; sēc gif þū dyrre.
text_bare: Eard git ne const, frecne stowe, ðær þu findan miht fela-sinnigne secg; sec gif þu dyrre.

text: Ic þē þā fǣhðe fēo lēanige, eald-gestrēonum, swā ic ǣr dyde, wundnum golde, gyf þū onweg cymest.”
text_bare: Ic þe þa fæhðe feo leanige, eald-gestreonum, swa ic ær dyde, wundnum golde, gyf þu onweg cymest.”

text: Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: “Ne sorga, snotor guma; sēlre bið ǣghwǣm, þæt hē his frēond wrece, þonne hē fela murne.
text_bare: Beowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: “Ne sorga, snotor guma; selre bið æghwæm, þæt he his freond wrece, þonne he fela murne.

text: Ure ǣghwylc sceal ende gebīdan worolde lifes; wyrce sē þe mōte dōmes ǣr dēaþe; þæt bið driht-guman unlifgendum æfter sēlest.
text_bare: Ure æghwylc sceal ende gebidan worolde lifes; wyrce se þe mote domes ær deaþe; þæt bið driht-guman unlifgendum æfter selest.

text: Ārīs, rīces weard; uton hraþe fēran, Grendles māgan gang scēawigan.
text_bare: Aris, rices weard; uton hraþe feran, Grendles magan gang sceawigan.

text: Ic hit þē gehāte: nō hē on hehn losaþ, ne on foldan fæþm, ne on fyrgen-holt, ne on gyfenes grund, gā þǣr hē wille.
text_bare: Ic hit þe gehate: no he on hehn losaþ, ne on foldan fæþm, ne on fyrgen-holt, ne on gyfenes grund, ga þær he wille.

text: Ðȳs dōgor þū geþyld hafa wēana gehwylces, swā ic þē wēne tō.” Āhlēop ðā se gomela, Gode þancode, mihtigan Drihtne, þæs se man gespræc.
text_bare: Ðys dogor þu geþyld hafa weana gehwylces, swa ic þe wene to.” Ahleop ða se gomela, Gode þancode, mihtigan Drihtne, þæs se man gespræc.

text: Þā wæs Hrōðgāre hors gebǣted, wicg wunden-feax; wīsa fengel geatolīc gengde; gum-fēþa stōp lind-hæbbendra.
text_bare: Þa wæs Hroðgare hors gebæted, wicg wunden-feax; wisa fengel geatolic gengde; gum-feþa stop lind-hæbbendra.

text: Lāstas wǣron æfter wald-swaþum wīde gesȳne, gang ofer grundas; gegnum fōr ofer myrcan mōr, mago-þegna bær þone sēlestan sāwol-lēasne, þāra þe mid Hrōðgāre hām eahtode.
text_bare: Lastas wæron æfter wald-swaþum wide gesyne, gang ofer grundas; gegnum for ofer myrcan mor, mago-þegna bær þone selestan sawol-leasne, þara þe mid Hroðgare ham eahtode.

text: Oferēode þā æþelinga bearn stēap stān-hliðo, stīge nearwe, enge ān-paðas, uncūð gelād, nēowle næssas, nicor-hūsa fela; hē fēara sum beforan gengde wīsra monna wong scēawian, oþ þæt hē fǣringa fyrgen-bēamas ofer hārne stān hleonian funde, wyn-lēasne wudu; wæter under stōd drēorig ond gedrēfed.
text_bare: Ofereode þa æþelinga bearn steap stan-hliðo, stige nearwe, enge an-paðas, uncuð gelad, neowle næssas, nicor-husa fela; he feara sum beforan gengde wisra monna wong sceawian, oþ þæt he færinga fyrgen-beamas ofer harne stan hleonian funde, wyn-leasne wudu; wæter under stod dreorig ond gedrefed.

text: Denum eallum wæs, winum Scyldinga, weorce on mōde tō geþolianne, ðegne monegum, oncȳð eorla gehwǣm, syðþan Æscheres on þām holm-clife hafelan mētton.
text_bare: Denum eallum wæs, winum Scyldinga, weorce on mode to geþolianne, ðegne monegum, oncyð eorla gehwæm, syðþan Æscheres on þam holm-clife hafelan metton.

text: Flōd blōde wēol folc tō sǣgon , hātan heolfre.
text_bare: Flod blode weol folc to sægon , hatan heolfre.

text: Horn stundum song fūslīc fyrd-lēoð.
text_bare: Horn stundum song fuslic fyrd-leoð.

text: Fēþa eal gesæt; gesāwon ðā æfter wætere wyrm-cynnes fela, sellīce sǣ-dracan, sund cunnian, swylce on næs-hleoðum nicras licgean, ðā on undern-mǣl oft bewitigað sorh-fulne sīð on segl-rāde, wyrmas ond wil-dēor; hīe onweg hruron bitere ond gebolgne, bearhtm ongēaton, gūð-horn galan.
text_bare: Feþa eal gesæt; gesawon ða æfter wætere wyrm-cynnes fela, sellice sæ-dracan, sund cunnian, swylce on næs-hleoðum nicras licgean, ða on undern-mæl oft bewitigað sorh-fulne sið on segl-rade, wyrmas ond wil-deor; hie onweg hruron bitere ond gebolgne, bearhtm ongeaton, guð-horn galan.

text: Sumne Gēata lēod of flān-bogan fēores getwǣfde, ȳð-gewinnes, þæt him on aldre stōd here-strǣl hearda; hē on hohne wæs sundes þē sǣnra, ðē hyne swylt fornam.
text_bare: Sumne Geata leod of flan-bogan feores getwæfde, yð-gewinnes, þæt him on aldre stod here-stræl hearda; he on hohne wæs sundes þe sænra, ðe hyne swylt fornam.

text: Hræþe wearð on ȳðum mid eofer-sprēotum heoro-hōcyhtum hearde genearwod, nīða genǣged ond on næs togen, wundorlīc wǣg-bora; weras scēawedon gryrelīcne gist.
text_bare: Hræþe wearð on yðum mid eofer-spreotum heoro-hocyhtum hearde genearwod, niða genæged ond on næs togen, wundorlic wæg-bora; weras sceawedon gryrelicne gist.

text: Gyrede hine Beowulf eorl-gewǣdum, nalles for ealdre mearn; scolde here-byrne hondum gebrōden, sīd ond searo-fāh, sund cunnian, sēo ðe bān-cofan beorgan cūþe, þæt him hilde-grāp hreþre ne mihte, eorres inwit-feng aldre gesceþðan; ac se hwīta helm hafelan werede, sē þe mere-grundas mengan scolde, sēcan sund-gebland since geweorðad, befongen frēa-wrāsnum, swā hine fyrn-dagum worhte wǣpna smið, wundrum tēode, besette swīn-līcum, þæt hine syðþan nō brond ne beado-mēcas bītan ne meahton.
text_bare: Gyrede hine Beowulf eorl-gewædum, nalles for ealdre mearn; scolde here-byrne hondum gebroden, sid ond searo-fah, sund cunnian, seo ðe ban-cofan beorgan cuþe, þæt him hilde-grap hreþre ne mihte, eorres inwit-feng aldre gesceþðan; ac se hwita helm hafelan werede, se þe mere-grundas mengan scolde, secan sund-gebland since geweorðad, befongen frea-wrasnum, swa hine fyrn-dagum worhte wæpna smið, wundrum teode, besette swin-licum, þæt hine syðþan no brond ne beado-mecas bitan ne meahton.

text: Næs þæt þonne mǣtost mægen-fultuma, þæt him on ðearfe lāh ðyle Hrōðgāres; wæs þǣm hæft-mēce Hrunting nama; þæt wæs ān foran eald-gestrēona; ecg wæs īren, āter-tānum fāh, āhyrded heaþo-swāte; nǣfre hit æt hilde ne swāc manna ǣngum, þāra þe hit mid mundum bewand, sē ðe gryre-sīðas gegān dorste, folc-stede fāra; næs þæt forma sīð, þæt hit ellen-weorc æfnan scolde.
text_bare: Næs þæt þonne mætost mægen-fultuma, þæt him on ðearfe lah ðyle Hroðgares; wæs þæm hæft-mece Hrunting nama; þæt wæs an foran eald-gestreona; ecg wæs iren, ater-tanum fah, ahyrded heaþo-swate; næfre hit æt hilde ne swac manna ængum, þara þe hit mid mundum bewand, se ðe gryre-siðas gegan dorste, folc-stede fara; næs þæt forma sið, þæt hit ellen-weorc æfnan scolde.

text: Hūru ne gemunde mago Ecglāfes eafoþes cræftig, þæt hē ǣr gespræc wīne druncen, þā hā þæs wǣpnes onlāh sēlran sweord-frecan; selfa ne dorste under ȳða gewin aldre genēþan, driht-scype drēogan; þǣr hē dōme forlēas, ellen-mǣrðum.
text_bare: Huru ne gemunde mago Ecglafes eafoþes cræftig, þæt he ær gespræc wine druncen, þa ha þæs wæpnes onlah selran sweord-frecan; selfa ne dorste under yða gewin aldre geneþan, driht-scype dreogan; þær he dome forleas, ellen-mærðum.

text: Ne wæs þǣm ōðrum swā, syðþan hē hine tō gūðe gegyred hæfde.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæm oðrum swa, syðþan he hine to guðe gegyred hæfde.

text: Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: “Geþenc nū, se mǣra maga Healfdenes, snottra fengel, nū ic eom sīðes fūs, gold-wine gumena, hwæt wit gēo sprǣcon: gif ic æt þearfe þīnre scolde aldre linnan, þæt ðū mē ā wǣre forð-gewitenum on fæder stǣle.
text_bare: Beowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: “Geþenc nu, se mæra maga Healfdenes, snottra fengel, nu ic eom siðes fus, gold-wine gumena, hwæt wit geo spræcon: gif ic æt þearfe þinre scolde aldre linnan, þæt ðu me a wære forð-gewitenum on fæder stæle.

text: Wes þū mund-bora mīnum mago-þegnum, hond-gesellum, gif mec hild nime; swylce þū ðā mādmas, þe þū mē sealdest, Hrōðgār lēofa, Higelāce onsend.
text_bare: Wes þu mund-bora minum mago-þegnum, hond-gesellum, gif mec hild nime; swylce þu ða madmas, þe þu me sealdest, Hroðgar leofa, Higelace onsend.

text: Mæg þonne on þǣm golde ongitan Gēata dryhten, gesēon sunu Hrēðles, þonne hē on þæt sinc starað, þæt ic gum-cystum gōdne funde bēaga bryttan, brēac þonne mōste.
text_bare: Mæg þonne on þæm golde ongitan Geata dryhten, geseon sunu Hreðles, þonne he on þæt sinc starað, þæt ic gum-cystum godne funde beaga bryttan, breac þonne moste.

text: Ond þū Unferð lǣt ealde lāfe, wrætlīc wǣg-sweord, wīd-cūðne man heard-ecg habban; ic mē mid Hruntinge dōm gewyrce, oþðe mec dēað nimeð.” Æfter þǣm wordum Weder-Gēata lēod efste mid elne, nalas ondsware bīdan wolde; brim-wylm onfēng hilde-rince.
text_bare: Ond þu Unferð læt ealde lafe, wrætlic wæg-sweord, wid-cuðne man heard-ecg habban; ic me mid Hruntinge dom gewyrce, oþðe mec deað nimeð.” Æfter þæm wordum Weder-Geata leod efste mid elne, nalas ondsware bidan wolde; brim-wylm onfeng hilde-rince.

text: Ðā wæs hwīl dæges, ǣr hē þone grund-wong ongytan mehte.
text_bare: Ða wæs hwil dæges, ær he þone grund-wong ongytan mehte.

text: Sōna þæt onfunde, sē ðe flōda begong heoro-gīfre behēold hund missera, grim ond grǣdig, þæt þǣr gumena sum æl-wihta eard ufan cunnode.
text_bare: Sona þæt onfunde, se ðe floda begong heoro-gifre beheold hund missera, grim ond grædig, þæt þær gumena sum æl-wihta eard ufan cunnode.

text: Grāp þā, tōgēanes, gūð-rinc gefēng atolan clommum; nō þȳ ǣr in gescōd hālan līce; hring ūtan ymbbearh, þæt hēo þone fyrd-hom ðurhfōn ne mihte, locene leoðo-syrcan, lāþan fingrum.
text_bare: Grap þa, togeanes, guð-rinc gefeng atolan clommum; no þy ær in gescod halan lice; hring utan ymbbearh, þæt heo þone fyrd-hom ðurhfon ne mihte, locene leoðo-syrcan, laþan fingrum.

text: Bær þā sēo brim-wylf, þā hēo tō botme cōm, hringa þengel tō hofe sīnum, swā hē ne mihte nō hē þēah mōdig wæs wǣpna gewealdan; ac hine wundra þæs fela swencte on sunde, sǣ-dēor monig hilde-tuxum here-syrcan bræc, ēhton āglǣcan.
text_bare: Bær þa seo brim-wylf, þa heo to botme com, hringa þengel to hofe sinum, swa he ne mihte no he þeah modig wæs wæpna gewealdan; ac hine wundra þæs fela swencte on sunde, sæ-deor monig hilde-tuxum here-syrcan bræc, ehton aglæcan.

text: Ðā se eorl ongeat, þæt hē in nīð-sele nāt-hwylcum wæs, þǣr him nǣnig wæter wihte ne sceþede, ne him for hrōf-sele hrīnan ne mehte fǣr-gripe flōdes; fȳr-lēoht geseah, blācne lēoman beorhte scīnan.
text_bare: Ða se eorl ongeat, þæt he in nið-sele nat-hwylcum wæs, þær him nænig wæter wihte ne sceþede, ne him for hrof-sele hrinan ne mehte fær-gripe flodes; fyr-leoht geseah, blacne leoman beorhte scinan.

text: Ongeat þā se gōda grund-wyrgenne, mere-wīf mihtig; mægen-rǣs forgeaf hilde-bille, hond swenge ne oftēah, þæt hire on hafelan hring-mǣl āgōl grǣdig gūð-lēoð.
text_bare: Ongeat þa se goda grund-wyrgenne, mere-wif mihtig; mægen-ræs forgeaf hilde-bille, hond swenge ne ofteah, þæt hire on hafelan hring-mæl agol grædig guð-leoð.

text: Ðā se gist onfand, þæt se beado-lēoma bītan nolde, aldre sceþðan, ac sēo ecg geswāc ðēodne æt þearfe; ðolode ǣr fela hond-gemōta, helm oft gescær, fǣges fyrd-hrægl; ðā wæs forma sīð dēorum mādme, þæt his dōm ālæg.
text_bare: Ða se gist onfand, þæt se beado-leoma bitan nolde, aldre sceþðan, ac seo ecg geswac ðeodne æt þearfe; ðolode ær fela hond-gemota, helm oft gescær, fæges fyrd-hrægl; ða wæs forma sið deorum madme, þæt his dom alæg.

text: Eft wæs ān-rǣd, nalas elnes læt, mǣrða gemyndig, mǣg Hygelāces.
text_bare: Eft wæs an-ræd, nalas elnes læt, mærða gemyndig, mæg Hygelaces.

text: Wearp ðā wunden-mǣl wrættum gebunden yrre ōretta, þæt hit on eorðan læg, stīð ond stȳl-ecg; strenge getrūwode, mund-gripe mægenes.
text_bare: Wearp ða wunden-mæl wrættum gebunden yrre oretta, þæt hit on eorðan læg, stið ond styl-ecg; strenge getruwode, mund-gripe mægenes.

text: Swā sceal man dōn, þonne hē æt gūðe gegān þenceð longsumne lof, nā ymb his līf cearað.
text_bare: Swa sceal man don, þonne he æt guðe gegan þenceð longsumne lof, na ymb his lif cearað.

text: Gefēng þā be eaxle nalas for fǣhðe mearn Gūð-Gēata lēod Grendles mōdor, brægd þā beadwe heard, þā hē gebolgen wæs, feorh-genīðlan, þæt hēo on flet gebēah.
text_bare: Gefeng þa be eaxle nalas for fæhðe mearn Guð-Geata leod Grendles modor, brægd þa beadwe heard, þa he gebolgen wæs, feorh-geniðlan, þæt heo on flet gebeah.

text: Hēo him eft hraðe hand-lēan forgeald grimman grāpum, ond him tōgēanes fēng; oferwearp þā wērig-mōd wigena strengest, fēþe-cempa, þæt hē on fylle wearð.
text_bare: Heo him eft hraðe hand-lean forgeald grimman grapum, ond him togeanes feng; oferwearp þa werig-mod wigena strengest, feþe-cempa, þæt he on fylle wearð.

text: Ofsæt þā þone sele-gyst, ond hyre seax getēah brād, brūn-ecg, wolde hire bearn wrecan, āngan eaferan.
text_bare: Ofsæt þa þone sele-gyst, ond hyre seax geteah brad, brun-ecg, wolde hire bearn wrecan, angan eaferan.

text: Him on eaxle læg brēost-net brōden; þæt gebearh fēore, wið ord ond wið ecge ingang forstōd.
text_bare: Him on eaxle læg breost-net broden; þæt gebearh feore, wið ord ond wið ecge ingang forstod.

text: Hæfde ðā forsīðod sunu Ecgþēowes under gynne grund, Gēata cempa, nemne him heaðo-byrne helpe gefremede, here-net hearde, ond hālig God gewēold wīg-sigor, wītig Drihten, rodera Rǣdend hit on ryht gescēd ȳðelīce; syþðan hē eft āstōd.
text_bare: Hæfde ða forsiðod sunu Ecgþeowes under gynne grund, Geata cempa, nemne him heaðo-byrne helpe gefremede, here-net hearde, ond halig God geweold wig-sigor, witig Drihten, rodera Rædend hit on ryht gesced yðelice; syþðan he eft astod.

text: Geseah ðā on searwum sige-ēadig bil, eald sweord eotenisc, ecgum þyhtig, wigena weorð-mynd; þæt wæs wǣpna cyst, būton hit wæs māre ðonne ǣnig mon ōðer tō beadu-lāce ætberan meahte, gōd ond geatolīc, gīganta geweorc.
text_bare: Geseah ða on searwum sige-eadig bil, eald sweord eotenisc, ecgum þyhtig, wigena weorð-mynd; þæt wæs wæpna cyst, buton hit wæs mare ðonne ænig mon oðer to beadu-lace ætberan meahte, god ond geatolic, giganta geweorc.

text: Hē gefēng þā fetel-hilt, freca Scyldinga hrēoh ond heoro-grim hring-mǣl gebrægd, aldres orwēna yrringa slōh, þæt hire wið halse heard grāpode, bān-hringas bræc; bil eal ðurhwōd fǣgne flǣsc-homan; hēo on flet gecrong.
text_bare: He gefeng þa fetel-hilt, freca Scyldinga hreoh ond heoro-grim hring-mæl gebrægd, aldres orwena yrringa sloh, þæt hire wið halse heard grapode, ban-hringas bræc; bil eal ðurhwod fægne flæsc-homan; heo on flet gecrong.

text: Sweord wæs swātig; secg weorce gefeh.
text_bare: Sweord wæs swatig; secg weorce gefeh.

text: Līxte se lēoma, lēoht inne stōd, efne swā of hefene hādre scīneð rodores candel.
text_bare: Lixte se leoma, leoht inne stod, efne swa of hefene hadre scineð rodores candel.

text: Hē æfter recede wlāt, hwearf þā be wealle; wǣpen hafenade heard be hiltum Higelāces ðegn yrre ond ān-rǣd.
text_bare: He æfter recede wlat, hwearf þa be wealle; wæpen hafenade heard be hiltum Higelaces ðegn yrre ond an-ræd.

text: Næs sēo ecg fracod hilde-rince, ac hē hraþe wolde Grendle forgyldan gūð-rǣsa fela, ðāra þe hē geworhte tō West-Denum oftor micle ðonne on ǣnne sīð, þonne he Hrōðgāres heorð-genēatas slōh on sweofote, slǣpende fræt folces Denigea fȳf-tȳne men, ond ōðer swylc ūt offerede, lāðlicu lāc.
text_bare: Næs seo ecg fracod hilde-rince, ac he hraþe wolde Grendle forgyldan guð-ræsa fela, ðara þe he geworhte to West-Denum oftor micle ðonne on ænne sið, þonne he Hroðgares heorð-geneatas sloh on sweofote, slæpende fræt folces Denigea fyf-tyne men, ond oðer swylc ut offerede, laðlicu lac.

text: Hē him þæs lēan forgeald, rēþe cempa, tō ðæs þe hē on ræste geseah gūð-wērigne Grendel licgan, aldor-lēasne, swā him ǣr gescōd hild æt Heorote.
text_bare: He him þæs lean forgeald, reþe cempa, to ðæs þe he on ræste geseah guð-werigne Grendel licgan, aldor-leasne, swa him ær gescod hild æt Heorote.

text: Hrā wīde sprong, syþðan hē æfter dēaðe drepe þrōwade, heoro-sweng heardne; ond hine þā hēafde becearf.
text_bare: Hra wide sprong, syþðan he æfter deaðe drepe þrowade, heoro-sweng heardne; ond hine þa heafde becearf.

text: Sōna þæt gesāwon snottre ceorlas, þā ðe mid Hrōðgāre on holm wliton, þæt wæs ȳð-geblond eal gemenged, brim blōde fāh.
text_bare: Sona þæt gesawon snottre ceorlas, þa ðe mid Hroðgare on holm wliton, þæt wæs yð-geblond eal gemenged, brim blode fah.

text: Blonden-feaxe gomele ymb gōdne on geador sprǣcon, þæt hig þæs æðelinges eft ne wēndon, þæt hē sige-hrēðig sēcean cōme mǣrne þēoden, þā ðæs monige gewearð, þæt hine sēo brim-wylf ābroten hæfde.
text_bare: Blonden-feaxe gomele ymb godne on geador spræcon, þæt hig þæs æðelinges eft ne wendon, þæt he sige-hreðig secean come mærne þeoden, þa ðæs monige gewearð, þæt hine seo brim-wylf abroten hæfde.

text: Ðā cōm nōn dæges; næs ofgēafon hwate Scyldingas; gewāt him hām þonon gold-wine gumena.
text_bare: Ða com non dæges; næs ofgeafon hwate Scyldingas; gewat him ham þonon gold-wine gumena.

text: Gistas sētan mōdes sēoce, ond on mere staredon; wiston ond ne wēndon, þæt hīe heora wine-drihten selfne gesāwon.
text_bare: Gistas setan modes seoce, ond on mere staredon; wiston ond ne wendon, þæt hie heora wine-drihten selfne gesawon.

text: Ðā þæt sweord ongan æfter heaþo-swāte hilde-gicelum, wīg-bil wanian; þæt wæs wundra sum, þæt hit eal gemealt īse gelīcost, }} ðonne forstes bend Fæder onlǣteð, onwindeð wǣl-rāpas, sē geweald hafað sǣla ond mǣla; þæt is sōð Metod.
text_bare: Ða þæt sweord ongan æfter heaþo-swate hilde-gicelum, wig-bil wanian; þæt wæs wundra sum, þæt hit eal gemealt ise gelicost, }} ðonne forstes bend Fæder onlæteð, onwindeð wæl-rapas, se geweald hafað sæla ond mæla; þæt is soð Metod.

text: Ne nōm hē in þǣm wicum, Weder-Gēata lēod, māðm-ǣhta mā, þēh hē þǣr monige geseah, būton þone hafelan ond þā hilt somod, since fāge; sweord ǣr gemealt, forbarn brōden mǣl; wæs þæt blōd tō þæs hāt, ǣttren ellor-gǣst, sē þǣr inne swealt.
text_bare: Ne nom he in þæm wicum, Weder-Geata leod, maðm-æhta ma, þeh he þær monige geseah, buton þone hafelan ond þa hilt somod, since fage; sweord ær gemealt, forbarn broden mæl; wæs þæt blod to þæs hat, ættren ellor-gæst, se þær inne swealt.

text: Sōna wæs on sunde, sē þe ǣr æt sæcce gebād wīg-hryre wrāðra, wæter ūp þurhdēaf; wǣron ȳð-gebland eal gefǣlsod, ēacne eardas, þā se ellor-gāst oflēt līf-dagas ond þās lǣnan gesceaft.
text_bare: Sona wæs on sunde, se þe ær æt sæcce gebad wig-hryre wraðra, wæter up þurhdeaf; wæron yð-gebland eal gefælsod, eacne eardas, þa se ellor-gast oflet lif-dagas ond þas lænan gesceaft.

text: Cōm þā tō lande lid-manna helm swīð-mōd swymman, sǣ-lāce gefeah, mægen-byrþenne þāra þe hē him mid hæfde.
text_bare: Com þa to lande lid-manna helm swið-mod swymman, sæ-lace gefeah, mægen-byrþenne þara þe he him mid hæfde.

text: Eodon him þā tōgēanes Gode þancodon, ðrȳðlīc þegna hēap, þēodnes gefēgon, þæs þe hī hyne gesundne gesēon mōston.
text_bare: Eodon him þa togeanes Gode þancodon, ðryðlic þegna heap, þeodnes gefegon, þæs þe hi hyne gesundne geseon moston.

text: Ðā wæs of þǣm hrōran helm ond byrne lungre ālȳsed.
text_bare: Ða wæs of þæm hroran helm ond byrne lungre alysed.

text: Lagu drūsade, wæter under wolcnum, wæl-drēore fāg.
text_bare: Lagu drusade, wæter under wolcnum, wæl-dreore fag.

text: Fērdon forð þonon fēþe-lāstum ferhþum fægne, fold-weg mæton, cūþe strǣte, cyning-balde men; from þǣm holm-clife hafelan bǣron earfoðlīce heora ǣghwæþrum fela-mōdigra; fēower scoldon on þǣm wæl-stenge weorcum geferian tō þǣm gold-sele Grendles hēafod, oþ ðæt semninga tō sele cōmon frome, fyrd-hwate, fēower-tȳne Gēata gongan; gum-dryhten mid, mōdig on gemonge, meodo-wongas træd.
text_bare: Ferdon forð þonon feþe-lastum ferhþum fægne, fold-weg mæton, cuþe stræte, cyning-balde men; from þæm holm-clife hafelan bæron earfoðlice heora æghwæþrum fela-modigra; feower scoldon on þæm wæl-stenge weorcum geferian to þæm gold-sele Grendles heafod, oþ ðæt semninga to sele comon frome, fyrd-hwate, feower-tyne Geata gongan; gum-dryhten mid, modig on gemonge, meodo-wongas træd.

text: Ðā cōm in gān ealdor ðegna, dǣd-cēne mon dōme gewurþad, hæle hilde-dēor, Hrōðgār grētan.
text_bare: Ða com in gan ealdor ðegna, dæd-cene mon dome gewurþad, hæle hilde-deor, Hroðgar gretan.

text: Þā wæs be feaxe on flet boren Grendles hēafod, þǣr guman druncon, egeslīc for eorlum ond þǣre idese mid; wlite-sēon wrætlīc weras onsāwon.
text_bare: Þa wæs be feaxe on flet boren Grendles heafod, þær guman druncon, egeslic for eorlum ond þære idese mid; wlite-seon wrætlic weras onsawon.

text: Bēowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþēowes: “Hwæt!
text_bare: Beowulf maþelode, bearn Ecgþeowes: “Hwæt!

text: wē þē þās sǣ-lāc, sunu Healfdenes lēod Scyldinga, lustum brōhton tīres tō tācne, þe þū hēr tō lōcast.
text_bare: we þe þas sæ-lac, sunu Healfdenes leod Scyldinga, lustum brohton tires to tacne, þe þu her to locast.

text: Ic þæt unsōfte ealdre gedīgde, wigge under wætere weorc genēþde earfoðlice; ætrihte wæs gūð getwǣfed, nymðe mec God scylde.
text_bare: Ic þæt unsofte ealdre gedigde, wigge under wætere weorc geneþde earfoðlice; ætrihte wæs guð getwæfed, nymðe mec God scylde.

text: Ne meahte ic æt hilde mid Hruntinge wiht gewyrcan, þēah þæt wǣpen duge; ac mē geūðe ylda Waldend, þæt ic on wāge geseah wlitig hangian eald sweord ēacen oftost wīsode winigea lēasum , þæt ic ðȳ wǣpne gebrǣd.
text_bare: Ne meahte ic æt hilde mid Hruntinge wiht gewyrcan, þeah þæt wæpen duge; ac me geuðe ylda Waldend, þæt ic on wage geseah wlitig hangian eald sweord eacen oftost wisode winigea leasum , þæt ic ðy wæpne gebræd.

text: Ofslōh ðā æt þǣre sæcce, þā mē sǣl āgeald, hūses hyrdas.
text_bare: Ofsloh ða æt þære sæcce, þa me sæl ageald, huses hyrdas.

text: Þā þæt hilde-bil forbarn, brogden mǣl, swā þæt blōd gesprang, hātost heaþo-swāta.
text_bare: Þa þæt hilde-bil forbarn, brogden mæl, swa þæt blod gesprang, hatost heaþo-swata.

text: Ic þæt hilt þanan fēondum ætferede, fyren-dǣda wræc, dēað-cwealm Denigea, swā hit gedēfe wæs.
text_bare: Ic þæt hilt þanan feondum ætferede, fyren-dæda wræc, deað-cwealm Denigea, swa hit gedefe wæs.

text: Ic hit þē þonne gehāte, þæt þū on Heorote mōst sorh-lēas swefan mid þīnra secga gedryht, ond þegna gehwylc þinra lēoda, duguðe ond iogoþe; þæt þū him ondrǣdan ne þearft, þēoden Scyldinga, on þā healfe aldor-bealu eorliim, swā þū ǣr dydest.” Ðā wæs gylden hilt gamelum rince, hārum hild-fruman, on hand gyfen, enta ǣr-geweorc; hit on ǣht gehwearf, æfter dēofla hryre, Denigea frēan, wundor-smiþa geweorc; ond þā þās worold ofgeaf grom-heort guma, Godes ondsaca, morðres scyldig, ond his mōdor ēac, on geweald gehwearf worold-cyninga ðǣm sēlestan be sǣm twēonum, ðāra þe on Sceden-igge sceattas dǣlde.
text_bare: Ic hit þe þonne gehate, þæt þu on Heorote most sorh-leas swefan mid þinra secga gedryht, ond þegna gehwylc þinra leoda, duguðe ond iogoþe; þæt þu him ondrædan ne þearft, þeoden Scyldinga, on þa healfe aldor-bealu eorliim, swa þu ær dydest.” Ða wæs gylden hilt gamelum rince, harum hild-fruman, on hand gyfen, enta ær-geweorc; hit on æht gehwearf, æfter deofla hryre, Denigea frean, wundor-smiþa geweorc; ond þa þas worold ofgeaf grom-heort guma, Godes ondsaca, morðres scyldig, ond his modor eac, on geweald gehwearf worold-cyninga ðæm selestan be sæm tweonum, ðara þe on Sceden-igge sceattas dælde.

text: Hrōðgār maðelode, hylt scēawode, ealde lāfe, on ðǣm wæs ōr writen fyrn-gewinnes, syðþan flōd ofslōh, gifen gēotende, gīganta cyn; frēcne gefērdon; þæt wæs fremde þēod ēcean Dryhtne; him þæs ende-lēan þurh wæteres wylm Waldend sealde.
text_bare: Hroðgar maðelode, hylt sceawode, ealde lafe, on ðæm wæs or writen fyrn-gewinnes, syðþan flod ofsloh, gifen geotende, giganta cyn; frecne geferdon; þæt wæs fremde þeod ecean Dryhtne; him þæs ende-lean þurh wæteres wylm Waldend sealde.

text: Gif him þonne Hrēþrīc tō hofum Gēata geþingeð, þēodnes bearn, hē mæg þǣr fela frēonda findan; feor-cȳþðe bēoð sēlran gesōhte, þǣm þe him selfa dēah.” Hrōðgār maþelode him on ondsware: “Þē þā word-cwydas wittig Drihten on sefan sende; ne hȳrde ic snotorlīcor on swā geongum fēore guman þingian; þū eart mægenes strang ond on mōde frōd, wīs word-cwida.

text: Þā wæs on sande sǣ-gēap naca hladen here-wǣdum, hringed-stefna mēarum ond māðmum; mæst hlīfade ofer Hrōðgāres hord-gestrēonum.
text_bare: Þa wæs on sande sæ-geap naca hladen here-wædum, hringed-stefna mearum ond maðmum; mæst hlifade ofer Hroðgares hord-gestreonum.

text: Hē þǣm bāt-wearde bunden golde swurd gesealde, þæt hē syðþan wæs on meodu-bence māþme þȳ weorþra, yrfe-lāfe.
text_bare: He þæm bat-wearde bunden golde swurd gesealde, þæt he syðþan wæs on meodu-bence maþme þy weorþra, yrfe-lafe.

text: Gewāt him on nacan drēfan dēop wæter, Dena land ofgeaf.
text_bare: Gewat him on nacan drefan deop wæter, Dena land ofgeaf.

text: Þā wæs be mæste mere-hrægla sum, segl sāle fæst; sund-wudu þunede; nō þǣr wēg-flotan wind ofer ȳðum sīðes getwǣfde; sǣ-genga fōr, flēat fāmig-heals forð ofer ȳðe, bunden-stefna ofer brim-strēamas, þæt hīe Gēata clifu ongitan meahton, cūþe næssas; cēol ūp geþrang lyft-geswenced, on lande stōd.
text_bare: Þa wæs be mæste mere-hrægla sum, segl sale fæst; sund-wudu þunede; no þær weg-flotan wind ofer yðum siðes getwæfde; sæ-genga for, fleat famig-heals forð ofer yðe, bunden-stefna ofer brim-streamas, þæt hie Geata clifu ongitan meahton, cuþe næssas; ceol up geþrang lyft-geswenced, on lande stod.

text: Hraþe wæs æt holme hȳð-weard gearu, sē þe ǣr lange tīd lēofra manna fūs æt faroð feor wlātode; sǣlde tō sande sīd-fæþme scip oncer-bendum fæst, þȳ lǣs hym ȳþa ðrym wudu wynsuman forwrecan meahte.
text_bare: Hraþe wæs æt holme hyð-weard gearu, se þe ær lange tid leofra manna fus æt faroð feor wlatode; sælde to sande sid-fæþme scip oncer-bendum fæst, þy læs hym yþa ðrym wudu wynsuman forwrecan meahte.

text: Hēt þā ūp beran æþelinga gestrēon, frætwe ond fǣt-gold; næs him feor þanon tō gesēcanne sinces bryttan, Higelāc Hrēþling, þǣr æt hām wunað selfa mid gesīðum sǣ-wealle nēah.
text_bare: Het þa up beran æþelinga gestreon, frætwe ond fæt-gold; næs him feor þanon to gesecanne sinces bryttan, Higelac Hreþling, þær æt ham wunað selfa mid gesiðum sæ-wealle neah.

text: Bold wæs betlīc, brego rōf cyning, hēa healle, Hygd swīðe geong, wīs, wel þungen, þēah ðe wintra lȳt under burh-locan gebiden hæbbe Hæreþes dohtor; næs hīo hnāh swā þēah, ne tō gnēað gifa Gēata lēodum, maāþm-gestrēona.
text_bare: Bold wæs betlic, brego rof cyning, hea healle, Hygd swiðe geong, wis, wel þungen, þeah ðe wintra lyt under burh-locan gebiden hæbbe Hæreþes dohtor; næs hio hnah swa þeah, ne to gneað gifa Geata leodum, maaþm-gestreona.

text: Mōd Ðrȳðo wæg, fremu folces cwēn, firen ondrysne; nǣnig þæt dorste dēor genēþan swǣsra gesīða, nefne sīn frēa, þæt hire an dæges ēagum starede; ac him wæl-bende weotode tealde hand-gewriþene; hraþe seoþðan wæs æfter mund-gripe mēce geþinged, þæt hit scēaden-mǣl scȳran mōste, cwealm-bealu cȳðan.
text_bare: Mod Ðryðo wæg, fremu folces cwen, firen ondrysne; nænig þæt dorste deor geneþan swæsra gesiða, nefne sin frea, þæt hire an dæges eagum starede; ac him wæl-bende weotode tealde hand-gewriþene; hraþe seoþðan wæs æfter mund-gripe mece geþinged, þæt hit sceaden-mæl scyran moste, cwealm-bealu cyðan.

text: Ne bið swylc cwēnlīc þēaw idese tō efnanne, þēah ðe hīo ǣnlicu sȳ, þætte freoðu-webbe fēores onsæce æfter lige-torne lēofne mannan.
text_bare: Ne bið swylc cwenlic þeaw idese to efnanne, þeah ðe hio ænlicu sy, þætte freoðu-webbe feores onsæce æfter lige-torne leofne mannan.

text: Hūru þæt onhōhsnode Hemminges mǣg.
text_bare: Huru þæt onhohsnode Hemminges mæg.

text: Ealo-drincende ōðer sǣdan, þæt hīo lēod-bealewa lǣs gefremede, inwit-nīða, syððan ǣrest wearð gyfen gold-hroden geongum cempan, æðelum dīore, syððan hīo Offan flet ofer fealone flōd be fæder lāre sīðe gesōhte; ðǣr hīo syððan well in gum-stōle, gōde mǣre, līf-gesceafta lifigende brēac, hīold hēah-lufan wið hæleþa brego, ealles mon-cynnes, mīne gefrǣge, þone sēlestan bī sǣm twēonum, eormen-cynnes.
text_bare: Ealo-drincende oðer sædan, þæt hio leod-bealewa læs gefremede, inwit-niða, syððan ærest wearð gyfen gold-hroden geongum cempan, æðelum diore, syððan hio Offan flet ofer fealone flod be fæder lare siðe gesohte; ðær hio syððan well in gum-stole, gode mære, lif-gesceafta lifigende breac, hiold heah-lufan wið hæleþa brego, ealles mon-cynnes, mine gefræge, þone selestan bi sæm tweonum, eormen-cynnes.

text: Forðām Offa wæs, geofum ond gūðum gār-cēne man, wīde geweorðod; wīsdōme hēold ēðel sīnne.
text_bare: Forðam Offa wæs, geofum ond guðum gar-cene man, wide geweorðod; wisdome heold eðel sinne.

text: Þonon Ēomǣr wōc hæleðum tō helpe, Hemminges mǣg, nefa Gārmundes, niða cræftig.
text_bare: Þonon Eomær woc hæleðum to helpe, Hemminges mæg, nefa Garmundes, niða cræftig.

text: Gewāt him ðā se hearda mid his hond-scole sylf æfter sande sǣ-wong tredan, wīde waroðas; woruld-candel scān, sigel sūðan fūs; hī sīð drugon, elne geēodon, tō ðæs þe eorla hlēo, bonan Ongenþēoes burgum in innan, geongne gūð-cyning gōdne gefrūnon hringas dǣlan.
text_bare: Gewat him ða se hearda mid his hond-scole sylf æfter sande sæ-wong tredan, wide waroðas; woruld-candel scan, sigel suðan fus; hi sið drugon, elne geeodon, to ðæs þe eorla hleo, bonan Ongenþeoes burgum in innan, geongne guð-cyning godne gefrunon hringas dælan.

text: Higelāce wæs sīð Bēowulfes snūde gecȳðed, þæt ðǣr on worðig wīgendra hlēo, lind-gestealla, lifigende cwōm, heaðo-lāces hāl tō hofe gongan.
text_bare: Higelace wæs sið Beowulfes snude gecyðed, þæt ðær on worðig wigendra hleo, lind-gestealla, lifigende cwom, heaðo-laces hal to hofe gongan.

text: Hraðe wæs gerȳmed, swa se rīca bebēad, fēðe-gestum flet innan-weard.
text_bare: Hraðe wæs gerymed, swa se rica bebead, feðe-gestum flet innan-weard.

text: Gesæt þā wið sylfne, sē ðā sæcce genæs, mǣg wið mǣge, syððan man-diyhten þurh hlēoðor-cwyde holdne gegrētte meaglum wordum.
text_bare: Gesæt þa wið sylfne, se ða sæcce genæs, mæg wið mæge, syððan man-diyhten þurh hleoðor-cwyde holdne gegrette meaglum wordum.

text: Meodu-scencum hwearf geond þæt heal-reced Hæreðes dohtor, lufode ðā lēode, lið-wǣge bær hælum tō handa.
text_bare: Meodu-scencum hwearf geond þæt heal-reced Hæreðes dohtor, lufode ða leode, lið-wæge bær hælum to handa.

text: Higelāc ongan sīnne geseldan in sele þām hēan fægre fricgcean, hyne fyrwet bræc, hwylce Sǣ-Gēata sīðas wǣron: “Hū lomp ēow on lāde, lēofa Bīowulf, þā ðū fǣringa feorr gehogodest sæcce sēcean ofer sealt wæter, hilde tō Hiorote?
text_bare: Higelac ongan sinne geseldan in sele þam hean fægre fricgcean, hyne fyrwet bræc, hwylce Sæ-Geata siðas wæron: “Hu lomp eow on lade, leofa Biowulf, þa ðu færinga feorr gehogodest sæcce secean ofer sealt wæter, hilde to Hiorote?

text: Ac ðū Hrōðgāre wīd-cūðne wēan wihte gebēttest, mǣrum ðēodne?
text_bare: Ac ðu Hroðgare wid-cuðne wean wihte gebettest, mærum ðeodne?

text: Ic ðæs mōd-ceare sorh-wylmum sēað, sīðe ne trūwode lēofes mannes.
text_bare: Ic ðæs mod-ceare sorh-wylmum seað, siðe ne truwode leofes mannes.

text: Ic ðē lange bæd, þæt ðū þone wæl-gæst wihte ne grētte, lēte Sūð-Dene sylfe geweorðan gūðe wið Grendel.
text_bare: Ic ðe lange bæd, þæt ðu þone wæl-gæst wihte ne grette, lete Suð-Dene sylfe geweorðan guðe wið Grendel.

text: Gode ic þanc secge, þæs ðe ic ðē gesundne gesēon mōste.” Bīowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgðīoes: “Þæt is undyrne, dryhten Higelāc, mǣre gemēting, monegum fīra, hwylc orleg-hwīl uncer Grendles wearð on ðām wange, þǣr hē worna fela Sige-Scyldingum sorge gefremede, yrmðe tō aldre; ic ðæt eall gewræc, swā ne gylpan þearf Grendeles māga ǣnig ofer eorðan ūht-hlem þone, sē þe lengest leofað lāðan cynnes fenne bifongen.
text_bare: Gode ic þanc secge, þæs ðe ic ðe gesundne geseon moste.” Biowulf maðelode, bearn Ecgðioes: “Þæt is undyrne, dryhten Higelac, mære gemeting, monegum fira, hwylc orleg-hwil uncer Grendles wearð on ðam wange, þær he worna fela Sige-Scyldingum sorge gefremede, yrmðe to aldre; ic ðæt eall gewræc, swa ne gylpan þearf Grendeles maga ænig ofer eorðan uht-hlem þone, se þe lengest leofað laðan cynnes fenne bifongen.

text: Ic ðǣr furðum cwōm tō ðām hring-sele Hrōðgār grētan; sōna mē se mǣra mago Healfdenes, syððan hē mōd-sefan mīnne cūðe, wið his sylfes sunu setl getǣhte.
text_bare: Ic ðær furðum cwom to ðam hring-sele Hroðgar gretan; sona me se mæra mago Healfdenes, syððan he mod-sefan minne cuðe, wið his sylfes sunu setl getæhte.

text: Weorod wæs on wynne; ne seah ic wīdan feorh under heofones hwealf heal-sittendra medu-drēam māran.
text_bare: Weorod wæs on wynne; ne seah ic widan feorh under heofones hwealf heal-sittendra medu-dream maran.

text: Hwīlum mǣru cwēn, friðu-sibb folca, flet eall geond-hwearf, bǣdde byre geonge; oft hīo bēah-wriðan secge sealde, ær hīo tō setle gēong.
text_bare: Hwilum mæru cwen, friðu-sibb folca, flet eall geond-hwearf, bædde byre geonge; oft hio beah-wriðan secge sealde, ær hio to setle geong.

text: Hwīlum for duguðe dohtor Hrōðgāres eorlum on ende ealu-wǣge bær, þā ic Frēaware flet-sittende nemnan hȳrde, þǣr hīo nægled sinc hæleðum sealde.
text_bare: Hwilum for duguðe dohtor Hroðgares eorlum on ende ealu-wæge bær, þa ic Freaware flet-sittende nemnan hyrde, þær hio nægled sinc hæleðum sealde.

text: Sīo gehāten wæs, geong, gold-hroden, gladum suna Frōdan; hafað þæs geworden wine Scyldinga, rīces hyrde, ond þæt rǣd talað, þæt hē mid ðȳ wīfe wæl-fǣhða dǣl, sæcca, gesette.
text_bare: Sio gehaten wæs, geong, gold-hroden, gladum suna Frodan; hafað þæs geworden wine Scyldinga, rices hyrde, ond þæt ræd talað, þæt he mid ðy wife wæl-fæhða dæl, sæcca, gesette.

text: Oft, nō seldan, hwǣr æfter lēod-hryre lȳtle hwīle bon-gār būgeð, þēah sēo brȳd duge.
text_bare: Oft, no seldan, hwær æfter leod-hryre lytle hwile bon-gar bugeð, þeah seo bryd duge.

text: Mæg þæs þonne ofþyncan ðēoden Heaðobeardna ond þegna gehwām þāra lēoda, þonne hē mid fǣmnan on flett gǣð, dryht-bearn Dena duguða biwenede; on him gladiað gomelra lāfe heard ond hring-mǣl, Heaðobeardna gestrēon, þenden hīe ðām wǣpnum wealdan mōston,
text_bare: Mæg þæs þonne ofþyncan ðeoden Heaðobeardna ond þegna gehwam þara leoda, þonne he mid fæmnan on flett gæð, dryht-bearn Dena duguða biwenede; on him gladiað gomelra lafe heard ond hring-mæl, Heaðobeardna gestreon, þenden hie ðam wæpnum wealdan moston,

text: oð ðæt hīe forlǣddan tō ðām lind-plegan swǣse gesīðas ond hyra sylfra feorh.
text_bare: oð ðæt hie forlæddan to ðam lind-plegan swæse gesiðas ond hyra sylfra feorh.

text: Þonne cwið aæt bēore, sē ðe bēah gesyhð, eald æsc-wiga, sē ðe eall geman, gār-cwealm gumena him bið grim sefa , onginneð gēomor-mōd geongum cempan þurh hreðra gehygd higes cunnian, wīg-bealu weccean, ond þæt word ācwyð: ‘Meaht ðū, mīn wine, mēce gecnāwan, þone þīn fæder tō gefeohte bær under here-grīman hindeman sīðe, dȳre īren, þǣr hyne Dene slōgon, wēoldon wæl-stōwe, syððan Wiðergyld læg, æfter hæleþa hryre, hwate Scyldungas?
text_bare: Þonne cwið aæt beore, se ðe beah gesyhð, eald æsc-wiga, se ðe eall geman, gar-cwealm gumena him bið grim sefa , onginneð geomor-mod geongum cempan þurh hreðra gehygd higes cunnian, wig-bealu weccean, ond þæt word acwyð: ‘Meaht ðu, min wine, mece gecnawan, þone þin fæder to gefeohte bær under here-griman hindeman siðe, dyre iren, þær hyne Dene slogon, weoldon wæl-stowe, syððan Wiðergyld læg, æfter hæleþa hryre, hwate Scyldungas?

text: Nū hēr þāra banena byre nāt-hwylces frætwum hrēmig on flet gǣð, morðres gylpeð, ond þone māðþum byreð, þone þe ðū mid rihte rǣdan sceoldest.’ Manað swā ond myndgað mǣla gehwylce sārum wordum, oð ðæt sǣl cymeð, þæt se fǣmnan þegn fore fæder dǣdum æfter billes bite blōd-fāg swefeð, ealdres scyldig; him se ōðer þonan losað lifigende, con him land geare.
text_bare: Nu her þara banena byre nat-hwylces frætwum hremig on flet gæð, morðres gylpeð, ond þone maðþum byreð, þone þe ðu mid rihte rædan sceoldest.’ Manað swa ond myndgað mæla gehwylce sarum wordum, oð ðæt sæl cymeð, þæt se fæmnan þegn fore fæder dædum æfter billes bite blod-fag swefeð, ealdres scyldig; him se oðer þonan losað lifigende, con him land geare.

text: Þonne bīoð brocene on bā healfe āð-sweord eorla, syððan Ingelde weallað wæl-nīðas, ond him wīf-lufan æfter cear-wælmum cōlran weorðað.
text_bare: Þonne bioð brocene on ba healfe að-sweord eorla, syððan Ingelde weallað wæl-niðas, ond him wif-lufan æfter cear-wælmum colran weorðað.

text: Þȳ ic Heaðobeardna hyldo ne telge, dryht-sibbe dǣl, Denum unfǣcne, frēond-scipe fæstne.
text_bare: Þy ic Heaðobeardna hyldo ne telge, dryht-sibbe dæl, Denum unfæcne, freond-scipe fæstne.

text: Ic sceal forð sprecan gēn ymbe Grendel, þæt ðū geare cunne, sinces brytta, tō hwan syððan wearð hond-rǣs hæleða.
text_bare: Ic sceal forð sprecan gen ymbe Grendel, þæt ðu geare cunne, sinces brytta, to hwan syððan wearð hond-ræs hæleða.

text: Syððan heofones gim glād ofer grundas, gæst yrre cwōm, eatol ǣfen-grom, ūser nēosan, ðǣr wē gesunde sæl weardodon.
text_bare: Syððan heofones gim glad ofer grundas, gæst yrre cwom, eatol æfen-grom, user neosan, ðær we gesunde sæl weardodon.

text: þǣr wæs Hondscīo hild onsǣge, feorh-bealu fǣgum; hē fyrmest læg, gyrded cempa; him Grendel wearð, mǣrum magu-þegne, tō mūð-bonan, lēofes mannes līc eall forswealg.
text_bare: þær wæs Hondscio hild onsæge, feorh-bealu fægum; he fyrmest læg, gyrded cempa; him Grendel wearð, mærum magu-þegne, to muð-bonan, leofes mannes lic eall forswealg.

text: Nō ðȳ ǣr ūt ðā gēn īdel-hende bona blōdig-tōð, bealewa gemyndig, of ðām gold-sele gongan wolde; ac hē mægnes rōf mīn costode, grāpode gearo-folm.
text_bare: No ðy ær ut ða gen idel-hende bona blodig-toð, bealewa gemyndig, of ðam gold-sele gongan wolde; ac he mægnes rof min costode, grapode gearo-folm.

text: Glōf hangode sīd ond syllīc, searo-bendum fæst; sīo wæs orðoncum eall gegyrwed dēofles cræftum ond dracan fellum.
text_bare: Glof hangode sid ond syllic, searo-bendum fæst; sio wæs orðoncum eall gegyrwed deofles cræftum ond dracan fellum.

text: Hē mec þǣr on innan unsynnigne, dīor dǣd-fruma, gedōn wolde manigra sumne; hyt ne mihte swā, syððan ic on yrre upp-riht āstōd.
text_bare: He mec þær on innan unsynnigne, dior dæd-fruma, gedon wolde manigra sumne; hyt ne mihte swa, syððan ic on yrre upp-riht astod.

text: Tō lang ys tō reccenne, hū ic ðām lēod-sceaðan yfla gehwylces hond-lean forgeald; þǣr ic, þēoden mīn, þīne lēode weorðode weorcum.
text_bare: To lang ys to reccenne, hu ic ðam leod-sceaðan yfla gehwylces hond-lean forgeald; þær ic, þeoden min, þine leode weorðode weorcum.

text: Hē onweg losade, lȳtle hwīle līf-wynna brēac; hwæþre him sīo swīðre swaðe weardade hand on Hiorte, ond hē hēan ðonan, mōdes gēomor, mere-grund gefēoll.
text_bare: He onweg losade, lytle hwile lif-wynna breac; hwæþre him sio swiðre swaðe weardade hand on Hiorte, ond he hean ðonan, modes geomor, mere-grund gefeoll.

text: Mē þone wæl-rǣs wine Scildunga fǣttan golde fela lēanode, manegum māðmum, syððan mergen cōm, ond wē tō symble geseten hæfdon.
text_bare: Me þone wæl-ræs wine Scildunga fættan golde fela leanode, manegum maðmum, syððan mergen com, ond we to symble geseten hæfdon.

text: Þǣr wæs gidd ond glēo.
text_bare: Þær wæs gidd ond gleo.

text: Gomela Scilding, fela fricgende, feorran rehte; hwīlum hilde-dēor hearpan wynne, gomen-wudu grētte, hwīlum gyd āwræc sōð ond sārlīc; hwīlum syllīc spell rehte æfter rihte rūm-heort cyning; hwīlum eft ongan eldo gebunden, gomel gūð-wiga gioguðe cwīðau hilde-strengo; hreðer inne wēoll, þonne hē wintrum frōd worn gemunde.
text_bare: Gomela Scilding, fela fricgende, feorran rehte; hwilum hilde-deor hearpan wynne, gomen-wudu grette, hwilum gyd awræc soð ond sarlic; hwilum syllic spell rehte æfter rihte rum-heort cyning; hwilum eft ongan eldo gebunden, gomel guð-wiga gioguðe cwiðau hilde-strengo; hreðer inne weoll, þonne he wintrum frod worn gemunde.

text: Swā wē þǣr inne ondlangne dæg nīode nāman, oð ðæt niht becwōm ōðer tō yldum.
text_bare: Swa we þær inne ondlangne dæg niode naman, oð ðæt niht becwom oðer to yldum.

text: Þā wæs eft hraðe gearo gyrn-wræce Grendeles mōdor, sīðode sorh-full; sunu dēað fornam, wīg-hete Wedra.
text_bare: Þa wæs eft hraðe gearo gyrn-wræce Grendeles modor, siðode sorh-full; sunu deað fornam, wig-hete Wedra.

text: Wīf unhȳre hyre bearn gewræc, beorn ācwealde ellenlīce; þǣr wæs Æschere, frōdan fyrn-witan, feorh ūð-genge.
text_bare: Wif unhyre hyre bearn gewræc, beorn acwealde ellenlice; þær wæs Æschere, frodan fyrn-witan, feorh uð-genge.

text: Nōðer hȳ hine ne mōston, syððan mergen cwōm, dēað-wērigne Denia lēode, bronde forbærnan, ne on bǣl hladan lēofne mannan; hīo þæt līc ætbær fēondes fæðmum under firgen-strēam.
text_bare: Noðer hy hine ne moston, syððan mergen cwom, deað-werigne Denia leode, bronde forbærnan, ne on bæl hladan leofne mannan; hio þæt lic ætbær feondes fæðmum under firgen-stream.

text: Þæt wæs Hrōðgāre hrēowa tornost, þāra þe lēod-fruman lange begēate.
text_bare: Þæt wæs Hroðgare hreowa tornost, þara þe leod-fruman lange begeate.

text: Þā se ðēoden mec ðīne līfe healsode hrēoh-mōd, þæt ic on holma geþring eorl-scipe efnde, ealdre genēðde, mǣrðo fremede; hē mē mēde gehēt.
text_bare: Þa se ðeoden mec ðine life healsode hreoh-mod, þæt ic on holma geþring eorl-scipe efnde, ealdre geneðde, mærðo fremede; he me mede gehet.

text: Ic ðā ðǣs wælmes, þe is wīde cūð, grimne, gryrelīcne grund-hyrde fond.
text_bare: Ic ða ðæs wælmes, þe is wide cuð, grimne, gryrelicne grund-hyrde fond.

text: Þǣr unc hwīle wæs hand-gemǣne; holm heolfre wēoll, ond ic hēafde becearf in ðām grund-sele Grendeles mōdor ēacnum ecgum; unsōfte þonan feorh oðferede; næs ic fǣge þā gyt; ac mē eorla hlēo eft gesealde māðma menigeo, maga Healfdenes.
text_bare: Þær unc hwile wæs hand-gemæne; holm heolfre weoll, ond ic heafde becearf in ðam grund-sele Grendeles modor eacnum ecgum; unsofte þonan feorh oðferede; næs ic fæge þa gyt; ac me eorla hleo eft gesealde maðma menigeo, maga Healfdenes.

text: Swā se ðēod-kyning þēawum lyfde; nealles ic ðām lēanum forloren hæfde, mægnes mēde, ac hē mē māðmas geaf, sunu Healfdenes, on mīnne sylfes dōm, ðā ic ðē, beorn-cyning, bringan wylle, ēstum geȳwan.
text_bare: Swa se ðeod-kyning þeawum lyfde; nealles ic ðam leanum forloren hæfde, mægnes mede, ac he me maðmas geaf, sunu Healfdenes, on minne sylfes dom, ða ic ðe, beorn-cyning, bringan wylle, estum geywan.

text: Gēn is eall ǣt ðē lissa gelong; ic lȳt hafo hēafod-māga nefne, Hygelāc, ðec.” Hēt ðā in beran eafor, hēafod-segn, heaðo-stēapne helm, hāre byrnan, gūð-sweord geatolīc, gyd æfter wræc: “Mē ðis hilde-sceorp Hrōðgār sealde, snotra fengel; sume worde hēt, þæt ic his ǣrest ðē ēst gesægde; cwæð þæt hyt hæfde Hiorogār cyning, lēod Scyldunga, lange hwīle; nō ðȳ ǣr suna sīnum syllan wolde, hwatum Heorowearde, þēah hē him hold wǣre, brēost-gewǣdu.
text_bare: Gen is eall æt ðe lissa gelong; ic lyt hafo heafod-maga nefne, Hygelac, ðec.” Het ða in beran eafor, heafod-segn, heaðo-steapne helm, hare byrnan, guð-sweord geatolic, gyd æfter wræc: “Me ðis hilde-sceorp Hroðgar sealde, snotra fengel; sume worde het, þæt ic his ærest ðe est gesægde; cwæð þæt hyt hæfde Hiorogar cyning, leod Scyldunga, lange hwile; no ðy ær suna sinum syllan wolde, hwatum Heorowearde, þeah he him hold wære, breost-gewædu.

text: Brūc ealles well.” Hȳrde ic, þæt þām frætwum fēower mēaras lungre gelīce lāst weardode, æppel-fealuwe; hē him ēst getēah mēara ond māðma.
text_bare: Bruc ealles well.” Hyrde ic, þæt þam frætwum feower mearas lungre gelice last weardode, æppel-fealuwe; he him est geteah meara ond maðma.

text: Swā sceal mǣg dōn, nealles inwit-net ōðrum bregdon, dyrnum cræfte dēað rēnian hond-gesteallan.
text_bare: Swa sceal mæg don, nealles inwit-net oðrum bregdon, dyrnum cræfte deað renian hond-gesteallan.

text: Hygelāce wæs nīða heardum nefa swȳðe hold, ond gehwǣðer ōðrum hrōþra gemyndig.
text_bare: Hygelace wæs niða heardum nefa swyðe hold, ond gehwæðer oðrum hroþra gemyndig.

text: Hȳrde ic, þæt hē ðone heals-bēah Hygde gesealde, wrætlīcne wundur-māððum, ðone þe him Wealhðēo geaf, ðēodnes dohtor, þrīo wicg somod swancor ond sadol-beorht; hyre syððan wæs, æfter bēah-ðege, brēost geweorðod.
text_bare: Hyrde ic, þæt he ðone heals-beah Hygde gesealde, wrætlicne wundur-maððum, ðone þe him Wealhðeo geaf, ðeodnes dohtor, þrio wicg somod swancor ond sadol-beorht; hyre syððan wæs, æfter beah-ðege, breost geweorðod.

text: Swā bealdode bearn Ecgðēowes, guma gūðum cūð, gōdum dǣdum, drēah æfter dōme, nealles druncne slōg heorð-genēatas; næs him hrēoh sefa, ac hē man-cynnes mǣste cræfte gin-fæstan gife, þe him God sealde, hēold hilde-dēor.
text_bare: Swa bealdode bearn Ecgðeowes, guma guðum cuð, godum dædum, dreah æfter dome, nealles druncne slog heorð-geneatas; næs him hreoh sefa, ac he man-cynnes mæste cræfte gin-fæstan gife, þe him God sealde, heold hilde-deor.

text: Hēan wæs lange, swā hyne Gēata bearn gōdne ne tealdon, ne hyne on medo-bence micles wyrðne drihten wereda gedōn wolde; swȳðe wēndon, þæt hē slēac wǣre, aeðeling unfrom.
text_bare: Hean wæs lange, swa hyne Geata bearn godne ne tealdon, ne hyne on medo-bence micles wyrðne drihten wereda gedon wolde; swyðe wendon, þæt he sleac wære, aeðeling unfrom.

text: Edwenden cwōm tīr-ēadigum menn torna gehwylces.
text_bare: Edwenden cwom tir-eadigum menn torna gehwylces.

text: Hēt ðā eorla hlēo in gefetian, heaðo-rōf cyning, Hrēðles lāfe golde gegyrede; næs mid Gēatum ðā sinc-māðþum sēlra on sweordes hād; þæt hē on Bīowulfes bearm ālegde, ond him gesealde seofan þūsendo, bold ond brego-stōl.
text_bare: Het ða eorla hleo in gefetian, heaðo-rof cyning, Hreðles lafe golde gegyrede; næs mid Geatum ða sinc-maðþum selra on sweordes had; þæt he on Biowulfes bearm alegde, ond him gesealde seofan þusendo, bold ond brego-stol.

text: Him wæs bām samod on ðām lēod-scipe lond gecynde, eard, ēðel-riht, ōðrum swīðor sīde rīce, þām ðǣr sēlra wæs.
text_bare: Him wæs bam samod on ðam leod-scipe lond gecynde, eard, eðel-riht, oðrum swiðor side rice, þam ðær selra wæs.

text: Eft þæt geīode ufaran dōgrum hilde-hlæmmum, syððan Hygelāc læg, ond Heardrēde hilde-mēceas under bord-hrēoðan tō bonan wurdon, ðā hyne gesōhtan on sige-þēode hearde hilde-frecan, Heaðo-Scilfingas, nīða genǣgdan nefan Hererīces— syððan Bēowulfe brāde rīce on hand gehwearf.
text_bare: Eft þæt geiode ufaran dogrum hilde-hlæmmum, syððan Hygelac læg, ond Heardrede hilde-meceas under bord-hreoðan to bonan wurdon, ða hyne gesohtan on sige-þeode hearde hilde-frecan, Heaðo-Scilfingas, niða genægdan nefan Hererices— syððan Beowulfe brade rice on hand gehwearf.

text: Hē gehēold tela fīftig wintra wæs ðā frōd cyning, eald ēþel-weard , oð ðæt ān ongan deorcum nihtum draca rīcsian, sē ðe on hēaum hlǣwe hord beweotode, stān-beorh stēapne; stīg under læg eldum uncūð.
text_bare: He geheold tela fiftig wintra wæs ða frod cyning, eald eþel-weard , oð ðæt an ongan deorcum nihtum draca ricsian, se ðe on heaum hlæwe hord beweotode, stan-beorh steapne; stig under læg eldum uncuð.

text_bare: Þær on innan giong niða nat-hwylc : : : : : : : gefeng hæðnum horde hond : : : : : : : : : : : : : since fah ne he þæt syððan : : : : : þeah ðe he slæpende be syre : : : : de þeofes cræfte þæt sie ðiod : : : : : : : : : folc beorna þæt he gebolgen wæs.

text: Nealles mid gewealdum wyrm-horda cræft sōhte, sylfes willum, sē ðe him sāre gescēod; ac for þrēa-nēdlan þēow nāt-hwylces hæleða bearna hete-swengeas flēah, ærnes þearfa, ond ðǣr inne fealh, secg syn-bysig.
text_bare: Nealles mid gewealdum wyrm-horda cræft sohte, sylfes willum, se ðe him sare gesceod; ac for þrea-nedlan þeow nat-hwylces hæleða bearna hete-swengeas fleah, ærnes þearfa, ond ðær inne fealh, secg syn-bysig.

text: Sōna getīdde, þæt : : : : : ðām gyste gryre-brōga stōd; hwæðre earm-sceapen .
text_bare: Sona getidde, þæt : : : : : ðam gyste gryre-broga stod; hwæðre earm-sceapen .

text_bare: sceapen .

text: þā hyne se fǣr begeat sinc-fæt geseah.
text_bare: þa hyne se fær begeat sinc-fæt geseah.

text: Þǣr wæs swylcra fela in ðām eorð-hūse ǣr-gestrēona, swā hȳ on gēar-dagum gumena nāt-hwylc, eormen-lāfe æþelan cynnes, þanc-hycgende þǣr gehȳdde, dēore māðmas.
text_bare: Þær wæs swylcra fela in ðam eorð-huse ær-gestreona, swa hy on gear-dagum gumena nat-hwylc, eormen-lafe æþelan cynnes, þanc-hycgende þær gehydde, deore maðmas.

text: Ealle hīe dēað fornam ǣrran mǣlum, ond se ān ðā gēn lēoda duguðe, sē ðǣr lengest hwearf, wearð wine-gēomor, wēnde þæs yldan, þæt hē lȳtel fæc long-gestrēona brūcan mōste.
text_bare: Ealle hie deað fornam ærran mælum, ond se an ða gen leoda duguðe, se ðær lengest hwearf, wearð wine-geomor, wende þæs yldan, þæt he lytel fæc long-gestreona brucan moste.

text: Beorh eall gearo wunode on wonge wæter-ȳðum nēah, nīwe be næsse, nearo-cræftum fæst; þǣr on innan bær eorl-gestrēona hringa hyrde hard-fyrne dǣl, fǣttan goldes, fēa worda cwæð: “Heald þū nū, hrūse, nū hæleð ne mōstan, eorla ǣhte.
text_bare: Beorh eall gearo wunode on wonge wæter-yðum neah, niwe be næsse, nearo-cræftum fæst; þær on innan bær eorl-gestreona hringa hyrde hard-fyrne dæl, fættan goldes, fea worda cwæð: “Heald þu nu, hruse, nu hæleð ne mostan, eorla æhte.

text_bare: Hwæt!
