text: Nāh hwā sweord wege, oððe feormie fǣted wǣge, drync-fæt dēore; duguð ellor scōc.
text_bare: Nah hwa sweord wege, oððe feormie fæted wæge, drync-fæt deore; duguð ellor scoc.

text: Sceal se hearda helm hyrsted golde fǣtum befeallen; feormend swefað, þā ðe beado-grīman bȳwan sceoldon; ge swylce sēo here-pād, sīo æt hilde gebād ofer borda gebræc bite īrena, brosnað æfter beorne; ne mæg byrnan hring æfter wīg-fruman wīde fēran hæleðum be healfe.
text_bare: Sceal se hearda helm hyrsted golde fætum befeallen; feormend swefað, þa ðe beado-griman bywan sceoldon; ge swylce seo here-pad, sio æt hilde gebad ofer borda gebræc bite irena, brosnað æfter beorne; ne mæg byrnan hring æfter wig-fruman wide feran hæleðum be healfe.

text: Nis hearpan wyn, gomen glēo-bēames, ne gōd hafoc geond sæl swingeð, ne se swifta mearh burh-stede bēateð.
text_bare: Nis hearpan wyn, gomen gleo-beames, ne god hafoc geond sæl swingeð, ne se swifta mearh burh-stede beateð.

text: Bealo-cwealm hafað fela feorh-cynna forð onsended.” Swā gīomor-mōd giohðo mǣnde ān æfter eallum, unblīðe hwēop dæges ond nihtes, oð ðæt dēaðes wylm hrān æt heortan.
text_bare: Bealo-cwealm hafað fela feorh-cynna forð onsended.” Swa giomor-mod giohðo mænde an æfter eallum, unbliðe hweop dæges ond nihtes, oð ðæt deaðes wylm hran æt heortan.

text: Hord-wynne fond eald ūht-sceaða opene standan, sē ðe byrnende biorgas sēceð, nacod nīð-draca, nihtes flēogeð fȳre befangen; hyne fold-būend swīðe ondrǣdað.
text_bare: Hord-wynne fond eald uht-sceaða opene standan, se ðe byrnende biorgas seceð, nacod nið-draca, nihtes fleogeð fyre befangen; hyne fold-buend swiðe ondrædað.

text: Hē gesēcean sceall hord on hrūsan, þǣr hē hǣðen gold warað wintrum frōd; ne byð him wihte ðȳ sēl.
text_bare: He gesecean sceall hord on hrusan, þær he hæðen gold warað wintrum frod; ne byð him wihte ðy sel.

text: Swā se ðēod-sceaða þrēo hund wintra hēold on hrūsan hord-ærna sum ēacen-cræftig, oð ðæt hyne ān ābealh mon on mōde; man-dryhtne bær fǣted wǣge, frioðo-wǣre bæd hlāford sīnne.
text_bare: Swa se ðeod-sceaða þreo hund wintra heold on hrusan hord-ærna sum eacen-cræftig, oð ðæt hyne an abealh mon on mode; man-dryhtne bær fæted wæge, frioðo-wære bæd hlaford sinne.

text: Ða wæs hord rāsod, onboren bēaga hord; bēne getīðad fēa-sceaftum men.
text_bare: Ða wæs hord rasod, onboren beaga hord; bene getiðad fea-sceaftum men.

text: Frēa scēawode fīra fyrn-geweorc forman sīðe.
text_bare: Frea sceawode fira fyrn-geweorc forman siðe.

text: Þā se wyrm onwoc, wrōht wæs genīwad; stonc ðā æfter stāne, stearc-heort onfand fēondes fōt-lāst; hē tō forð gestōp dyrnan cræfte dracan hēafde nēah.
text_bare: Þa se wyrm onwoc, wroht wæs geniwad; stonc ða æfter stane, stearc-heort onfand feondes fot-last; he to forð gestop dyrnan cræfte dracan heafde neah.

text: Swā mæg unfǣge ēaðe gedīgan wēan ond wræc-sīð, sē ðe Waldendes hyldo gehealdeþ.
text_bare: Swa mæg unfæge eaðe gedigan wean ond wræc-sið, se ðe Waldendes hyldo gehealdeþ.

text: Hord-weard sōhte georne æfter grunde, wolde guman findan, þone þe him on sweofote sāre getēode; hāt ond hrēoh-mōd hlǣw oft ymbehwearf ealne ūtan-weardne; ne ðǣr ǣnig mon on þǣm wēstenne.
text_bare: Hord-weard sohte georne æfter grunde, wolde guman findan, þone þe him on sweofote sare geteode; hat ond hreoh-mod hlæw oft ymbehwearf ealne utan-weardne; ne ðær ænig mon on þæm westenne.

text: Hwæðre hilde gefeh, beadu-weorces; hwīlum on beorh æthwearf, sinc-fæt sōhte; hē þæt sōna onfand, ðæt hæfde gumena sum goldes gefandod, hēah-gestrēona.
text_bare: Hwæðre hilde gefeh, beadu-weorces; hwilum on beorh æthwearf, sinc-fæt sohte; he þæt sona onfand, ðæt hæfde gumena sum goldes gefandod, heah-gestreona.

text: Hord-weard onbād earfoðlīce, oð ðæt ǣfen cwōm; wæs ðā gebolgen beorges hyrde, wolde se lāða līge forgyldan drinc-fæt dȳre.
text_bare: Hord-weard onbad earfoðlice, oð ðæt æfen cwom; wæs ða gebolgen beorges hyrde, wolde se laða lige forgyldan drinc-fæt dyre.

text: Þā wæs dæg sceacen wyrme on willan; nō on wealle leng bīdan wolde, ac mid bǣle fōr, fȳre gefȳsed.
text_bare: Þa wæs dæg sceacen wyrme on willan; no on wealle leng bidan wolde, ac mid bæle for, fyre gefysed.

text: Wæs se fruma egeslīc lēodum on lande, swā hyt lungre wearð on hyra sinc-gifan sāre geendod.
text_bare: Wæs se fruma egeslic leodum on lande, swa hyt lungre wearð on hyra sinc-gifan sare geendod.

text: Ðā se gæst ongan glēdum spīwan, beorht hofu bærnan; bryne-lēoma stōd eldum on andan; nō ðǣr āht cwices lāð lyft-floga lǣfan wolde.
text_bare: Ða se gæst ongan gledum spiwan, beorht hofu bærnan; bryne-leoma stod eldum on andan; no ðær aht cwices lað lyft-floga læfan wolde.

text: Wæs þæs wyrmes wīg wīde gesȳne, nearo-fāges nīð nēan ond feorran, hū se gūð-sceaða Gēata lēode hatode ond hȳnde.
text_bare: Wæs þæs wyrmes wig wide gesyne, nearo-fages nið nean ond feorran, hu se guð-sceaða Geata leode hatode ond hynde.

text: Hord eft gescēat, dryht-sele dyrnne, ǣr dæges hwīle; hæfde land-wara līge befangen, bǣle ond bronde; beorges getrūwode, wīges ond wealles; him sēo wēn gelēah.
text_bare: Hord eft gesceat, dryht-sele dyrnne, ær dæges hwile; hæfde land-wara lige befangen, bæle ond bronde; beorges getruwode, wiges ond wealles; him seo wen geleah.

text: Þā wæs Bīowulfe brōga gecȳðed snūde tō sōðe, þæt his sylfes hām, bolda sēlest, bryne-wyhnum mealt, gif-stōl Gēata.
text_bare: Þa wæs Biowulfe broga gecyðed snude to soðe, þæt his sylfes ham, bolda selest, bryne-wyhnum mealt, gif-stol Geata.

text: Þæt ðām gōdan wæs hrēow on hreðre, hyge-sorga mǣst; wēnde se wīsa, þæt hē Wealdende ofer ealde riht, ēcean Dryhtne, bitre gebulge; brēost innan wēoll þēostrum geþoncum, swā him geþȳwe ne wæs.
text_bare: Þæt ðam godan wæs hreow on hreðre, hyge-sorga mæst; wende se wisa, þæt he Wealdende ofer ealde riht, ecean Dryhtne, bitre gebulge; breost innan weoll þeostrum geþoncum, swa him geþywe ne wæs.

text: Hæfde līg-draca lēoda fæsten, ēa-lond ūtan, eorð-weard ðone, glēdum forgrunden; him ðæs gūð-kyning, Wedera þīoden, wræce leornode.
text_bare: Hæfde lig-draca leoda fæsten, ea-lond utan, eorð-weard ðone, gledum forgrunden; him ðæs guð-kyning, Wedera þioden, wræce leornode.

text: Heht him þā gewyrcean wīgendra hlēo eall-īrenne, eorla dryhten, wīg-bord wrætlīc; wisse hē gearwe, þæt him holt-wudu helpan ne meahte, lind wið līge.
text_bare: Heht him þa gewyrcean wigendra hleo eall-irenne, eorla dryhten, wig-bord wrætlic; wisse he gearwe, þæt him holt-wudu helpan ne meahte, lind wið lige.

text: Sceolde lǣn-daga.
text_bare: Sceolde læn-daga.

text: æþeling ǣr-gōd ende gebīdan, worulde līfes, ond se wyrm somod, þēah ðe hord-welan hēolde lange.
text_bare: æþeling ær-god ende gebidan, worulde lifes, ond se wyrm somod, þeah ðe hord-welan heolde lange.

text: Oferhogode ðā hringa fengel, þæt hē þone wīd-flogan weorode gesōhte, sīdan herge; nō hē him þā sæcce ondrēd, ne him þæs wyrmes wīg for wiht dyde, eafoð ond ellen, forðon hē ǣr fela, nearo nēðende, nīða gedīgde, hilde-hlemma, syððan hē Hrōðgāres, sigor-ēadig secg, sele fǣlsode, ond æt gūðe forgrāp Grendeles mǣgum lāðan cynnes.
text_bare: Oferhogode ða hringa fengel, þæt he þone wid-flogan weorode gesohte, sidan herge; no he him þa sæcce ondred, ne him þæs wyrmes wig for wiht dyde, eafoð ond ellen, forðon he ær fela, nearo neðende, niða gedigde, hilde-hlemma, syððan he Hroðgares, sigor-eadig secg, sele fælsode, ond æt guðe forgrap Grendeles mægum laðan cynnes.

text: Nō þæt lǣsest wæs hond-gemōt, þǣr mon Hygelāc slōh, syððan Gēata cyning gūðe rǣsum, frēa-wine folca Frēs-londum on, Hrēðles eafora, hioro-dryncum swealt bille gebēaten; þonan Bīowulf cōm sylfes cræfte, sund-nytte drēah; hæfde him on earme āna þrittig hilde-geatwa, þā hē tō holme stāg.
text_bare: No þæt læsest wæs hond-gemot, þær mon Hygelac sloh, syððan Geata cyning guðe ræsum, frea-wine folca Fres-londum on, Hreðles eafora, hioro-dryncum swealt bille gebeaten; þonan Biowulf com sylfes cræfte, sund-nytte dreah; hæfde him on earme ana þrittig hilde-geatwa, þa he to holme stag.

text: Nealles Hetware hrēmge þorfton fēðe-wīges, þe him foran ongēan linde bǣron; lȳt eft becwōm fram þām hild-frecan hāmes nīosan.
text_bare: Nealles Hetware hremge þorfton feðe-wiges, þe him foran ongean linde bæron; lyt eft becwom fram þam hild-frecan hames niosan.

text: Oferswam ðā sioleða bigong sunu Ecgðēowes, earm ān-haga, eft tō lēodum, þǣr him Hygd gebēad hord ond rīce, bēagas ond brego-stōl; bearne ne trūwode, þæt hē wið æl-fylcum ēþel-stōlas healdan cūðe, ðā w«s Hygelāc dēad.
text_bare: Oferswam ða sioleða bigong sunu Ecgðeowes, earm an-haga, eft to leodum, þær him Hygd gebead hord ond rice, beagas ond brego-stol; bearne ne truwode, þæt he wið æl-fylcum eþel-stolas healdan cuðe, ða w«s Hygelac dead.

text: Nō dȳ ǣr fēa-sceafte findan meahton æt ðām æðelinge ǣnige ðinga, þæt hē Heardrēde hlāford wǣre, oððe þone cynedōm cīosan wolde; hwæðre hē hine on folce frēond-lārum hēold, ēstum mid āre, oð ðæt hē yldra wearð, Weder-Gēatum wēold.
text_bare: No dy ær fea-sceafte findan meahton æt ðam æðelinge ænige ðinga, þæt he Heardrede hlaford wære, oððe þone cynedom ciosan wolde; hwæðre he hine on folce freond-larum heold, estum mid are, oð ðæt he yldra wearð, Weder-Geatum weold.

text: Hyne wræc-mæcgas ofer sǣ sēhtan, suna Ōhteres; hæfdon hȳ forhealden helm Scylfinga, þone sēlestan sǣ-cyninga, þāra ðe in Swīo-rīce sinc brytnade, mǣrne þēoden.
text_bare: Hyne wræc-mæcgas ofer sæ sehtan, suna Ohteres; hæfdon hy forhealden helm Scylfinga, þone selestan sæ-cyninga, þara ðe in Swio-rice sinc brytnade, mærne þeoden.

text: Him þæt tō mearce wearð; hē þǣr orfeorme feorh-wunde hlēat sweordes swengum, sunu Hygelāces.
text_bare: Him þæt to mearce wearð; he þær orfeorme feorh-wunde hleat sweordes swengum, sunu Hygelaces.

text: Ond him eft gewāt Ongenðīoes bearn hāmes nīosan, syððan Heardrēd læg, lēt ðone brego-stōl Bīowulf healdan, Gēatum wealdan; þæt wæs gōd cyning.
text_bare: Ond him eft gewat Ongenðioes bearn hames niosan, syððan Heardred læg, let ðone brego-stol Biowulf healdan, Geatum wealdan; þæt wæs god cyning.

text: Sē ðæs lēod-hryres lēan gemunde uferan dōgrum; Ēadgilse wearð fēa-sceaftum frēond, folce gestēpte ofer sǣ sīde sunu Ōhteres, wigum ond wǣpnum; hē gewræc syððan cealdum cear-sīðum, cyning ealdre binēat.
text_bare: Se ðæs leod-hryres lean gemunde uferan dogrum; Eadgilse wearð fea-sceaftum freond, folce gestepte ofer sæ side sunu Ohteres, wigum ond wæpnum; he gewræc syððan cealdum cear-siðum, cyning ealdre bineat.

text: Swā hē nīða gehwane genesen hæfde, slīðra geslyhta, sunu Ecgðīowes, ellen-weorca, oð ðone ānne dæg, þe hē wið þām wyrme gewegan sceolde.
text_bare: Swa he niða gehwane genesen hæfde, sliðra geslyhta, sunu Ecgðiowes, ellen-weorca, oð ðone anne dæg, þe he wið þam wyrme gewegan sceolde.

text: Gewāt þā twelfa sum, torne gebolgen, dryhten Gēata dracan scēawian; hæfde þā gefrūnen, hwanan sīo fǣhð ārās, bealo-nīð biorna; him tō bearme cwōm māþðum-fæt mǣre þurh ðæs meldan hond.
text_bare: Gewat þa twelfa sum, torne gebolgen, dryhten Geata dracan sceawian; hæfde þa gefrunen, hwanan sio fæhð aras, bealo-nið biorna; him to bearme cwom maþðum-fæt mære þurh ðæs meldan hond.

text: Sē wæs on ðām ðrēate þreottēoþa secg, sē ðæs orleges ōr onstealde; hæft hyge-gīomor sceolde hēan ðonon wong wīsian.
text_bare: Se wæs on ðam ðreate þreotteoþa secg, se ðæs orleges or onstealde; hæft hyge-giomor sceolde hean ðonon wong wisian.

text: Hē ofer willan gīong, tō ðæs ðe hē eorð-sele ānne wisse, hlǣw under hrūsan holm-wylme nēh, ȳð-gewinne, sē wæs innan full wrætta ond wīra.
text_bare: He ofer willan giong, to ðæs ðe he eorð-sele anne wisse, hlæw under hrusan holm-wylme neh, yð-gewinne, se wæs innan full wrætta ond wira.

text: Weard unhīore, gearo gūð-freca, gold-māðmas hēold, eald under eorðan; næs þæt ȳðe cēap tō gegangenne gumena ǣnigum.
text_bare: Weard unhiore, gearo guð-freca, gold-maðmas heold, eald under eorðan; næs þæt yðe ceap to gegangenne gumena ænigum.

text: Gesæt ðā on næsse nīð-heard cyning, þenden hǣlo ābēad heorð-genēatum, gold-wine Gēata.
text_bare: Gesæt ða on næsse nið-heard cyning, þenden hælo abead heorð-geneatum, gold-wine Geata.

text: Him wæs gēomor sefa, wǣfre ond wæl-fūs, wyrd ungemete nēah, sē ðone gomelan grētan sceolde, sēcean sāwle hord, sundur gedǣlan līf wið līce; nō þon lange wæs feorh æþelinges flǣsce bewunden.
text_bare: Him wæs geomor sefa, wæfre ond wæl-fus, wyrd ungemete neah, se ðone gomelan gretan sceolde, secean sawle hord, sundur gedælan lif wið lice; no þon lange wæs feorh æþelinges flæsce bewunden.

text: Bīowulf maþelade, bearn Ecgðēowes: “Fela ic on giogoðe gūð-rǣsa genæs, orleg-hwīla; ic þæt eall gemon.
text_bare: Biowulf maþelade, bearn Ecgðeowes: “Fela ic on giogoðe guð-ræsa genæs, orleg-hwila; ic þæt eall gemon.

text: Ic wæs syfan-wintre, þā mec sinca baldor, frēa-wine folca, æt mīnum fæder genam; hēold mec ond hæfde Hrēðel cyning, geaf mē sinc ond symbel, sibbe gemunde; næs ic him tō līfe lāðra ōwihte beorn in burgum þonne his bearna hwylc, Herebeald ond Hǣðcyn, oððe Hygelāc mīn.
text_bare: Ic wæs syfan-wintre, þa mec sinca baldor, frea-wine folca, æt minum fæder genam; heold mec ond hæfde Hreðel cyning, geaf me sinc ond symbel, sibbe gemunde; næs ic him to life laðra owihte beorn in burgum þonne his bearna hwylc, Herebeald ond Hæðcyn, oððe Hygelac min.

text: Wæs þām yldestan ungedēfelīce mǣges dǣdum morþor-bed strēd, syððan hyne Hǣðcyn of horn-bogan, his frēa-wine, flāne geswencte, miste mercelses ond his mǣg ofscēt, brōðor ōðerne, blōdigan gāre.
text_bare: Wæs þam yldestan ungedefelice mæges dædum morþor-bed stred, syððan hyne Hæðcyn of horn-bogan, his frea-wine, flane geswencte, miste mercelses ond his mæg ofscet, broðor oðerne, blodigan gare.

text: Þæt wæs feoh-lēas gefeoht, fyrenum gesyngad, hreðre hyge-mēðe; sceolde hwæðre swā þēah æðeling unwrecen ealdres linnan.
text_bare: Þæt wæs feoh-leas gefeoht, fyrenum gesyngad, hreðre hyge-meðe; sceolde hwæðre swa þeah æðeling unwrecen ealdres linnan.

text: Swā bið gēomorlīc gomelum ceorle tō gebīdanne, þæt his byre rīde giong on galgan; þonne hē gyd wrece, sārigne sang, þonne his sunu hangað hrefne tō hrōðre, ond hē him helpan ne mæg, eald ond in-frōd, ǣnige gefremman.
text_bare: Swa bið geomorlic gomelum ceorle to gebidanne, þæt his byre ride giong on galgan; þonne he gyd wrece, sarigne sang, þonne his sunu hangað hrefne to hroðre, ond he him helpan ne mæg, eald ond in-frod, ænige gefremman.

text: Symble bið gemyndgad morna gehwylce eaforan ellor-sīð; ōðres ne gȳmeð tō gebīdanne burgum in innan yrfe-weardas, þonne se ān hafað þurh dēaðes nȳd dǣda gefondad.
text_bare: Symble bið gemyndgad morna gehwylce eaforan ellor-sið; oðres ne gymeð to gebidanne burgum in innan yrfe-weardas, þonne se an hafað þurh deaðes nyd dæda gefondad.

text: Gesyhð sorh-cearig on his suna būre wīn-sele wēstne, wind-gereste, rēote berofene; rīdend swefað, hæleð in hoðman; nis þǣr hearpan swēg, gomen in geardum, swylce ðǣr īu wǣron.
text_bare: Gesyhð sorh-cearig on his suna bure win-sele westne, wind-gereste, reote berofene; ridend swefað, hæleð in hoðman; nis þær hearpan sweg, gomen in geardum, swylce ðær iu wæron.

text: Gewīteð þonne on sealman, sorh-lēoð gæleð ān æfter ānum; þūhte him eall tō rūm, wongas ond wīc-stede.
text_bare: Gewiteð þonne on sealman, sorh-leoð gæleð an æfter anum; þuhte him eall to rum, wongas ond wic-stede.

text: Swā Wedra helm æfter Herebealde heortan sorge weallinde wæg; wihte ne meahte on ðām feorh-bonan fǣghðe gebētan; nē ðȳ ǣr hē þone heaðorinc hatian ne meahte lāðum dǣdum, þēah him lēof ne wæs.
text_bare: Swa Wedra helm æfter Herebealde heortan sorge weallinde wæg; wihte ne meahte on ðam feorh-bonan fæghðe gebetan; ne ðy ær he þone heaðorinc hatian ne meahte laðum dædum, þeah him leof ne wæs.

text: Hē ðā mid þǣre sorhge, þe him sīo sār belamp, gum-drēam ofgeaf, Godes lēoht gecēas; eaferum lǣfde, swā dēð ēadig mon, lond ond lēod-byrig, þā hē of līfe gewāt.
text_bare: He ða mid þære sorhge, þe him sio sar belamp, gum-dream ofgeaf, Godes leoht geceas; eaferum læfde, swa deð eadig mon, lond ond leod-byrig, þa he of life gewat.

text: Þā wæs synn ond sacu Swēona ond Gēata, ofer wīd wæter wrōht gemǣne, here-nīð hearda, syððan Hr¯wðel swealt; oððe him Ongenðēowes eaferan Wǣran frome, fyrd-hwate, frēode ne woldon ofer heafo healdan, ac ymb Hreosnabeorh eatolne inwit-scear oft gefremedon.
text_bare: Þa wæs synn ond sacu Sweona ond Geata, ofer wid wæter wroht gemæne, here-nið hearda, syððan Hr¯wðel swealt; oððe him Ongenðeowes eaferan Wæran frome, fyrd-hwate, freode ne woldon ofer heafo healdan, ac ymb Hreosnabeorh eatolne inwit-scear oft gefremedon.

text: Þæt mǣg-wine mīne gewrǣcan, fǣhðe ond fyrene, swā hyt gefrǣge wæs, þēah ðe ōðer his ealdre gebohte, heardan cēape; Hǣðcynne wearð, Gēata dryhtne, gūð onsǣge.
text_bare: Þæt mæg-wine mine gewræcan, fæhðe ond fyrene, swa hyt gefræge wæs, þeah ðe oðer his ealdre gebohte, heardan ceape; Hæðcynne wearð, Geata dryhtne, guð onsæge.

text: Þā ic on morgne gefrægn mǣg ōðerne billes ecgum on bonan stǣlan, þǣr Ongenþēow Eofores nīosað; gūð-helm tōglād, gomela Scylfing hrēas heoro-blāc; hond gemunde fǣhðo genōge, feorh-sweng ne oftēah.
text_bare: Þa ic on morgne gefrægn mæg oðerne billes ecgum on bonan stælan, þær Ongenþeow Eofores niosað; guð-helm toglad, gomela Scylfing hreas heoro-blac; hond gemunde fæhðo genoge, feorh-sweng ne ofteah.

text: Ic him þā māðmas, þe hē mē sealde, geald æt gūðe, swa mē gifeðe wæs, lēohtan sweorde; hē mē lond forgeaf, eard, ēðel-wyn.
text_bare: Ic him þa maðmas, þe he me sealde, geald æt guðe, swa me gifeðe wæs, leohtan sweorde; he me lond forgeaf, eard, eðel-wyn.

text: Næs him ǣnig þearf, þæt hē tō Gifðum, oððe tō Gār-Denum, oððe in Swīo-rīce, sēcean þurfe wyrsan wīg-frecan, weorðe gecȳpan; symle ic him on fēðan beforan wolde, āna on orde, ond swā to aldre sceall sæcce fremman, þenden þis sweord þolað, þæt mec ǣr ond sīð oft gelǣste, syððan ic for dugeðum Dæghrefne wearð tō hand-bonan, Hūga cempan.
text_bare: Næs him ænig þearf, þæt he to Gifðum, oððe to Gar-Denum, oððe in Swio-rice, secean þurfe wyrsan wig-frecan, weorðe gecypan; symle ic him on feðan beforan wolde, ana on orde, ond swa to aldre sceall sæcce fremman, þenden þis sweord þolað, þæt mec ær ond sið oft gelæste, syððan ic for dugeðum Dæghrefne wearð to hand-bonan, Huga cempan.

text: Nalles hē ðā frætwe Frēs-cyninge, brēost-weorðunge, bringan mōste, ac in campe gecrong cumbles hyrde, æþeling on elne; ne wæs ecg bona, ac him hilde-grāp heortan wylmas, bān-hūs gebræc.
text_bare: Nalles he ða frætwe Fres-cyninge, breost-weorðunge, bringan moste, ac in campe gecrong cumbles hyrde, æþeling on elne; ne wæs ecg bona, ac him hilde-grap heortan wylmas, ban-hus gebræc.

text: Nū sceall billes ecg, hond ond heard sweord, ymb hord wīgan.” Bēowulf maðelode, bēot-wordum spræc, nīehstan sīðe: “Ic genēðde fela gūða on geogoðe; gyt ic wylle, frōd folces weard, fǣhðe sēcan, mǣrðum fremman, gif mec se mān-sceaða of eorð-sele ūt gesēceð.” Gegrētte ðā gumena gehwylcne, hwate helm-berend, hindeman sīðe, swǣse gesīðas: “Nolde ic sweord beran, wǣpen tō wyrme, gif ic wiste hū wið ðām āglǣcean elles meahte gylpe wiðgrīpan, swā ic gīo wið Grendle dyde; ac ic ðǣr heaðu-fȳres hātes wēne, oreðes ond attres; forðon ic mē on hafu bord ond byrnan.
text_bare: Nu sceall billes ecg, hond ond heard sweord, ymb hord wigan.” Beowulf maðelode, beot-wordum spræc, niehstan siðe: “Ic geneðde fela guða on geogoðe; gyt ic wylle, frod folces weard, fæhðe secan, mærðum fremman, gif mec se man-sceaða of eorð-sele ut geseceð.” Gegrette ða gumena gehwylcne, hwate helm-berend, hindeman siðe, swæse gesiðas: “Nolde ic sweord beran, wæpen to wyrme, gif ic wiste hu wið ðam aglæcean elles meahte gylpe wiðgripan, swa ic gio wið Grendle dyde; ac ic ðær heaðu-fyres hates wene, oreðes ond attres; forðon ic me on hafu bord ond byrnan.

text: Nelle ic beorges weard oferflēon fōtes trem, ac unc sceal weorðan æt wealle, swā unc wyrd getēoð, Metod manna gehwæs.
text_bare: Nelle ic beorges weard oferfleon fotes trem, ac unc sceal weorðan æt wealle, swa unc wyrd geteoð, Metod manna gehwæs.

text: Ic eom on mōde from, þæt ic wið þone gūð-flogan gylp ofersitte.
text_bare: Ic eom on mode from, þæt ic wið þone guð-flogan gylp ofersitte.

text: Gebīde gē on beorge byrnum werede, secgas on searwum, hwæðer sēl mæge æfter wæl-rǣse wunde gedȳgan uncer twēga.
text_bare: Gebide ge on beorge byrnum werede, secgas on searwum, hwæðer sel mæge æfter wæl-ræse wunde gedygan uncer twega.

text: Nis þæt ēower sīð, ne gemet mannes nefne mīn ānes, þæt hē wið āglǣcean eofoðo dǣle eorl-scype efne.
text_bare: Nis þæt eower sið, ne gemet mannes nefne min anes, þæt he wið aglæcean eofoðo dæle eorl-scype efne.

text: Ic mid elne sceall gold gegangan, oððe gūð nimeð, feorh-bealu frēcne, frēan ēowerne.” Ārās ðā bī ronde rōf ōretta, heard under helme, hioro-sercean bær under stān-cleofu, strengo getrūwode ānes mannes; ne bið swylc earges sīð.
text_bare: Ic mid elne sceall gold gegangan, oððe guð nimeð, feorh-bealu frecne, frean eowerne.” Aras ða bi ronde rof oretta, heard under helme, hioro-sercean bær under stan-cleofu, strengo getruwode anes mannes; ne bið swylc earges sið.

text: Geseah ðā be wealle, sē ðe worna fela, gum-cystum gōd, gūða gedīgde, hilde-hlemma, þonne hnitan fēðan, stondan stān-bogan, strēam ūt þonan brecan of beorge; wæs þǣre burnan wælm heaðo-fȳrum hāt; ne meahte horde nēah unbyrnende ǣnige hwīle dēop gedȳgan for dracan lēge.
text_bare: Geseah ða be wealle, se ðe worna fela, gum-cystum god, guða gedigde, hilde-hlemma, þonne hnitan feðan, stondan stan-bogan, stream ut þonan brecan of beorge; wæs þære burnan wælm heaðo-fyrum hat; ne meahte horde neah unbyrnende ænige hwile deop gedygan for dracan lege.

text: Lēt ðā of brēostum, ðā hē gebolgen wæs, Weder-Gēata lēod word ūt faran, stearc-heort styrmde; stefn in becōm heaðo-torht hlynnan under hārne stān; hete wæs onhrēred, hord-weard oncnīow mannes reorde; næs ðǣr māra fyrst frēode tō friclan.
text_bare: Let ða of breostum, ða he gebolgen wæs, Weder-Geata leod word ut faran, stearc-heort styrmde; stefn in becom heaðo-torht hlynnan under harne stan; hete wæs onhrered, hord-weard oncniow mannes reorde; næs ðær mara fyrst freode to friclan.

text: From ǣrest cwōm oruð āglǣcean ūt of stāne, hāt hilde-swāt; hrūse dynede.
text_bare: From ærest cwom oruð aglæcean ut of stane, hat hilde-swat; hruse dynede.

text: Biorn under beorge bord-rand onswāf wið ðām gryre-gieste, Gēata dryhten; ðā wæs hring-bogan heorte gefȳsed sæcce tō sēceanne.
text_bare: Biorn under beorge bord-rand onswaf wið ðam gryre-gieste, Geata dryhten; ða wæs hring-bogan heorte gefysed sæcce to seceanne.

text: Sweord ǣr gebrǣd gōd gūð-cyning, gomele lāfe, ecgum unslaw; ǣghwæðrum wæs bealo-hycgendra brōga fram ōðrum.
text_bare: Sweord ær gebræd god guð-cyning, gomele lafe, ecgum unslaw; æghwæðrum wæs bealo-hycgendra broga fram oðrum.

text: Stīð-mōd gestōd wið stēapne rond winia bealdor, ðā se wyrm gebēah snūde tōsomne; hē on searwum bād.
text_bare: Stið-mod gestod wið steapne rond winia bealdor, ða se wyrm gebeah snude tosomne; he on searwum bad.

text: Gewāt ðā byrnende gebogen scrīðan, tō gescipe scyndan.
text_bare: Gewat ða byrnende gebogen scriðan, to gescipe scyndan.

text: Scyld wel gebearg līfe ond līce lǣssan hwīle mǣrum þēodne, þonne his myne sōhte, ðǣr hē þȳ fyrste forman dōgore wealdan mōste, swā him wyrd ne gescrāf hrēð æt hilde.
text_bare: Scyld wel gebearg life ond lice læssan hwile mærum þeodne, þonne his myne sohte, ðær he þy fyrste forman dogore wealdan moste, swa him wyrd ne gescraf hreð æt hilde.

text: Hond ūp ābrǣd Gēata dryhten, gryre-fāhne slōh incge lāfe, þæt sīo ecg gewāc brūn on bāne, bāt unswīðor, þonne his ðīod-cyning þearfe hæfde, bysigum gebǣded.
text_bare: Hond up abræd Geata dryhten, gryre-fahne sloh incge lafe, þæt sio ecg gewac brun on bane, bat unswiðor, þonne his ðiod-cyning þearfe hæfde, bysigum gebæded.

text: Þā wæs beorges weard æfter heaðu-swenge on hrēoum mōde, wearp wæl-fyre; wīde sprungon hilde-lēoman.
text_bare: Þa wæs beorges weard æfter heaðu-swenge on hreoum mode, wearp wæl-fyre; wide sprungon hilde-leoman.

text: Hrēð-sigora ne gealp gold-wine Gēata; gūð-bill geswāc nacod æt nīðe, swā hyt nō sceolde, īren ǣr-gōd.
text_bare: Hreð-sigora ne gealp gold-wine Geata; guð-bill geswac nacod æt niðe, swa hyt no sceolde, iren ær-god.

text: Ne wǣs þǣt ēðe sīð, þǣt se mǣra maga Ecgðēowes grund-wong þone ofgyfan wolde; sceolde ofer willan wīc eardian elles hwergen, swā sceal ǣghwylc mon ālǣtan lǣen-dagas.
text_bare: Ne wæs þæt eðe sið, þæt se mæra maga Ecgðeowes grund-wong þone ofgyfan wolde; sceolde ofer willan wic eardian elles hwergen, swa sceal æghwylc mon alætan læen-dagas.

text: Næs ðā long tō ðon, þæt ðā āglǣcean hȳ eft gemētton.
text_bare: Næs ða long to ðon, þæt ða aglæcean hy eft gemetton.

text: Hyrte hyne hord-weard, hreðer ǣðme wēoll, nīwan stefne; nearo ðrōwode fȳre befongen, sē ðe ǣr folce wēold.
text_bare: Hyrte hyne hord-weard, hreðer æðme weoll, niwan stefne; nearo ðrowode fyre befongen, se ðe ær folce weold.

text: Nealles him on hēape hand-gesteallan, æðelinga bearn, ymbe gestōdon hilde-cystum, ac hȳ on holt bugon ealdre burgan.
text_bare: Nealles him on heape hand-gesteallan, æðelinga bearn, ymbe gestodon hilde-cystum, ac hy on holt bugon ealdre burgan.

text: Hiora in ānum wēoll sefa wið sorgum; sibb ǣfre ne mæg wiht onwendan, þām ðe wel þenceð.
text_bare: Hiora in anum weoll sefa wið sorgum; sibb æfre ne mæg wiht onwendan, þam ðe wel þenceð.

text: Wīglaf wæs hāten, Weoxstānes sunu, lēoflic lind-wiga, lēod Scylfinga, mǣg Ælfheres; geseah his mon-diyhten under here-grīman hāt þrōwian; gemunde ðā ðā āre, þe hē him ǣr forgeaf, wīc-stede weligne Wǣgmundinga, folc-rihta gehwylc, swā his fæder āhte; ne mihte ðā forhabban, hond rond gefēng, geolwe linde, gomel swyrd getēah.
text_bare: Wiglaf wæs haten, Weoxstanes sunu, leoflic lind-wiga, leod Scylfinga, mæg Ælfheres; geseah his mon-diyhten under here-griman hat þrowian; gemunde ða ða are, þe he him ær forgeaf, wic-stede weligne Wægmundinga, folc-rihta gehwylc, swa his fæder ahte; ne mihte ða forhabban, hond rond gefeng, geolwe linde, gomel swyrd geteah.

text: Þæt wæs mid eldum Ēanmundes lāf, suna Ōhteres, þām æt sæcce wearð, wræccan wine-lēasum, Weohstān bana mēces ecgum, ond his māgum ætbær brūn-fāgne helm, hringde byrnan, eald sweord etonisc, þæt him Onela forgeaf, his gædelinges gūð-gewǣdu, fyrd-searo fūslīc; nō ymbe ðā fǣhðe spræc, þēah ðe hē his brōðr bearn ābredwade.
text_bare: Þæt wæs mid eldum Eanmundes laf, suna Ohteres, þam æt sæcce wearð, wræccan wine-leasum, Weohstan bana meces ecgum, ond his magum ætbær brun-fagne helm, hringde byrnan, eald sweord etonisc, þæt him Onela forgeaf, his gædelinges guð-gewædu, fyrd-searo fuslic; no ymbe ða fæhðe spræc, þeah ðe he his broðr bearn abredwade.

text: Hē frǣtwe gehēold fela missera, bill ond byrnan, oð ðæt his byre mihte eorl-scipe efnan swā his ǣr-fǣder; geaf him ðā mid Gēatum gūð-gewǣda ǣghwæs unrīm, þā hē of ealdre gewāt frōd on forð-weg.
text_bare: He frætwe geheold fela missera, bill ond byrnan, oð ðæt his byre mihte eorl-scipe efnan swa his ær-fæder; geaf him ða mid Geatum guð-gewæda æghwæs unrim, þa he of ealdre gewat frod on forð-weg.

text: Þā wæs forma sīð geongan cempan, þæt hē gūðe rǣs mid his frēo-dryhtne fremman sceolde; ne gemealt him se mōd-sefa, ne his mǣges lāf gewāc æt wīge; þæt se wyrm onfand, syððan hīe tōgædre gegān hæfdon.
text_bare: Þa wæs forma sið geongan cempan, þæt he guðe ræs mid his freo-dryhtne fremman sceolde; ne gemealt him se mod-sefa, ne his mæges laf gewac æt wige; þæt se wyrm onfand, syððan hie togædre gegan hæfdon.

text: Wīglāf maðelode word-rihta fela, sægde gesīðum him wæs sefa gēomor : “Ic ðæt mǣl geman, þǣr wē medu þēgun, þonne wē gehēton ussum hlāforde in bīor-sele, ðe ūs ðās bēagas geaf, þæt wē him ðā gūð-getāwa gyldan woldon, gif him þyslicu þearf gelumpe, helmas ond heard sweord.
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode word-rihta fela, sægde gesiðum him wæs sefa geomor : “Ic ðæt mæl geman, þær we medu þegun, þonne we geheton ussum hlaforde in bior-sele, ðe us ðas beagas geaf, þæt we him ða guð-getawa gyldan woldon, gif him þyslicu þearf gelumpe, helmas ond heard sweord.

text: Ðē hē ūsic on herge gecēas tō ðyssum sīð-fate sylfes willum, onmunde ūsic mǣrða, ond mē þās māðmas geaf, þē hē ūsic gār-wīgend gōde tealde, hwate helm-berend, þēah ðe hlāford ūs þis ellen-weorc āna āðōhte tō gefremmanne, folces hyrde, forðam hē manna mǣst mǣrða gefremede, dǣda dollīcra.
text_bare: Ðe he usic on herge geceas to ðyssum sið-fate sylfes willum, onmunde usic mærða, ond me þas maðmas geaf, þe he usic gar-wigend gode tealde, hwate helm-berend, þeah ðe hlaford us þis ellen-weorc ana aðohte to gefremmanne, folces hyrde, forðam he manna mæst mærða gefremede, dæda dollicra.

text: Nū is se dæg cumen, þæt ūre man-dryhten mægenes behōfað gōdra gūð-rinca; wutun gongan tō, helpan hild-fruman, þenden hyt sȳ, glēd-egesa grim.
text_bare: Nu is se dæg cumen, þæt ure man-dryhten mægenes behofað godra guð-rinca; wutun gongan to, helpan hild-fruman, þenden hyt sy, gled-egesa grim.

text: God wāt on mec, þæt mē is micle lēofre, þæt mīnne līc-haman mid mīnne gold-gyfan glēd fæðmie.
text_bare: God wat on mec, þæt me is micle leofre, þæt minne lic-haman mid minne gold-gyfan gled fæðmie.

text: Ne þynceð mē gerysne, þæt wē rondas beren eft tō earde, nemne wē ǣror mægen fāne gefyllan, feorh ealgian Wedra ðēodnes.
text_bare: Ne þynceð me gerysne, þæt we rondas beren eft to earde, nemne we æror mægen fane gefyllan, feorh ealgian Wedra ðeodnes.

text: Ic wāt geare, þæt nǣron eald gewyrht, þæt hē āna scyle Gēata duguðe gnorn þrōwian, gesīgan æt sæcce; ūrum sceal sweord ond helm, byrne ond byrdu-scrūd, bām gemǣne.” Wōd þā þurh þone wæl-rēc, wīg-heafolan bær frēan on fultum, fēa worda cwæð: “Lēofa Bīowulf, lǣst eall tela, swā ðū on geoguð-fēore geara gecwǣde, þæt ðū ne ālǣte be ðē lifigendum dōm gedrēosan; scealt nū dǣdum rōf, æðeling ān-hȳdig, ealle mægene feorh ealgian; ic ðē ful-lǣstu.” Æfter ðām wordum wyrm yrre cwōm, atol inwit-gæst, ōðre sīðe fȳr-wylmum fāh fīonda nīosian, lāðra manna.
text_bare: Ic wat geare, þæt næron eald gewyrht, þæt he ana scyle Geata duguðe gnorn þrowian, gesigan æt sæcce; urum sceal sweord ond helm, byrne ond byrdu-scrud, bam gemæne.” Wod þa þurh þone wæl-rec, wig-heafolan bær frean on fultum, fea worda cwæð: “Leofa Biowulf, læst eall tela, swa ðu on geoguð-feore geara gecwæde, þæt ðu ne alæte be ðe lifigendum dom gedreosan; scealt nu dædum rof, æðeling an-hydig, ealle mægene feorh ealgian; ic ðe ful-læstu.” Æfter ðam wordum wyrm yrre cwom, atol inwit-gæst, oðre siðe fyr-wylmum fah fionda niosian, laðra manna.

text: Līg-ȳðum forborn bord wið rond; byrne ne meahte geongum gār-wigan gēoce gefremman; ac se maga geonga under his mǣges scyld elne geēode, þā his āgen wæs glēdum forgrunden.
text_bare: Lig-yðum forborn bord wið rond; byrne ne meahte geongum gar-wigan geoce gefremman; ac se maga geonga under his mæges scyld elne geeode, þa his agen wæs gledum forgrunden.

text: Þā gēn gūð-cyning mǣrða gemunde, mægen-strengo slōh hilde-bille, þæt hyt on heafolan stōd nīþe genȳded; Nægling forbærst, geswāc æt sæcce sweord Bīowulfes, gomol ond grǣg-mǣl.
text_bare: Þa gen guð-cyning mærða gemunde, mægen-strengo sloh hilde-bille, þæt hyt on heafolan stod niþe genyded; Nægling forbærst, geswac æt sæcce sweord Biowulfes, gomol ond græg-mæl.

text: Him þæt gifeðe ne wæs, þæt him īrenna ecge mihton helpan æt hilde; wæs sīo hond tō strong, sē ðe mēca gehwane, mīne gefrǣge, swenge ofersōhte, þonne hē tō sæcce bær wǣpen wundrum heard; næs him wihte ðē sēl.
text_bare: Him þæt gifeðe ne wæs, þæt him irenna ecge mihton helpan æt hilde; wæs sio hond to strong, se ðe meca gehwane, mine gefræge, swenge ofersohte, þonne he to sæcce bær wæpen wundrum heard; næs him wihte ðe sel.

text: Þā wæs þēod-sceaða þriddan sīðe, frēcne fȳr-draca, fǣhða gemymdig, rǣsde on ðone rōfan, þā him rūm āgeald, hāt ond heaðo-grim, heals ealne ymbefēng biteran bānum; hē geblōdegod wearð sāwul-drīore; swāt ȳðum wēoll.
text_bare: Þa wæs þeod-sceaða þriddan siðe, frecne fyr-draca, fæhða gemymdig, ræsde on ðone rofan, þa him rum ageald, hat ond heaðo-grim, heals ealne ymbefeng biteran banum; he geblodegod wearð sawul-driore; swat yðum weoll.

text: Ðā ic æt þearfe gefrægn þeod-cyninges andlongne eorl ellen cȳðan, cræft ond cēnðu, swā him gecynde wæs; ne hēdde hē þæs heafolan ac sīo hand gebarn mōdiges mannes, þǣr hē his mǣges healp , þæt hē þone nīð-gæst nioðor hwēne slōh, secg on searwum, þæt ðæt sweord gedēaf fāh ond fǣted, þæt ðæt fȳr ongon sweðrian syððan.
text_bare: Ða ic æt þearfe gefrægn þeod-cyninges andlongne eorl ellen cyðan, cræft ond cenðu, swa him gecynde wæs; ne hedde he þæs heafolan ac sio hand gebarn modiges mannes, þær he his mæges healp , þæt he þone nið-gæst nioðor hwene sloh, secg on searwum, þæt ðæt sweord gedeaf fah ond fæted, þæt ðæt fyr ongon sweðrian syððan.

text: Þā gēn sylf cyning gewēold his gewitte, wæll-seaxe gebrǣd biter ond beadu-scearp, þæt hē on byrnan wæg; forwrāt Wedra helm wyrm on middan.
text_bare: Þa gen sylf cyning geweold his gewitte, wæll-seaxe gebræd biter ond beadu-scearp, þæt he on byrnan wæg; forwrat Wedra helm wyrm on middan.

text: Fēond gefyldan, ferh ellen wræc, ond hī hyne þā bēgen ābroten hæfdon, sib-æðelingas; swylc sceolde secg wesan, þegn æt ðearfe.
text_bare: Feond gefyldan, ferh ellen wræc, ond hi hyne þa begen abroten hæfdon, sib-æðelingas; swylc sceolde secg wesan, þegn æt ðearfe.

text: Þæt ðām þēodne wæs sīðast sige-hwīle sylfes dǣdum, worlde geweorces. Ðā sīo wund ongon, þe him se eorð-draca ǣr geworhte, swēlan ond swellan; hē þæt sōna onfand, þæt him on brēostum bealo-nīð wēoll, āttor on innan.
text_bare: Þæt ðam þeodne wæs siðast sige-hwile sylfes dædum, worlde geweorces. Ða sio wund ongon, þe him se eorð-draca ær geworhte, swelan ond swellan; he þæt sona onfand, þæt him on breostum bealo-nið weoll, attor on innan.

text: Ðā se æðeling gīong, þæt hē bī wealle wīs-hycgende gesæt on sesse, seah on enta geweorc, hū ðā stān-bogan stapulum fæste ēce eorð-reced innan healde.
text_bare: Ða se æðeling giong, þæt he bi wealle wis-hycgende gesæt on sesse, seah on enta geweorc, hu ða stan-bogan stapulum fæste ece eorð-reced innan healde.

text: Hyne þā mid handa heoro-drēorigne, þēoden mǣrne, þegn ungemete till, wine-dryhten his, wætere gelafede hilde-sædne, ond his helm onspēon.
text_bare: Hyne þa mid handa heoro-dreorigne, þeoden mærne, þegn ungemete till, wine-dryhten his, wætere gelafede hilde-sædne, ond his helm onspeon.

text: Bīowulf maþelode: hē ofer benne spræc, wunde wæl-blēate; wisse hē gearwe, þæt hē dæg-hwīla gedrogen hæfde eorðan wynne; ðā wæs eall sceacen dōgor-gerīmes, dēatð ungemete nēah: “Nū ic suna mīnum syllan wolde gūð-gewǣdu, þǣr mē gifeðe swā ǣnig yrfe-weard æfter wurde līce gelenge.
text_bare: Biowulf maþelode: he ofer benne spræc, wunde wæl-bleate; wisse he gearwe, þæt he dæg-hwila gedrogen hæfde eorðan wynne; ða wæs eall sceacen dogor-gerimes, deatð ungemete neah: “Nu ic suna minum syllan wolde guð-gewædu, þær me gifeðe swa ænig yrfe-weard æfter wurde lice gelenge.

text: Ic ðās lēode hēold fīftig wintra; næs se folc-cyning ymbe-sittendra ǣnig ðāra, þe mec gūð-winum grētan dorste, egesan ðēon.
text_bare: Ic ðas leode heold fiftig wintra; næs se folc-cyning ymbe-sittendra ænig ðara, þe mec guð-winum gretan dorste, egesan ðeon.

text: Ic on earde bād mǣl-gesceafta, hēold mīn tela, ne sōhte searo-nīðas, ne mē swōr fela āða on unriht.
text_bare: Ic on earde bad mæl-gesceafta, heold min tela, ne sohte searo-niðas, ne me swor fela aða on unriht.

text: Ic ðæs ealles mæg feorh-bennum sēoc gefēan habban; forðam mē wītan ne ðearf Waldend fīra morðor-bealo māga, þonne mīn sceaceð līf of līce.
text_bare: Ic ðæs ealles mæg feorh-bennum seoc gefean habban; forðam me witan ne ðearf Waldend fira morðor-bealo maga, þonne min sceaceð lif of lice.

text: Nū ðū lungre geong hord scēawian under hārne stān, Wīglāf lēofa, nū se wyrm ligeð, swefeð sāre wund, since berēafod.
text_bare: Nu ðu lungre geong hord sceawian under harne stan, Wiglaf leofa, nu se wyrm ligeð, swefeð sare wund, since bereafod.

text: Bīo nū on ofoste, þæt ic ǣr-welan, gold-ǣht ongite, gearo scēawige swegle searo-gimmas, þæt ic ðȳ sēft mæge æfter māððum-welan mīn ālǣtan līf ond lēod-scipe, þone ic longe hēold.”
text_bare: Bio nu on ofoste, þæt ic ær-welan, gold-æht ongite, gearo sceawige swegle searo-gimmas, þæt ic ðy seft mæge æfter maððum-welan min alætan lif ond leod-scipe, þone ic longe heold.”

text: Ðā ic snūde gefrægn sunu Wihstānes æfter word-cwydum wundum dryhtne hȳran heaðo-sīocum, hring-net beran, brogdne beadu-sercean, under beorges hrōf.
text_bare: Ða ic snude gefrægn sunu Wihstanes æfter word-cwydum wundum dryhtne hyran heaðo-siocum, hring-net beran, brogdne beadu-sercean, under beorges hrof.

text: Geseah ðā sige-hrēðig, þā hē bī sesse gēong, mago-þegn mōdig māððum-sigla fealo, gold glitinian grunde getenge, wundur on wealle, ond þaes wyrmes denn, ealdes ūht-flogan; orcas stondan, fyrn-manna fatu, feormend-lēase, hyrstum behrorene.
text_bare: Geseah ða sige-hreðig, þa he bi sesse geong, mago-þegn modig maððum-sigla fealo, gold glitinian grunde getenge, wundur on wealle, ond þaes wyrmes denn, ealdes uht-flogan; orcas stondan, fyrn-manna fatu, feormend-lease, hyrstum behrorene.

text: Þǣr wæs helm monig eald ond ōmig, earm-bēaga fela searwum gesǣled.
text_bare: Þær wæs helm monig eald ond omig, earm-beaga fela searwum gesæled.

text: Sinc ēaðe mæg, gold on grunde, gum-cynnes gehwone oferhīgian, hȳde sē ðe wylle.
text_bare: Sinc eaðe mæg, gold on grunde, gum-cynnes gehwone oferhigian, hyde se ðe wylle.

text: Swylce hē siomian geseah segn eall-gylden hēah ofer horde, hond-wundra mǣst, gelocen leoðo-cræftum; of ðām lēoma stōd, þæt hē þone grund-wong ongitan meahte, wræte giondwlītan.
text_bare: Swylce he siomian geseah segn eall-gylden heah ofer horde, hond-wundra mæst, gelocen leoðo-cræftum; of ðam leoma stod, þæt he þone grund-wong ongitan meahte, wræte giondwlitan.

text: Næs ðæs wyrmes þǣr onsȳn ǣnig, ac hyne ecg fornam.
text_bare: Næs ðæs wyrmes þær onsyn ænig, ac hyne ecg fornam.

text: Ðā ic on hlǣwe gefrægn hord rēafian, eald enta geweorc, ānne mannan, him on bearm hladon būnan ond discas sylfes dōme; segn ēac genōm, bēacna beorhtost.
text_bare: Ða ic on hlæwe gefrægn hord reafian, eald enta geweorc, anne mannan, him on bearm hladon bunan ond discas sylfes dome; segn eac genom, beacna beorhtost.

text: Bill ǣr gescōd ecg wæs īren eald-hlāfordes þām ðāra māðma mund-bora wæs longe hwīle, līg-egesan wæg hātne for horde, hioro-weallende middel-nihtum, oð þæt hē morðre swealt.
text_bare: Bill ær gescod ecg wæs iren eald-hlafordes þam ðara maðma mund-bora wæs longe hwile, lig-egesan wæg hatne for horde, hioro-weallende middel-nihtum, oð þæt he morðre swealt.

text: Ār wæs on ofoste, eft-sīðes georn, frætwum gefyrðred; hyne fyrwet bræc, hwæðer collen-ferð cwicne gemētte in ðām wong-stede Wedra þēoden, ellen-sīocne, þǣr hē hine ǣr forlēt.
text_bare: Ar wæs on ofoste, eft-siðes georn, frætwum gefyrðred; hyne fyrwet bræc, hwæðer collen-ferð cwicne gemette in ðam wong-stede Wedra þeoden, ellen-siocne, þær he hine ær forlet.

text: Hē ðā mid þām māðmum mǣrne þīoden, dryhten sīnne, drīorigne fand ealdres æt ende; hē hine eft ongon wæteres weorpan, oð þæt wordes ord brēost-hord þurhbræc.
text_bare: He ða mid þam maðmum mærne þioden, dryhten sinne, driorigne fand ealdres æt ende; he hine eft ongon wæteres weorpan, oð þæt wordes ord breost-hord þurhbræc.

text: Bēowulf maðelode, gomel on giohðe gold scēawode: “Ic ðāra frætwa Frēan ealles ðanc, Wuldur-cyninge, wordum secge, ēcum Dryhtne, þe ic hēr on starie, þæs ðe ic mōste mīnum lēodum ǣr swylt-dæge swylc gestrȳnan.
text_bare: Beowulf maðelode, gomel on giohðe gold sceawode: “Ic ðara frætwa Frean ealles ðanc, Wuldur-cyninge, wordum secge, ecum Dryhtne, þe ic her on starie, þæs ðe ic moste minum leodum ær swylt-dæge swylc gestrynan.

text: Nū ic on māðma hord mīne bebohte frōde feorh-lege, fremmað gēna lēoda þearfe; ne mæg ic hēr leng wesan.
text_bare: Nu ic on maðma hord mine bebohte frode feorh-lege, fremmað gena leoda þearfe; ne mæg ic her leng wesan.

text: Hātað heaðo-mǣre hlǣw gewyrcean beorhtne æfber bǣle æt brimes nosan; sē scel tō gemyndum mīnum lēodum hēah hlīfian on Hrones næsse, þæt hit sǣ-līðend syððan hātan Bīowulfes biorh, ðā ðe brentingas ofer flōda genipu feorran drīfað.”.
text_bare: Hatað heaðo-mære hlæw gewyrcean beorhtne æfber bæle æt brimes nosan; se scel to gemyndum minum leodum heah hlifian on Hrones næsse, þæt hit sæ-liðend syððan hatan Biowulfes biorh, ða ðe brentingas ofer floda genipu feorran drifað.”.

text: Dyde him of healse hring gyldenne þīoden þrīst-hȳdig; þegne gesealde, geongum gār-wigan, gold-fāhne helm, bēah ond byrnan, hēt hyne brūcan well.
text_bare: Dyde him of healse hring gyldenne þioden þrist-hydig; þegne gesealde, geongum gar-wigan, gold-fahne helm, beah ond byrnan, het hyne brucan well.

text: “Þū eart ende-lāf usses cynnes, Wǣgmundinga; ealle wyrd forswēop mīne māgas tō metod-sceafte, eorlas on elne; ic him æfter sceal.” Þæt wæs þām gomelan gingæste word brēost-gehygdum, ǣr hē bǣl cure, hāte heaðo-wylmas; him of hreðre gewāt sāwol sēcean sōð-fæstra dōm.}}
text_bare: “Þu eart ende-laf usses cynnes, Wægmundinga; ealle wyrd forsweop mine magas to metod-sceafte, eorlas on elne; ic him æfter sceal.” Þæt wæs þam gomelan gingæste word breost-gehygdum, ær he bæl cure, hate heaðo-wylmas; him of hreðre gewat sawol secean soð-fæstra dom.}}

text: Ðā wæs gegongen guman unfrōdum earfoðlīce, þæt hē on eorðan geseah þone lēofestan līfes æt ende blēate gebǣran.
text_bare: Ða wæs gegongen guman unfrodum earfoðlice, þæt he on eorðan geseah þone leofestan lifes æt ende bleate gebæran.

text: Bona swylce læg, egeslīc eorð-draca ealdre berēafod, bealwe gebǣded.
text_bare: Bona swylce læg, egeslic eorð-draca ealdre bereafod, bealwe gebæded.

text: Bēah-hordum leng wyrm wōh-bogen wealdan ne mōste, ac hine īrenna ecga fornāmon, hearde, heaðo-scearde homera lāfe, þæt se wīd-floga wundum stille hrēas on hrūsan hord-ærne nēah; nalles æfter lyfte lācende hwearf middel-nihtum, māðm-ǣhta wlonc ansȳn ȳwde, ac hē eorðan gefēoll for ðæs hild-fruman hond-geweorce.
text_bare: Beah-hordum leng wyrm woh-bogen wealdan ne moste, ac hine irenna ecga fornamon, hearde, heaðo-scearde homera lafe, þæt se wid-floga wundum stille hreas on hrusan hord-ærne neah; nalles æfter lyfte lacende hwearf middel-nihtum, maðm-æhta wlonc ansyn ywde, ac he eorðan gefeoll for ðæs hild-fruman hond-geweorce.

text: Hūru þæt on lande lȳt manna ðāh mægen-āgendra, mīne gefrǣge, þēah ðe hē dǣda gehwæs dyrstig wǣre, þæt hē wið attor-sceaðan oreðe gerǣsde, oððe hring-sele hondum styrede, gif hē wæccende weard onfunde būon on beorge.
text_bare: Huru þæt on lande lyt manna ðah mægen-agendra, mine gefræge, þeah ðe he dæda gehwæs dyrstig wære, þæt he wið attor-sceaðan oreðe geræsde, oððe hring-sele hondum styrede, gif he wæccende weard onfunde buon on beorge.

text: Bīowulfe wearð dryht-māðma dǣl dēaðe forgolden; hæfde ǣghwæðer ende gefēred lǣnan līfes.
text_bare: Biowulfe wearð dryht-maðma dæl deaðe forgolden; hæfde æghwæðer ende gefered lænan lifes.

text: Næs ðā lang tō ðon, þæt ðā hild-latan holt ofgēfan, tydre trēow-logan tȳne ætsomne, ðā ne dorston ǣr dareðum lācan on hyra man-dryhtnes miclan þearfe; ac hȳ scamiende scyldas bǣran, gūð-gewǣdu, þǣr se gomela læg; wlitan on Wīglāf.
text_bare: Næs ða lang to ðon, þæt ða hild-latan holt ofgefan, tydre treow-logan tyne ætsomne, ða ne dorston ær dareðum lacan on hyra man-dryhtnes miclan þearfe; ac hy scamiende scyldas bæran, guð-gewædu, þær se gomela læg; wlitan on Wiglaf.

text: Hē gewērgad sæt, fēðe-cempa, frēan eaxlum nēah, wehte hyne wætre; him wiht ne spēow.
text_bare: He gewergad sæt, feðe-cempa, frean eaxlum neah, wehte hyne wætre; him wiht ne speow.

text: Ne meahte hē on eorðan, ðēah hē ūðe wel, on ðām frum-gāre feorh gehealdan, ne ðæs Wealdendes willan wiht oncirran.
text_bare: Ne meahte he on eorðan, ðeah he uðe wel, on ðam frum-gare feorh gehealdan, ne ðæs Wealdendes willan wiht oncirran.

text: Wolde dōm Godes dǣdum rǣdan gumena gehwylcum, swā hē nē gēn dēð.
text_bare: Wolde dom Godes dædum rædan gumena gehwylcum, swa he ne gen deð.

text: Þā wæs æt ðām geongum grim ondswaru ēð-begēte, þām ðe ǣr his elne forlēas.
text_bare: Þa wæs æt ðam geongum grim ondswaru eð-begete, þam ðe ær his elne forleas.

text: Wīglāf maðelode, Weohstānes sunu, secg sārig-ferð seah on unlēofe: “Þæt lā!
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode, Weohstanes sunu, secg sarig-ferð seah on unleofe: “Þæt la!

text: mæg secgan, sē ðe wyle sōð specan, þæt se mon-dryhten, sē ēow ðā māðmas geaf, ēored-geatwe, þe gē þǣr on standað, þonne hē on ealu-bence oft gesealde heal-sittendum helm ond byrnan, þēoden his þegnum, swylce hē þrȳðlīcost ōwēr feor oððe nēah findan meahte, þæt hē gēnunga gūð-gewǣdu wrāðe forwurpe, ðā hyne wīg beget.
text_bare: mæg secgan, se ðe wyle soð specan, þæt se mon-dryhten, se eow ða maðmas geaf, eored-geatwe, þe ge þær on standað, þonne he on ealu-bence oft gesealde heal-sittendum helm ond byrnan, þeoden his þegnum, swylce he þryðlicost ower feor oððe neah findan meahte, þæt he genunga guð-gewædu wraðe forwurpe, ða hyne wig beget.

text: Nealles folc-cyning fyrd-gesteallum gylpan þorfte; hwæðre him God ūðe, sigora Waldend, þæt hē hyne sylfne gewræc āna mid ecge, þā him wæs ehies þearf.
text_bare: Nealles folc-cyning fyrd-gesteallum gylpan þorfte; hwæðre him God uðe, sigora Waldend, þæt he hyne sylfne gewræc ana mid ecge, þa him wæs ehies þearf.

text: Ic him līf-wraðe lȳtle meahte ætgifan æt gūðe, ond ongan swā þēah ofer mīn gemet mǣges helpan.
text_bare: Ic him lif-wraðe lytle meahte ætgifan æt guðe, ond ongan swa þeah ofer min gemet mæges helpan.

text: Symle wæs þȳ sǣmra, þonne ic sweorde drep ferhð-genīðlan; fȳr unswīðor wēoll of gewitte.
text_bare: Symle wæs þy sæmra, þonne ic sweorde drep ferhð-geniðlan; fyr unswiðor weoll of gewitte.

text: Wergendra tō lȳt þrong ymbe þēoden, þā, hyne sīo þrāg becwom.
text_bare: Wergendra to lyt þrong ymbe þeoden, þa, hyne sio þrag becwom.

text: Nū sceal sinc-þego ond swyrd-gifu, eall ēdel-wyn, ēowrum cynne, lufen ālicgean; lond-rihtes mōt þǣre mǣg-burge monna ǣghwylc īdel hweorfan, syððan æðelingas feorran gefricgean flēam ēowerne, dōm-lēasan dǣd.
text_bare: Nu sceal sinc-þego ond swyrd-gifu, eall edel-wyn, eowrum cynne, lufen alicgean; lond-rihtes mot þære mæg-burge monna æghwylc idel hweorfan, syððan æðelingas feorran gefricgean fleam eowerne, dom-leasan dæd.

text: Dēað bið sēlla eorla gehwylcum þonne edwīt-līf.”}}
text_bare: Deað bið sella eorla gehwylcum þonne edwit-lif.”}}

text: Heht ðā þæt heaðo-weorc tō hagan bīodan ūp ofer ēg-clif, þǣr þæt eorl-weorod morgen-longne dæg mōd-gīomor sæt, bord-hæbbende, bēga on wēnum, ende-dōgores ond eft-cymes lēofes monnes.
text_bare: Heht ða þæt heaðo-weorc to hagan biodan up ofer eg-clif, þær þæt eorl-weorod morgen-longne dæg mod-giomor sæt, bord-hæbbende, bega on wenum, ende-dogores ond eft-cymes leofes monnes.

text: Lȳt swīgode nīwra spella, sē ðe næs gerād, ac hē sōðlīce sægde ofer ealle: “Nū is wil-geofa Wedra lēoda, dryhten Gēata, dēað-bedde fæst, wunað wæl-reste wyrmes dǣdum.
text_bare: Lyt swigode niwra spella, se ðe næs gerad, ac he soðlice sægde ofer ealle: “Nu is wil-geofa Wedra leoda, dryhten Geata, deað-bedde fæst, wunað wæl-reste wyrmes dædum.

text: Him on efn ligeð ealdor-gewinna siex-bennum sēoc; sweorde ne meahte on ðām āglǣcean ænige þinga wunde gewyrcean.
text_bare: Him on efn ligeð ealdor-gewinna siex-bennum seoc; sweorde ne meahte on ðam aglæcean ænige þinga wunde gewyrcean.

text: Wīglāf siteð ofer Bīowulfe, byre Wihstānes, eorl ofer ōðrum unlifigendum, healdeð hige-mǣðum hēafod-wearde lēofes ond lāðes.
text_bare: Wiglaf siteð ofer Biowulfe, byre Wihstanes, eorl ofer oðrum unlifigendum, healdeð hige-mæðum heafod-wearde leofes ond laðes.

text: Nū ys lēodum wēn orleg-hwīle, syððan underne Froncum ond Frȳsum fyll cyninges wīde weorðeð.
text_bare: Nu ys leodum wen orleg-hwile, syððan underne Froncum ond Frysum fyll cyninges wide weorðeð.

text: Wæs sīo wrōht scepen heard wið Hūgas, syððan Higelāc cwōm faran flot-herge on Frēsna land, þǣr hyne Hetware hilde gehnǣgdon, elne geēodon, mid ofer-mægene, þæt se byrn-wiga būgan sceolde, fēoll on fēðan; nalles frætwe geaf ealdor dugoðe.
text_bare: Wæs sio wroht scepen heard wið Hugas, syððan Higelac cwom faran flot-herge on Fresna land, þær hyne Hetware hilde gehnægdon, elne geeodon, mid ofer-mægene, þæt se byrn-wiga bugan sceolde, feoll on feðan; nalles frætwe geaf ealdor dugoðe.

text: Ūs wæs ā syððan Merewīoingas milts ungyfeðe.
text_bare: Us wæs a syððan Merewioingas milts ungyfeðe.

text: Ne ic tō Swēo-ðēode sibbe oððe trēowe wihte ne wēne; ac wæs wīde cūð, þætte Ongenðīo ealdre besnyðede Hǣðcen Hreþling wið Hrefna-wudu, þā for onmēdlan ǣrest gesōhton Gēata lēode Gūð-Scilfiiigas.
text_bare: Ne ic to Sweo-ðeode sibbe oððe treowe wihte ne wene; ac wæs wide cuð, þætte Ongenðio ealdre besnyðede Hæðcen Hreþling wið Hrefna-wudu, þa for onmedlan ærest gesohton Geata leode Guð-Scilfiiigas.

text: Sōna him se frōda fæder Ōhtheres, eald ond eges-full, ondslyht āgeaf, ābrēot brim-wīsan, brȳd āhēorde, gomela īo-meowlan golde berofene, Onelan mōdor ond Ōhtheres, ond ðā folgode feorh-genīðlan, oð ðæt hī oðēodon earfoðlīce in Hrefnes holt hlāford-lēase.
text_bare: Sona him se froda fæder Ohtheres, eald ond eges-full, ondslyht ageaf, abreot brim-wisan, bryd aheorde, gomela io-meowlan golde berofene, Onelan modor ond Ohtheres, ond ða folgode feorh-geniðlan, oð ðæt hi oðeodon earfoðlice in Hrefnes holt hlaford-lease.

text: Besæt ðā sin-herge sweorda lāfe wundum wērge; wēan oft gehēt earmre teohhe ondlonge niht; cwæð, hē on mergenne mēces ecgum gētan wolde, sume on galg-trēowum fuglum tō gamene.
text_bare: Besæt ða sin-herge sweorda lafe wundum werge; wean oft gehet earmre teohhe ondlonge niht; cwæð, he on mergenne meces ecgum getan wolde, sume on galg-treowum fuglum to gamene.

text: Frōfor eft gelamp sārig-mōdum somod ǣr-dæge, syððan hīe Hygelāces horn ond bȳman gealdor ongēaton, þā se gōda cōm lēoda dugoðe on lāst faran.
text_bare: Frofor eft gelamp sarig-modum somod ær-dæge, syððan hie Hygelaces horn ond byman gealdor ongeaton, þa se goda com leoda dugoðe on last faran.

text: Wæs sīo swāt-swaðu Swēona ond Gēata, wæl-rǣs weora, wīde gesȳne, hū ðā folc mid him fǣhðe tōwehton.
text_bare: Wæs sio swat-swaðu Sweona ond Geata, wæl-ræs weora, wide gesyne, hu ða folc mid him fæhðe towehton.

text: Gewāt him ðā se gōda mid his gædelingum, frōd, fela-gēomor, fæsten sēcean, eorl Ongenþīo ufor oncirde; hæfde Higelāces hilde gefrūnen, wlonces wīg-cræft; wiðres ne trūwode, þæt hē sǣ-mamium onsacan mihte, hēaðo-līðendum, hord forstandan, bearn ond brȳde; bēah eft þonan eald under eorð-weall.
text_bare: Gewat him ða se goda mid his gædelingum, frod, fela-geomor, fæsten secean, eorl Ongenþio ufor oncirde; hæfde Higelaces hilde gefrunen, wlonces wig-cræft; wiðres ne truwode, þæt he sæ-mamium onsacan mihte, heaðo-liðendum, hord forstandan, bearn ond bryde; beah eft þonan eald under eorð-weall.

text: Þā wæs ǣht boden Swēona lēodum, segn Higelāces; freoðo-wong þone forð oferēodon, syððan Hrēðlingas tō hagan þrungon.
text_bare: Þa wæs æht boden Sweona leodum, segn Higelaces; freoðo-wong þone forð ofereodon, syððan Hreðlingas to hagan þrungon.

text: Þǣr wearð Ongenðīow ecgum sweorda, blonden-fexa, on bīd wrecen, þæt se þēod-cyning ðafian sceolde Eafores ānne dōm.
text_bare: Þær wearð Ongenðiow ecgum sweorda, blonden-fexa, on bid wrecen, þæt se þeod-cyning ðafian sceolde Eafores anne dom.

text: Hyne yrringa Wulf Wonrēding wǣpne gerǣhte, þæt him for swenge swāt ǣdrum sprong forð under fexe.
text_bare: Hyne yrringa Wulf Wonreding wæpne geræhte, þæt him for swenge swat ædrum sprong forð under fexe.

text: Næs hē forht swā ðēh, gomela Scilfing, ac forgeald hraðe wyrsan wrixle wæl-hlem þone, syððan ðēod-cyning þyder oncirde.
text_bare: Næs he forht swa ðeh, gomela Scilfing, ac forgeald hraðe wyrsan wrixle wæl-hlem þone, syððan ðeod-cyning þyder oncirde.

text: Ne meahte se snella sunu Wonrēdes ealdum ceorle ondslyht giofan, ac hē him on hēafde helm ǣr gescer, þæt hē blōde fāh būgan sceolde, fēoll on foldan; næs hē fǣge þā git, ac hē hyne gewyrpte, þēah ðe him wund hrine.
text_bare: Ne meahte se snella sunu Wonredes ealdum ceorle ondslyht giofan, ac he him on heafde helm ær gescer, þæt he blode fah bugan sceolde, feoll on foldan; næs he fæge þa git, ac he hyne gewyrpte, þeah ðe him wund hrine.

text: Lēt se hearda Higelāces þegn brādne mēce, þā his brōðor læg, eald sweord eotonisc, entiscne helm brecan ofer bord-weal; ðā gebēah cyning, folces hyrde, wæs in feorh dropen.
text_bare: Let se hearda Higelaces þegn bradne mece, þa his broðor læg, eald sweord eotonisc, entiscne helm brecan ofer bord-weal; ða gebeah cyning, folces hyrde, wæs in feorh dropen.

text: Ðā wǣron monige, þe his mǣg wriðon, ricone ārǣrdon, ðā him gerȳmed wearð, þæt hīe wæl-stōwe wealdan mōston, þenden rēafode rinc ōðerne, nam on Ongenðīo īren-byrnan, heard swyrd hilted ond his helm somod; hāres hyrste Higelāce bær.
text_bare: Ða wæron monige, þe his mæg wriðon, ricone arærdon, ða him gerymed wearð, þæt hie wæl-stowe wealdan moston, þenden reafode rinc oðerne, nam on Ongenðio iren-byrnan, heard swyrd hilted ond his helm somod; hares hyrste Higelace bær.

text: Hā ðām frætwum fēng, ond him fægre gehēt lēana for lēodum, ond gelǣste swā; geald þone gūð-rǣs Gēata dryhten, Hrēðles eafora, þā hē tō hām becōm, Iofore ond Wulfe mid ofer-māðmum, sealde hiora gehwæðrum hund þūsenda landes ond locenra beaga; ne ðorfte him ðā lēan oðwītan mon on middan-gearde, syððan hīe ðā mǣrða geslōgon; ond ðā Iofore forgeaf āngan dohtor, hām-weorðunge, hyldo tō wedde.
text_bare: Ha ðam frætwum feng, ond him fægre gehet leana for leodum, ond gelæste swa; geald þone guð-ræs Geata dryhten, Hreðles eafora, þa he to ham becom, Iofore ond Wulfe mid ofer-maðmum, sealde hiora gehwæðrum hund þusenda landes ond locenra beaga; ne ðorfte him ða lean oðwitan mon on middan-gearde, syððan hie ða mærða geslogon; ond ða Iofore forgeaf angan dohtor, ham-weorðunge, hyldo to wedde.

text: Þæt ys sīo fǣhðo ond se fēond-scipe, wæl-nīð wera, ðæs ðe ic wēn hafo, þē ūs sēceað tō Swēona lēoda, syððan hīe gefricgeað frēan ūserne ealdor-lēasne, þone ðe ǣr gehēold wis hettendum hord ond rīce æfter hæleSa hryre, hwate Scilfingas, folc-rēd fremede, oððe furður gēn eorl-scipe efnde.
text_bare: Þæt ys sio fæhðo ond se feond-scipe, wæl-nið wera, ðæs ðe ic wen hafo, þe us seceað to Sweona leoda, syððan hie gefricgeað frean userne ealdor-leasne, þone ðe ær geheold wis hettendum hord ond rice æfter hæleSa hryre, hwate Scilfingas, folc-red fremede, oððe furður gen eorl-scipe efnde.

text: Nū is ofost betost, þæt wē þēod-cyning þǣr scēawian, ond þone gebringan, þe ūs bēagas geaf, on ād-fære.
text_bare: Nu is ofost betost, þæt we þeod-cyning þær sceawian, ond þone gebringan, þe us beagas geaf, on ad-fære.

text: Ne scel ānes hwæt meltan mid þām mōdigan, ac þǣr is māðma hord, gold unrīme, grimme gecēapod, ond nū æt sīðestan sylfes fēore bēagas gebohte; þā sceall brond fretan, ǣled þeccean, nalles eorl wegan māððum tō gemyndum, ne mægð scȳne habban on healse hring-weorðunge, ac sceal gēomor-mōd, golde berēafod, oft, nalles ǣne, el-land tredan, nū se here-wīsa hleahtor ālegde, gamen ond glēo-drēam.
text_bare: Ne scel anes hwæt meltan mid þam modigan, ac þær is maðma hord, gold unrime, grimme geceapod, ond nu æt siðestan sylfes feore beagas gebohte; þa sceall brond fretan, æled þeccean, nalles eorl wegan maððum to gemyndum, ne mægð scyne habban on healse hring-weorðunge, ac sceal geomor-mod, golde bereafod, oft, nalles æne, el-land tredan, nu se here-wisa hleahtor alegde, gamen ond gleo-dream.

text: Forðon sceall gār wesan, monig morgen-ceald, mundum bewunden, hæfen on handa, nalles hearpan swēg wīgend weccean, ac se wonna hrefn fūs ofer fǣgum fela reordian, earne secgan hū him æt ǣte spēow, þenden hē wið wulf wæl rēafode.” Swā se secg hwata secgende wæs lāðra spella; hē ne lēag fela wyrda ne worda.
text_bare: Forðon sceall gar wesan, monig morgen-ceald, mundum bewunden, hæfen on handa, nalles hearpan sweg wigend weccean, ac se wonna hrefn fus ofer fægum fela reordian, earne secgan hu him æt æte speow, þenden he wið wulf wæl reafode.” Swa se secg hwata secgende wæs laðra spella; he ne leag fela wyrda ne worda.

text: Weorod eall ārās; ēodon unblīðe under Earna næs, wollen-tēare, wundur scēawian.
text_bare: Weorod eall aras; eodon unbliðe under Earna næs, wollen-teare, wundur sceawian.

text: Fundon ðā on sande sāwul-lēasne hlim-bed healdan, þone þe him hringas geaf ǣrran mǣlum; þā wæs ende-dæg gōdum gegongen, þæt se gūð-cyning, Wedra þēoden, wundor-dēaðe swealt.
text_bare: Fundon ða on sande sawul-leasne hlim-bed healdan, þone þe him hringas geaf ærran mælum; þa wæs ende-dæg godum gegongen, þæt se guð-cyning, Wedra þeoden, wundor-deaðe swealt.

text: Ǣr hī þǣr gesēgan syllīcran wiht, wyrm on wonge wiðer-ræhtes þǣr lāðne licgean; wæs se lēg-draca, grimlīc gryre, glēdum beswǣled.
text_bare: Ær hi þær gesegan syllicran wiht, wyrm on wonge wiðer-ræhtes þær laðne licgean; wæs se leg-draca, grimlic gryre, gledum beswæled.

text: Sē wæs fīftiges fōt-gemearces lang on legere; lyft-wynne hēold nihtes hwīlum, nyðer eft gewāt dennes nīosian; wæs ðā dēaðe fæst, hæfde eorð-scrafa ende genyttod.
text_bare: Se wæs fiftiges fot-gemearces lang on legere; lyft-wynne heold nihtes hwilum, nyðer eft gewat dennes niosian; wæs ða deaðe fæst, hæfde eorð-scrafa ende genyttod.

text: Him big stōdan būnan ond orcas, discas lāgon ond dȳre swyrd, ōmige, þurh-etone, swā hīe wið eorðan fæðm þūsend wintra þǣr eardodon; þonne wæs þæt yrfe ēacen-cræftig, īu-monna gold, galdre bewunden, þæt ðām hring-sele hrīnan ne mōste gumena ǣnig, nefne God sylfa, sigora Sōð-cyning, sealde þām ðe hē wolde hē is manna gehyld hord openian, efne swā hwylcum manna, swā him gemet ðūhte.
text_bare: Him big stodan bunan ond orcas, discas lagon ond dyre swyrd, omige, þurh-etone, swa hie wið eorðan fæðm þusend wintra þær eardodon; þonne wæs þæt yrfe eacen-cræftig, iu-monna gold, galdre bewunden, þæt ðam hring-sele hrinan ne moste gumena ænig, nefne God sylfa, sigora Soð-cyning, sealde þam ðe he wolde he is manna gehyld hord openian, efne swa hwylcum manna, swa him gemet ðuhte.

text: Þā wæs gesȳne, þæt se sīð ne ðāh þām ðe unrihte inne gehȳdde wræte under wealle.
text_bare: Þa wæs gesyne, þæt se sið ne ðah þam ðe unrihte inne gehydde wræte under wealle.

text: Weard ǣr ofslōh fēara sumne; þā sīo fǣhð gewearð gewrecen wrāðlīce.
text_bare: Weard ær ofsloh feara sumne; þa sio fæhð gewearð gewrecen wraðlice.

text: Wundur hwār þonne eorl ellen-rōf ende gefēre līf-gesceafta, þonne leng ne mæg mon mid his māgum medu-seld būan.
text_bare: Wundur hwar þonne eorl ellen-rof ende gefere lif-gesceafta, þonne leng ne mæg mon mid his magum medu-seld buan.

text: Swā wæs Bīowulfe, þā hē biorges weard sōhte, searo-nīðas; seolfa ne cūðe, þurh hwæt his worulde gedāl weorðan sceolde.
text_bare: Swa wæs Biowulfe, þa he biorges weard sohte, searo-niðas; seolfa ne cuðe, þurh hwæt his worulde gedal weorðan sceolde.

text: Swā hit oð dōmes dæg dīope benemdon þēodnas mǣre, þā ðæt þǣr dydon, þæt se secg wǣre synnum scildig, hergum geheaðerod, hell-bendum fæst, wommum gewitnad, sē ðone wong strude.
text_bare: Swa hit oð domes dæg diope benemdon þeodnas mære, þa ðæt þær dydon, þæt se secg wære synnum scildig, hergum geheaðerod, hell-bendum fæst, wommum gewitnad, se ðone wong strude.

text: Næs hē gold-hwæt; gearwor hæfde Āgendes ēst ǣr gescēawod.
text_bare: Næs he gold-hwæt; gearwor hæfde Agendes est ær gesceawod.

text: Wīglāf maðelode, Wihstānes sunu: “Oft sceall eorl monig ānes willan wræc ādrēogan, swā ūs geworden is.
text_bare: Wiglaf maðelode, Wihstanes sunu: “Oft sceall eorl monig anes willan wræc adreogan, swa us geworden is.

text: Ne meahton wē gelǣran lēofne þēoden, rīces hyrde, rǣd ǣnigne, þǣt hē ne grētte gold-weard þone, lēte hyne licgean, þǣr hē longe wæs, wīcum wunian oð woruld-ende; hēold on hēah gesceap.
text_bare: Ne meahton we gelæran leofne þeoden, rices hyrde, ræd ænigne, þæt he ne grette gold-weard þone, lete hyne licgean, þær he longe wæs, wicum wunian oð woruld-ende; heold on heah gesceap.

text: Hord ys gescēawod, grimme gegongen; wæs þæt gifeðe tō swīð, þe ðone þēod-cyning þyder ontyhte.
text_bare: Hord ys gesceawod, grimme gegongen; wæs þæt gifeðe to swið, þe ðone þeod-cyning þyder ontyhte.

text: Ic wæs þǣr inne ond þæt eall geondseh, recedes geatwa, þā mē gerȳmed wæs nealles swǣslīce, sīð ālȳfed inn under eorð-weall.
text_bare: Ic wæs þær inne ond þæt eall geondseh, recedes geatwa, þa me gerymed wæs nealles swæslice, sið alyfed inn under eorð-weall.

text: Ic on ofoste gefēng micle mid mundum mægen-byrðenne hord-gestrēona, hider ūt ætbær cyninge mīnum; cwico wæs þā gēna, wīs ond gewittig.
text_bare: Ic on ofoste gefeng micle mid mundum mægen-byrðenne hord-gestreona, hider ut ætbær cyninge minum; cwico wæs þa gena, wis ond gewittig.

text: Worn eall gespræc gomol on gehðo, ond ēowic grētan hēt, bæd þæt gē geworhton æfter wines dǣdum in bǣl-stede beorh þone hēan, micelne ond mǣrne, swā hē manna wæs wīgend weorð-fullost wīde geond eorðan, þenden hē burh-welan brūcan mōste.
text_bare: Worn eall gespræc gomol on gehðo, ond eowic gretan het, bæd þæt ge geworhton æfter wines dædum in bæl-stede beorh þone hean, micelne ond mærne, swa he manna wæs wigend weorð-fullost wide geond eorðan, þenden he burh-welan brucan moste.

text: Uton nū efstan ōðre sīðe sēon ond sēcean searo-geþræc, wundur under wealle; ic ēow wīsige, þæt gē genōge nēon scēawiað bēagas ond brād gold.
text_bare: Uton nu efstan oðre siðe seon ond secean searo-geþræc, wundur under wealle; ic eow wisige, þæt ge genoge neon sceawiað beagas ond brad gold.

text: Sīe sīo bǣr gearo ǣdre geæfned, þonne wē ūt cymen, ond þonne geferian frēan ūserne, lēofne mannan, þǣr hē longe sceal on ðæs Waldendes wǣre geþolian.” Hēt ðā gebēodan byre Wihstānes, hæle hilde-dīor, hæleða monegum, bold-āgendra, þæt hīe bǣl-wudu feorran feredon, folc-āgende, gōdum tōgēnes: “Nū sceal glēd fretan weaxan wonna lēg wigena strengel, þone ðe oft gebād īsern-scūre, þonne strǣla storm strengum gebǣded scōc ofer scild-weall, sceft nytte hēold, feðer-gēarwum fūs flāne full-ēode.” Hūru se snotra sunu Wihstānes ācīgde of corðre cyninges þegnas syfone ætsomne, þā sēlestan, ēode eahta sum under inwit-hrōf; hilde-rinc sum on handa bær ǣled-lēoman, sē ðe on orde gēong.
text_bare: Sie sio bær gearo ædre geæfned, þonne we ut cymen, ond þonne geferian frean userne, leofne mannan, þær he longe sceal on ðæs Waldendes wære geþolian.” Het ða gebeodan byre Wihstanes, hæle hilde-dior, hæleða monegum, bold-agendra, þæt hie bæl-wudu feorran feredon, folc-agende, godum togenes: “Nu sceal gled fretan weaxan wonna leg wigena strengel, þone ðe oft gebad isern-scure, þonne stræla storm strengum gebæded scoc ofer scild-weall, sceft nytte heold, feðer-gearwum fus flane full-eode.” Huru se snotra sunu Wihstanes acigde of corðre cyninges þegnas syfone ætsomne, þa selestan, eode eahta sum under inwit-hrof; hilde-rinc sum on handa bær æled-leoman, se ðe on orde geong.

text: Næs ðā on hlytme, hwā þǣt hord strude, syððan orwearde ǣnigne dǣl secgas gesēgon on sele wunian, lǣne licgan; lȳt ǣnig mearn, þæt hī ofostlīce ūt geferedon dȳre māðmas.
text_bare: Næs ða on hlytme, hwa þæt hord strude, syððan orwearde ænigne dæl secgas gesegon on sele wunian, læne licgan; lyt ænig mearn, þæt hi ofostlice ut geferedon dyre maðmas.

text: Dracan ēc scufun, wyrm ofer weall-clif, lēton wēg niman, flōd fæðmian, frætwa hyrde.
text_bare: Dracan ec scufun, wyrm ofer weall-clif, leton weg niman, flod fæðmian, frætwa hyrde.

text: Þǣr wæs wunden gold on wǣn hladen, ǣghwæs unrīm; æþeling boren, hār hilde-rinc, to Hrones næsse.
text_bare: Þær wæs wunden gold on wæn hladen, æghwæs unrim; æþeling boren, har hilde-rinc, to Hrones næsse.

text: Him ðā gegiredan Gēata lēode ād on eorðan unwāclīcne, helmum behongen, hilde-bordum, beorhtum byrnum, swā hā bēna wæs; ālegdon ðā tōmiddes mǣrne þēoden hæleð hīofende, hlāford lēofne.
text_bare: Him ða gegiredan Geata leode ad on eorðan unwaclicne, helmum behongen, hilde-bordum, beorhtum byrnum, swa ha bena wæs; alegdon ða tomiddes mærne þeoden hæleð hiofende, hlaford leofne.

text: Ongunnon þā on beorge bǣl-fȳra mǣst wīgend weccan; wudu-rēc āstāh sweart ofer swioðole, swōgende lēg wōpe bewunden wind-blond gelæg , oð þæt hē ðā bān-hūs gebrocen hæfde, hāt on hreðre.
text_bare: Ongunnon þa on beorge bæl-fyra mæst wigend weccan; wudu-rec astah sweart ofer swioðole, swogende leg wope bewunden wind-blond gelæg , oð þæt he ða ban-hus gebrocen hæfde, hat on hreðre.

text: Higum unrōte mōd-ceare mǣndon mon-dryhtnes cwealm; swylce gīomor gyd sīo gēo-mēowle .
text_bare: Higum unrote mod-ceare mændon mon-dryhtnes cwealm; swylce giomor gyd sio geo-meowle .

text_bare: bunden heorde .

text: Heofon rēce swealg.
text_bare: Heofon rece swealg.

text: Geworhton ðā Wedra lēode hlǣw on hliðe, sē wæs hēah ond brād, wǣg-līðendum wīde gesȳne, ond betimbredon on tȳn dagum beadu-rōfes bēcn; bronda lāfe wealle beworhton, swā hyt weorðlīcost fore-snotre men findan mihton.
text_bare: Geworhton ða Wedra leode hlæw on hliðe, se wæs heah ond brad, wæg-liðendum wide gesyne, ond betimbredon on tyn dagum beadu-rofes becn; bronda lafe wealle beworhton, swa hyt weorðlicost fore-snotre men findan mihton.

text: Hī on beorg dydon bēg ond siglu, eall swylce hyrsta, swylce on horde ǣr nīð-hēdige men genumen hæfdon; forlēton eorla gestrēon eorðan healdan, gold on grēote, þǣr hit nū gēn lifað eldum swā unnyt, swā hit ǣror wæs.
text_bare: Hi on beorg dydon beg ond siglu, eall swylce hyrsta, swylce on horde ær nið-hedige men genumen hæfdon; forleton eorla gestreon eorðan healdan, gold on greote, þær hit nu gen lifað eldum swa unnyt, swa hit æror wæs.

text: Þā ymbe hlǣw riodan hilde-dēore æþelinga bearn ealra twelfa, woldon ceare cwīðan, kyning mǣnan, word-gyd wrecan, ond ymb wer sprecan; }} eahtodan eorl-scipe, ond his ellen-weorc duguðum dēmdon, swā hit ge-dēfe bið, þæt mon his wine-dryhten wordum herge, ferhðum frēoge, þonne hē forð scile of līc-haman lǣne weorðan.
text_bare: Þa ymbe hlæw riodan hilde-deore æþelinga bearn ealra twelfa, woldon ceare cwiðan, kyning mænan, word-gyd wrecan, ond ymb wer sprecan; }} eahtodan eorl-scipe, ond his ellen-weorc duguðum demdon, swa hit ge-defe bið, þæt mon his wine-dryhten wordum herge, ferhðum freoge, þonne he forð scile of lic-haman læne weorðan.

text: Swā begnornodon Gēata lēode hlāfordes hryre, heorð-genēatas; cwǣdon þæt hē wǣre wyruld-cyning, manna mildust ond mon-ðwǣrust, lēodum līðost, ond lof-geornost.
text_bare: Swa begnornodon Geata leode hlafordes hryre, heorð-geneatas; cwædon þæt he wære wyruld-cyning, manna mildust ond mon-ðwærust, leodum liðost, ond lof-geornost.

text: þæt hīe swā frēolīc feorh forman sīþe tō ðǣre healle durum hyrsta ne bǣran, nū hyt nīþa heard ānyman wolde; ac hē frægn ofer eal undearninga, dēor-mōd hæleð, hwā ðā duru hēolde.
text_bare: þæt hie swa freolic feorh forman siþe to ðære healle durum hyrsta ne bæran, nu hyt niþa heard anyman wolde; ac he frægn ofer eal undearninga, deor-mod hæleð, hwa ða duru heolde.

text: “Sigeferþ is mīn nama cweð he , ic eom Secgena lēod, wreccea wīde cūð.
text_bare: “Sigeferþ is min nama cweð he , ic eom Secgena leod, wreccea wide cuð.

text: Fela ic wēana gebād, heardra hilda; ðē is gyt hēr witod, swæðer ðū sylf tō mē sēcean wylle.” Þā wæs on wealle wæl-slihta gehlyn, sceolde cellod bord cēnum on handa, bān-helm berstan.
text_bare: Fela ic weana gebad, heardra hilda; ðe is gyt her witod, swæðer ðu sylf to me secean wylle.” Þa wæs on wealle wæl-slihta gehlyn, sceolde cellod bord cenum on handa, ban-helm berstan.

text: Buruh-ðelu dynede, ōð þæt æt ðǣre gūðe Gārulf gecrang, ealra ǣrest eorð-būendra, Gūðlāfes sunu, ymbe hyue gōdra fela.
text_bare: Buruh-ðelu dynede, oð þæt æt ðære guðe Garulf gecrang, ealra ærest eorð-buendra, Guðlafes sunu, ymbe hyue godra fela.

text: Hwarf flacra hrǣw hræfen, wandrode sweart and sealo-brun; swurd-lēoma stōd swylce eal Finns-buruh fȳrenu wǣre.
text_bare: Hwarf flacra hræw hræfen, wandrode sweart and sealo-brun; swurd-leoma stod swylce eal Finns-buruh fyrenu wære.

text: Ne gefrægn ic nǣfre wurþlīcor æt wera hilde sixtig sige-beorna sēl gebǣran, ne nǣfre swānas swētne medo sēl forgyldan, ðonne Hnæfe guldan his hæg-stealdas.
text_bare: Ne gefrægn ic næfre wurþlicor æt wera hilde sixtig sige-beorna sel gebæran, ne næfre swanas swetne medo sel forgyldan, ðonne Hnæfe guldan his hæg-stealdas.

text: Hig fuhton fīf dagas, swā hyra nān ne fēol driht-gesīða, ac hig ðā duru hēoldon.
text_bare: Hig fuhton fif dagas, swa hyra nan ne feol driht-gesiða, ac hig ða duru heoldon.

text: Þā gewāt him wund hæleð on wæg gangan, sǣde þæt his byrne ābrocen wǣre, here-sceorp unhrōr, and ēac wæs his helm ðȳrl.
text_bare: Þa gewat him wund hæleð on wæg gangan, sæde þæt his byrne abrocen wære, here-sceorp unhror, and eac wæs his helm ðyrl.

text: Ðā hine sōna frægn folces hyrde, hū ðū wīgend hyra wunda genǣson, oððe hwæþer ðǣra hyssa
text_bare: Ða hine sona frægn folces hyrde, hu ðu wigend hyra wunda genæson, oððe hwæþer ðæra hyssa
